The messages popped instantly. Vritra remained seated, wondering what sort of change was going to happen in his environment.
{You have taken the path of the Divine and have now officially become the next Divine.}
{Preparing the announcement...}
Suddenly, inside the small realm of the dimensional book, the sky was covered with clouds and the thundering sound of lightning rang out.
That was just the start of strange changes. Suddenly a heavy voice sounded, as if someone was screaming right inside his head.
"THE DIVINE HAS BEEN BORN IN THE TOPAZ CONTINENT WHITE KINGDOM, VRITRA ARCLIS, WILL BE THE ONE TO CONTINUE WITH THE DIVINE’S LEGACY.
THE DIVINE, MORE POWERFUL THAN EVER, WILL SLAUGHTER ALL GODS, SIX SEATS, FIVE MONARCHS, FOUR EMPERORS, THREE JUDGES AND THE TWO LORDS!!
THE SKY WILL BREAK, THE GROUND SWALLOWED, DIVINE COULD NEVER BE KILLED!! THE INEVITABLE, THE HONOURED, THE FEARED!!"
While the loud and heavy words sounded, even a portrait of Vritra became visible inside the small realm. It was extremely large and very clear.
The same thing that was said just now even appeared like letters in the sky beside his face that looked exactly like him.

"Oh, so the changes really weren’t too big. I guess hearing this announcement inside this realm is fine. I am getting something super powerful in return after all. And that photo looks nice." Vritra said with a nod.
After the first announcement, the voice repeated the same thing again as if to confirm that not a single word was missed.
"And who are all these people beside the Gods? They sound really dangerous—" suddenly Yasmine interrupted him, her face becoming pale even in her soul-like form.
"Wait hubby, that announcement and the image isn’t just present inside this book realm but..."
Vritra was shocked and he observed the outside and indeed, the same announcement was being said just as loudly again and again, the same image appearing across the sky.
"Oh..." he was so shocked that he didn’t know what to say.
He had just been exposed to all the dangerous powers across the universe, and the divine was shameless enough to repeat it more than twenty times, along with his HD-quality image.
Yasmine: "..."
Vritra: "YOU BITCH—"
Before he could finish, his entire body was covered by a red fluid.

"Heehee, duz dis mean my wuvvy-dovey cutie-pie finawwy wanna gib me a itty-bitty chancey-wancey, my karieeeeee- kiyaaaaaaa!!"
Diddy let out a feminine scream, his body jumping like a scared cat as soon as he saw Vritra in his Ben Tennyson form.
Vritra’s face scrunched up in disgust, looking at Diddy who was certainly living up to his name.
A strong disgust rose from within.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Disgusted +1, +1, +1...}
{Sin Point Gained: Grossed Out +1, +1, +1...}
{Sin Point Gained: Repulsed +1, +1, +1...}
His defence mechanism kicked in as Vritra almost blasted the two to pieces; even the Elegy Parasite almost came to the rescue.
"D- D- Disgu- I mean, sorry." Karen turned around and fled, sensing the heavy pressure in the air.
While Diddy just fainted there, a slight patch of wetness could be seen on his pant.
’Yeah, mom was right, maybe I shouldn’t go out.’ Vritra thought.
When the start was this bad, then who knows how badly things could go.
Not to mention all the bad luck he just inherited by this disgusting sight.
After thinking for a while, he decided to just go high into the sky and then enter his dimensional book.
That way, even if a big commotion was caused, the surrounding wouldn’t be much affected.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
Vritra entered the disappearing state and then flew up directly, only stopping after making sure there was no one around and he was high enough.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Vritra scanned the surroundings just to be sure, and after confirming there wasn’t anything wrong, he relaxed and sat down inside the small realm.
It was just a vast grassland with a clear sky where a cold wind was blowing.
He created this nice environment to refresh his mind and remove that disgusting memory.
"Hoo, this is better, wifey, let’s first work on regaining your levels." Vritra said and pulled out all the soul potion glass bottles, making them hover in front of him.
"Okay, I am ready." Yasmine stayed inside.
The energy would be divided into three parts: one for Vritra, second for Yasmine, and third for Nihil-anima mythic halo, though the dragoness gets the most of it.
GULP GULP
Without wasting a moment, Vritra began to gulp down the soul potions.
He was completely used to its taste by now.
He drank one bottle after another.
The moment he swallowed the fluid, it transformed into energy and was then controlled by Yasmine.

The amount of soul potion Vritra had received was extremely large this time, so it was going to be a great help to her, and now she would be able to stay in her human form for several times longer periods.
One bottle after another, Vritra devoured the entire stock after a long time, spending at least a couple of hours just drinking nonstop.
"Hoo, I feel full and empty at the same time, so much energy, it will take me quite long to absorb it all." Vritra mumbled, touching his stomach.
Thankfully, the hunger he had felt in the abandoned realm before didn’t return even after not devouring any sin coin.
"Mmm, such a nice meal, thank you, hubby."

Yasmine said, humming in satisfaction as she came out and transformed into her beautiful human-like form and sat down on Vritra’s lap, circling her arms around his neck and resting her head over his shoulder.
"Haa, shall we get started with the evolution now?" Vritra placed his arm over her waist.
Being close to her made him feel as if his good luck meter was charging up.
Although there was no warmth or real like feeling, it was still such a wholesome feeling.
"Yeah, let’s see what the physique and bloodline of the Divine would be like." Yasmine muttered.
Now she could stay like this for more than an hour easily, or maybe even two.
Taking a long breath, Vritra opened the status panel and focused on the area of the evolution, reading the message carefully.
{Would you like to Evolve into the Divine’s Bloodline and Physique?}
{Yes / No}
After reading the line and seeing the two options, Vritra was just about to choose yes when Yasmine spoke: "Wait, look at the corner, I think something is written there."
The letters written were so small that even Vritra, with his Nether Eye on, had to focus for a while to be able to read.
It was like the line spoken at the end of a risky investment ad that sounds like gibberish, telling about the risks.
(Note: Upon choosing to obtain the strongest physique and bloodline in existence, there will be a tiny, absolutely small, negligible change in your surroundings.
A change so small that no one would notice, it is minuscule and holds no importance.
The physique and bloodline hold immense power; the microscopic change holds no value when compared to the pros.)

He felt like he was having a Deja Vu.
After thinking for a moment, he remembered that his dragon waifu had said something like that when she shared the side effects of getting the dragon’s bloodline and physique.
This was clearly some sort of scheme, a scam, a perfect fraud.
"Why are you looking at me like that?" Yasmine shifted slightly on his lap, looking to a different side, watching the grass sway in the air.

Your Demonic Dragon God bloodline and Physique are already very powerful and you can upgrade them in the future, so no reason to take the risk."
"..." Vritra nodded.
He could think more about it and make a better decision.
It’s not like the physique and bloodline were going to run anywhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: Disaster
paragraphs: There are countless powers spread across the universe, though for most, gods are the highest and strongest beings.
But since no gods directly interfere with beings on the planet, they aren’t normally considered in the power system.

Under the gods, there are many powerful entities like the demon lords, the six seats of the Golden Moon, five monarchs of the strongest five families, four emperors of the strongest three races, three judges from the Divine Kage, and the two lords.
All of them had stood against the demons and any other danger.
All of them were busy with their works when suddenly a piercing voice reverberated throughout the universe, challenging them directly.
Of course, they were among the few who knew about the Divine, and also knew why he hates them.
The gods and demon gods can’t make a move against the new Divine unless he comes knocking at their door, so they gave the highest level of order to all their followers.
Kill Vritra Arclis at any cost before he gets the time to grow.
All other strong people who were also threatened during the announcement also began to search for Vritra, though many of them had different plans for him.
The human emperor was also among the ones who were threatened. There are a total of three continents where humans could live.
Out of the three, Topaz could be considered the smallest and weakest, then comes the Opal continent which wasn’t all that different from Topaz.
The biggest reason for the two continents being so weak was the power management. Almost the entire power of humanity was present in the single and largest continent, Quartz.
They wouldn’t allow the other continents to grow enough that they could pose any sort of danger.
Quartz was so big that it could easily swallow hundreds of continents the size of the other two, and the power level was extremely high.

A lot of secret realms were present all over the Quartz continent, and inside one such realm that was used by the emperor to keep the most dangerous and heinous criminals, four guys could be seen sitting over benches forming a circle.
The group of four ignored the others in the same cell, their arms were chained by a special material that could greatly decrease their overall strength and make it impossible to use any skill.
One was a guy who looked to be in his early twenties, though with a childishly innocent face, contrary to all the other prisoners who kept looking at him strangely.
The second looked to be around in his thirties, with a decent face, but was covered in chains from top to bottom.
The third was a baldy wearing reddish clothes, with a swollen bump exactly in the middle of his forehead.
And finally, the last one was a blind guy with a weak body, only he was wearing simple cuffs.
Vritra, Monk Shitless, Onest and Rich sat inside one of the most dangerous prisons of the Quartz kingdom. The atmosphere around them was quite sinister.
"H- How can this be? How did I end up here? I just came to meet with the emperor, why would they capture me too? And a monk, a beggar and a blind guy?"
Rich pulled his hair in frustration, looking extremely confused and shaken.

He just came here to talk with the emperor about a big deal that he was going to propose to the dragon race, but the moment he stepped near the Emperor’s Palace, he was captured like some criminal and thrown into this place.
"Sob, my reputation, what am I going to tell people back in White Kingdom? I had never been caught." Onest was busy with his own sobbing.
"Kekeke, I am getting closer to the peak of evil, now everyone will know of Shitless the most evil monk, kekeke."
Monk Shitless was busy with his own thoughts, feeling proud to be able to get into one of the most dangerous prisons.
The blind guy with a frail body was busy eating a big piece of meat, making the others feel hungry, as they wondered how he got it inside.
"Rich, it is me, did you forget we met back in the Blue Kingdom? I am Jin Woo but here I am disguised." Vritra said, taking off a big bite from the large piece of meat and enjoying it.
All the other prisoners in their cells had a few of their bones broken and wounds all over their bodies, which is why they weren’t attacking the new group for the second time.
They were all beaten by Vritra after they tried to intimidate the four of them and steal his food; they even tried touching Rich who had a feminine body.
"JIN WOO?!! How can this be you? Are you actually blind and so weak, or is it all just a disguise?" Rich asked in shock, it should be impossible to fool so many people.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +19}
The nineteen other prisoners kept looking at Vritra fearfully; they sat in the corner while hugging their bodies.
"Yeah, it’s just a disguise, anyway, how have you been? It’s been a while since we last met." Vritra asked, his eyes were covered by a strip of black cloth.
"I was fine before meeting you guys, but how did you end up here? How did I end up here? I- I can’t understand anything."
Rich looked distraught, wondering how the three of them were not worried about their situation.
Anyone who enters this prison would be killed after a period of torture; it is considered the worst kind of prison, all three continents combined.
"Oh that—" Vritra was about to speak when Onest interrupted.
"It’s all because of this shitty fraud monk, why would you press a shady looking button in the middle of nowhere?" he shouted in frustration.
"Wouldn’t it be stranger not to press that button? I had to know what it was there for. And if you hadn’t stolen the—" Monk Shitless retorted, but Vritra stopped them from fighting further.
"Let me explain everything from the beginning, so—" Vritra was about to start but...
BANG BANG
A prison guard hit the door of the cell and shouted: "Be ready, the four of you will be brought to the emperor soon for judgement, haha I wish I could get to see that burning punishment again."
Onest felt shivers, while Monk Shitless was just excited. Rich wasn’t all that worried since after he meets with the emperor he would be able to leave easily.
But the news of it will give his parents and sister a way to make fun of him.
"Cough, so let me start how it all began, after we left the White kingdom..." and so Vritra pulled Rich and other inmates into the flashbacks, they all listened with great interest.
"YOU BITCH—" before Vritra could finish, his entire body was swallowed by a thick red fluid, covering him completely.
The sky of the small realm suddenly turned red, the size of the cocoon forming around Vritra growing rapidly until it had stretched to nearly a kilometre.
Yasmine flew back and observed it all in surprise, she pushed the matter of the announcement aside for the time being.
"What kind of physique is this going to be? Even the demonic God Physique didn’t have this type of dramatic changes..."
She floated around in the air, her eyes focused on the enormous cocoon that had completely changed the atmosphere inside the realm.
Even Yasmine could feel the oppressive pressure in the air, and she could say for sure that it was several times heavier than the pressure she felt when she was attacked by the demon god’s energy.
But this was just the beginning...
Vritra had already fallen into a strange unconscious state inside the large cocoon whose insides were filled with an energy so thick that it had solidified.
Slowly, it began to break apart his skin, flesh, bones, organs, every single part of him. If he was conscious then Vritra just might have experienced the worst pain of his life.

The energy began to recreate every single cell of his body, his life teetering close to extreme danger as messages from the Mutamorphis kept flashing, but even his sugar mommy couldn’t do anything in such a situation except letting the change continue on.
Minutes after minutes passed, which soon changed into hours, and nearly a day has passed and during this time Vritra’s body was constantly being disintegrated and reformed again and again.
Yasmine couldn’t see exactly what was happening inside that cocoon, but the extent was just unbelievable, the space cracked and the realm was on the verge of breaking.
Outside that realm, Vanessa, Fiona and Diana were shocked when they saw the announcement, they had just broken into the 2nd Legion rank.
When they were about to use the next legion stone to level up into the 3rd Legion rank, the announcement rang out and the three of them sighed collectively.
Just as they had expected, Vritra had caused trouble outside again but the extent was infinitely more dangerous.
"...Yeah, let’s finish packing up first, and level up quickly. We will be leaving the White kingdom soon, haa honey, what did you do this time?" Vanessa muttered, tapping on her forehead.
The three quickly finished their packing up and then used the empty 3rd Legion rank stone hurriedly.
Inside the small realm, after the long process ended that seemed to have gone on for months inside the cocoon, it finally began to crack.
The realm barely survived the disaster, outside only a day has passed but Vritra felt he had been inside the cocoon for nearly a year, sleeping and dreaming.
A blinding red light flashed, and finally he appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: So Rich
paragraphs: Yasmine waited in anticipation as the enormous cocoon soon broke, leaving behind a large area completely in tatters.
Cracks were present in the space, and an extremely large crater in the ground.
As his body came into view, he was still covered by a thin red layer that broke apart, and from inside, Vritra’s body came into view, floating midair.
There was little change to his appearance, looking almost the same as he was before.
His eyes slowly opened and Vritra looked down at himself, before taking out a new set of clothes from the inventory and putting them on.
"Hubby, are you okay?" Yasmine asked, finally flying close to him.
"...Yes." He answered and felt an incomparable power coursing through his body. It was hard to describe, but his strength had certainly grown.
"I wonder what the strongest physique and bloodline have given me..." he muttered. After pondering for a few seconds, he looked at Yasmine and added:
"We can’t waste time here, let’s go. That damned Divine even announced our current location."
The two quickly made their way out of the small realm inside the dimensional book, appearing in the sky above the castle.
And as expected, the entire capital was in a commotion after that announcement. His face could still be seen in the sky even after so many hours.
"..." Vritra cursed internally and flew towards the castle, entering his room directly.
The three ladies were already prepared to leave, so he went to meet Chopper directly.
Chopper was in his room when he too heard the loud announcement and saw a face he was all too familiar with.
The king was just coming to meet them as the two sides met midway.
"So you are Vritra?" Chopper asked, now feeling that Vritra was more special than he had expected.
"Yeah, anyway, we can’t waste time. How do I get out of this continent?" Vritra got straight to the point.

"Oh... haa, there is a portal that can bring you all outside. If you want, I can send you, but the receiving portal is a bit away from the Quartz continent so you would have to travel on foot." Chopper said.

If the people from that continent want to come to the Topaz continent, then they could just teleport here directly, but they set the receiving portal quite far away to make it extremely difficult for the people here to travel there.
"Alright, do you have a map or something—" Vritra was just speaking when a voice sounded in his mind.
"Don’t worry about that. Outside of this place, I know most of the terrain so we don’t need a map," Yasmine said.

"Come with me." He gestured and began to lead them to the back of the castle.

"Shitless and Onest..." Vritra muttered, nodding towards the two.
"Are you leaving? Can I travel along with you? Going there on my own will take too long," Monk Shitless asked, a pleading look on his face.
"Yes and yes, there is no problem, right?" Vritra answered and then looked at Chopper.
"M- Me too," Onest added hastily.
"Huh, why would you want to go out?" Vritra asked, eyeing the map in curiosity.
"I want to widen my horizons and steal in a bigger plane, make a name for myself and then marry the—" Onest began to answer but was interrupted by Chopper.

"Thank you..." he said to the king, before Chopper moved to give instructions in haste.
There were a lot of people who worked there or just guarded it. After making all the necessary preparations, he nodded towards the group and stood with his hands behind his back.
"It is a way to reduce the resources, controlling their strength, and locking them here by not allowing the people here to directly teleport to the Quartz continent.
But don’t worry, we will be there after a few days of travel if nothing goes wrong, sigh..." Yasmine said.
The glyphs and patterns on the ground lit up, strange light traveling on the glass, swirling around rapidly as a massive amount of energy was sucked dry within a moment.
And in just a few moments, a blinding light completely covered the circle area, leaving behind a loud sound of air blasting around.
"What a strange lad, I hope he can survive." Chopper said. He knew that he might put himself in danger for helping Vritra but he wasn’t really afraid of death anymore.

"Who are you and what is your purpose for coming here?" one of the men shouted.
Vritra quickly came to his senses, but his body had already transformed into someone he had met some time ago.
He even transformed the others with the misty essence for now. When the light disappeared, a boy, five women, and a bull came into view.
"I am Rich." While speaking, Vritra pulled out an emblem that he had obtained from the real Rich.
"O- Oh, we didn’t know you were coming, please forgive us, sir." The guards instantly lowered their weapons and bowed.
’As I expected, the identity of that Rich guy wasn’t simple.’ Vritra thought. The guys were wearing heavy armor and seemed to be special guards from the Quartz continent.
{Sin Point Gained: Respected +17}
{Sin Point Gained: Suspected +5}
Thankfully, Vritra had a way to know exactly what was going on through their minds, and he could act accordingly.
He didn’t want to leave behind suspects; even if he killed them all now, it would just confirm his location so he wanted to avoid that as much as possible.
"These are the slaves I had rescued from the White Kingdom. I saw talent in them and I am bringing them to join my family." Vritra added with a smile, his tone soft.
"Oh, just as we had heard about you, kind and magnanimous. But sir, would it be okay if I send this news back to—" the head guard spoke in a respectful tone, though he was clearly suspicious.
"Sure, you definitely should." Vritra said, walking out of the circle, then he pulled out a storage glyph and seemed to be rummaging through it.
First, he pulled out the emblem of the Golden Moon, then put it back. After not being able to find something, he began to throw the stuff inside the glyph on the ground.
A bright light made all the guards’ vision go blind for a few moments as an enormous amount of gold and other valuable things were presented.
It was at least ten times the treasury of the White Kingdom, and Vritra seemed to have an endless supply.
"S- So rich..." the guards were just shocked; none of them could see through the illusion.
As Vritra continued to pour his wealth across the ground, the sin point messages changed continuously and soon there wasn’t a single soul who still doubted him.

’Who could be so rich other than the richest man alive, Mr. Rich!! He is definitely the real deal, sigh thankfully he is quite kind in nature, but if his family were to know that we stopped them then not even the emperor could save us.’
The head guard thought, wiping his forehead, the wealth was overflowing across the entire town.
What better way to prove he is Rich than by showing his richness.
"S- Sir, we understand, I will get the car ready for you immediately." The guards began to run around hurriedly, no one anymore doubting that he could be a fake.
Vritra nodded and put away all his wealth. He wondered what sort of car he would get to see here.
It wasn’t long before a car was arranged for them. It still couldn’t match the technology of the earth but the car was a lot more advanced than the ones in the White kingdom.
It was a big white car that looked like a cubical Tesla. After getting inside, Vritra of course took the driver’s seat and refused to let any of the guards accompany them.
Yasmine gave him a few instructions and he easily learned to drive.
"Sir, be careful when crossing over the bridge, there are many dangers across the cliff." The guard warned but didn’t explain; after all, Rich must already be aware of it all.

chapters.title: Chapter 358: The Button
paragraphs: The guards waved their hands as they watched the car drive away, then one of the guards scratched his head and asked:
"Captain, if he really was Rich then why didn’t he directly teleport into the continent?"
The leader of the guards shook his head, patted the guard’s shoulder before saying with a sigh, "Poor people like you can’t understand what goes through the mind of rich people like us."
The car was going through the path in the forest, seven people were sitting inside, humming to the rhythm of the music that Vritra had created through the misty essence.
Unlike their expectation, it was a rather enjoyable ride.
Vritra was driving, Monk Shitless sat beside him, the three women sat behind them, and Onest sat on the back seat which was meant for luggage.
The weather was sunny, sunlight was peeking through the dense trees, faint sounds of beasts and insects could be heard.
"Haa, such fresh air..." Onest moved his head out of the window and took a deep breath, but then warm droplets fell onto his face, making him wonder if it was raining.
"Huh, what is this smell..." As more of the drops fell onto his face, he opened his eyes and looked up but there was no rain.
Then he looked to the front and saw that Monk Shitless was also leaning out of the window and vomiting nonstop.
"!!!" For a moment Onest was frozen, then disgust crept into every single cell as he shouted and began to wash himself.
"You damned monk, what the hell are you doing?"
"Can I drive it?" As Monk Shitless’s motion sickness got better, he spoke excitedly, gazing at the vehicle excitedly.
"No, I don’t want the car to explode." Vritra rejected. Driving the car was rather easy; he just needed to control the steering wheel, accelerator, and brake.
They drove for a few hours and then took a break to eat. Thankfully they had enough fresh food stored, so they didn’t have to worry.
"Can I drive this time?" Monk Shitless asked, with a pleading look. His Bullo was tied above the car; the heavy bull was sleeping peacefully.
"Nope." Vritra answered as they got back into the car and were ready to continue with their ride.
By the time it was evening, and the forest seemed especially dark, the howls of the beasts had gone quiet.
Zrrrrrrr...
The sound that the car was producing had become quite clear now; the insects buzzed with a faint sound.
As the group of seven got close to the cliff, the car came to a halt. Vritra got out of the car and saw that the cliff was too steep and wide, while the bridge was broken.

So to cross along with the car they would have to fly to the other side. Vritra returned to the car and spoke: "The bridge ahead is broken so hold tight, I will be bringing the car to the other side."
"Wait, let me make the jump!! If we travel at full speed and go along the slope, then the car can make the jump." Monk Shitless said excitedly.
"No, there is no need to take the risk." Vritra again refused and ignoring the monk, he just flew to the other side, bringing the car along.
The guards had warned them to be careful ahead of this bridge, so as he put the car down, Vritra scanned his surroundings.
Thankfully there wasn’t anything around.
"Pitiful one, please sob please just let me drive for once, I promise I will be careful. I- If I cause any trouble then Your sword, Onest’s neck, he will be ready for any punishment."
Monk Shitless said, putting his hands together pitifully.
"You crooked monk, why are you dragging me into this?" Onest shouted from behind.
"Sigh, fine, just for ten minutes." Vritra finally gave in to his demand.
And so everyone sat cautiously in their seats as the crazy monk began to drive, shooting the car forward at full speed.
Inside the forest, a long distance away from the car in which Vritra and the group were traveling.
In a bright spacious cave, thousands of demons could be seen. On the throne at the front of the cave, a demon wearing a black outfit sat as he stared at his army with the single eye on his face.
In front of the army of thousands, two demons stronger than the rest stood, kneeling in front of the demon general.
This demon general’s strength was comparable to the three demon generals that Vritra had met previously, Thaddeus and the others.
After a few minutes he spoke, looking at his two stupid but useful underlings, who were both in the fifth legion ranks.
"How is the preparation for the city humans built going on?"
"General, as you had instructed, we had finished our job." One of the two demons answered, his body looked quite similar to a large bat, with big wings on his back.
"Good, I knew you could be idiotic but you always get the job done." The one-eyed demon general praised, his wide lips stretching almost to the back of his head.
"General, with just one press of the button, we will make humans understand the terror of us demons once again."
The other underling added, a big grin on his face, his body was also like a bat but a rather fat one.
"Hahaha That bastard Sirius dared to challenge me, now I am going to show him what exactly I am capable of." After a good hard laugh, the demon general took out a communication glyph and asked:
"Is it time?"
Then a reply came from the other side: "No General, they are still celebrating, wait for ten more minutes. I will give the signal when it will be time."
"Good, keep an eye on them." The one-eyed demon said before putting away the glyph and extending his right hand towards one of the underlings and asked:
"I will give you a huge reward soon, now give me the button."
"Keke thank you general, here is the button—" the tall underling put his hand into pockets but then froze. He checked all his pockets and, clearing his throat, he said.
"F- Fratty, I gave you the button right? Give it to the general."
"..." the demon general maintained the same smile and now pointed his hand towards Fratty.

"Ah right, you gave it to me, Trall." Fratty nodded and put his hand into his pocket, only to freeze a moment later, then he nervously checked all his pockets and spoke with a look of shock on his face.
"O- Oh right, we set up the button in the forest, exactly at the place where the human general Sirius smashed your face into the ground.
W- We wanted to give you a surprise but forgot to inform you about it." Fratty said, the fat on his body jiggling in fear.
"What?!!" One-eyed demon stood over his single leg, glaring at the two in rage.
"You left that button in the middle of the forest with no one around and you just forgot to mention it?!!" The general could barely balance his body on the single leg as he felt his blood boil.

chapters.title: Chapter 359: Culprits
paragraphs: "S- Sorry, please cut off our legs and take out our eyes, we deserve to look the worst just like you general, we deserve the worst possible punishment."
The two instantly knelt down on the ground, smashing their heads against the ground.
The more he listened to them the angrier the general became; taking a deep breath he shouted:
"Let’s go to that location before someone discovers the button, and you will get your punishment very soon."
BANG
Monk Shitless smashed the car into one of the trees at full speed. Vritra was busy chatting with Yasmine at that moment and couldn’t react in time.
"Ughh S- Sorry pitiful one, as I had promised, since I messed up, so you can cut Onest’s head off, I won’t struggle at all." Monk Shitless said with a look of remorse on his face.
"You fuckerrrr!!"
Onest shouted from behind; a tree had even plunged into the back of the car from somewhere and almost tore off the small pouch that carried his family jewels, just barely.
"Sigh I knew this was gonna happen." Vritra sighed and looked outside; the sky was slightly darker now, and they would have to walk or fly now.
But Vritra was sure if they actually flew then before reaching their destination they would attract too much dangerous attention to themselves.
"Well I can sense a city or something not too far away from here, so let’s just go there." They got out of the car and stretched; the ride was quite fun as long as it lasted.
"..." Monk Shitless was secretly happy since he didn’t get any sort of punishment.
As they began to walk ahead, Vritra looked to the side and spoke:
"Shitless, you will be carrying all the luggage that your Bullo is carrying and walk along with us, that will be your punishment."
Monk Shitless showed a pitiful expression but received no kindness, so he took the luggage from Bullo’s back and began to drag his body forward.
They had just walked a kilometre or so when the group collectively saw something strange in the middle of the forest.
There was a small hole in the ground in which a single eye, nose, and a wide mouth could be seen, almost as if a face had been smashed into the ground.
And right beside that hole, a heavy small stone table could be seen and on top of that table a single button was embedded.
"Now what is this?" Yasmine muttered, it was hard to guess since whatever it activated was quite far away from there.
"Well whatever it might be, let’s keep on going." Vritra said, knowing how bad his luck is; he didn’t want to take any chances.
The others nodded as well, maintaining their distance from the stone table.
They had just taken ten or so steps when they heard Monk Shitless’s tired but excited voice from behind.
"Whoa, what’s a table doing here, and what is this?" Without a single thought his hand moved, pressing his finger against the button as he pushed it down hurriedly.
"Noo—" Vritra tried to stop the monk but for the second time he was a bit late, by the time he appeared beside the monk, the button was already pressed.
In the next moment, sounds of countless explosions rang out from the distance and it was as if the entire forest had brightened up.
BOOOM! WHOOSH!
BOOOOOOM!
BANNGGGG!
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!

Vritra and the others stared at the sky, and this actually looked pretty.
"I wonder which kind soul would be so thoughtful to do this for random passersby, hehe let’s do this again." He pressed again but no more explosions sounded.
"I guess it could only be used once, let’s continue then."
Again they continued to walk.
On their path, the group encountered a few beasts that they killed easily and after walking for two hours, they finally found somewhere they could spend their night.
"Huh, why are all the people here living in tents? Is it some sort of tribal area?" Diana muttered, the atmosphere in the place seemed rather tense.
Approaching the people, Vritra explained their problem and since it was getting quite late, they just went to sleep.
Vritra had gotten a tent in which he slept on a bed along with his mother, Diana and Fiona.
Although the people here seemed poor, with burnt clothes and such shabby houses, they were kind.
"Mmm, good morning honey." Vanessa said; she gave a peck on his lips before getting out of the bed.
"Good morning darling." Fiona did the same, giving a kiss on his lips before getting up.
"Good morning master~" Diana said, although there was no need to but she just enjoyed calling him that a bit too much.
"Good morning..." Vritra replied sleepily, rubbing his eyes.
But then he heard loud shouts from outside and sat up; the noises were so loud that all his sleep disappeared.
"What happened here now?" Getting off the bed, he walked out of the tent and saw that just like the last night another commotion was going on.
Vritra stopped one of the enraged men and asked: "What happened here? Is there a problem?"
The man explained a few things, giving Vritra some useful info like:
All these people were from one of the cities outside the Quartz continent but in a recent attack from the one-eyed demon general their city was completely destroyed.
But thankfully the general Sirius came in time and beat up the demon pretty badly.
He was kind enough to promise the rebuilding of the entire city, so they had been living in the tents while the city was being built even better than before.
This morning, someone stole something very precious that belonged to their city and was kept in the house of the city chief.
"Oh, that’s so infuriating, once you catch the thief make sure you cut off his limbs and burn him to death."
Vritra said, but the poor man still had many things that the people of their city had suffered through.
More and more people gathered around Vritra and his group as they began to tell their stories, sharing their misery.
The city had been built completely, and they were celebrating the wonderful event but before they could even set foot in their new city, those damned demons made the entire place explode.
It was such a big explosion that not a single house was left intact.
They had lost their houses and the city for the second time, and this morning they just lost one of the most valuable treasures of their city.
Without it, they weren’t sure if the rich folks from the continent would even allow them to live near the continent.
"O- Oh, that sounds terrible, I hope you kill the culprits."
Vritra said, while he could tell that something was wrong with the entire situation and that they should leave the place as soon as possible.
Thankfully he was still in the form of Rich, so he didn’t had to worry as much.

sentences.text: "S- Sorry, please cut off our legs and take out our eyes, we deserve to look the worst just like you general, we deserve the worst possible punishment."
The two instantly knelt down on the ground, smashing their heads against the ground.

"Let’s go to that location before someone discovers the button, and you will get your punishment very soon."
BANG

Vritra was busy chatting with Yasmine at that moment and couldn’t react in time.
"Ughh S- Sorry pitiful one, as I had promised, since I messed up, so you can cut Onest’s head off, I won’t struggle at all." Monk Shitless said with a look of remorse on his face.
"You fuckerrrr!!"
Onest shouted from behind; a tree had even plunged into the back of the car from somewhere and almost tore off the small pouch that carried his family jewels, just barely.
"Sigh I knew this was gonna happen." Vritra sighed and looked outside; the sky was slightly darker now, and they would have to walk or fly now.
But Vritra was sure if they actually flew then before reaching their destination they would attract too much dangerous attention to themselves.
"Well I can sense a city or something not too far away from here, so let’s just go there." They got out of the car and stretched; the ride was quite fun as long as it lasted.

As they began to walk ahead, Vritra looked to the side and spoke:
"Shitless, you will be carrying all the luggage that your Bullo is carrying and walk along with us, that will be your punishment."

"Now what is this?" Yasmine muttered, it was hard to guess since whatever it activated was quite far away from there.
"Well whatever it might be, let’s keep on going." Vritra said, knowing how bad his luck is; he didn’t want to take any chances.
The others nodded as well, maintaining their distance from the stone table.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: The Wanted Guests
paragraphs: "Well, you have been so kind to us, letting us stay here overnight. I am really thankful for your hospitality, but now I will be taking my leave," Vritra said, as his eyes scanned the surroundings.
He soon saw Onest whistling on the side.

"Oh, forgive me, but General Sirius has just arrived here and has ordered that no one can leave the place. I know that you know nothing of this all, but you can’t leave yet," the man said respectfully.
Vritra: "..."
Vritra, Fiona, Vanessa, Diana, Onest, and Monk Shitless seated on his bull all looked at one another, trying to find a way out of there.
He was just about to use the dimensional book and the misty essence at the same time when a man came running, shouting:
"I have found it!! We have got the criminals. Knowing of the wretched demon’s behavior, we had made our preparations."

"Now we can find exactly who was the one to steal the treasure. As for that explosion, it was most probably done by that one-legged demon, so General Sirius has already gone to catch him," he added, before displaying a light-blue glyph.
Without wasting a moment, he inserted some mana as two displays appeared in the air, clear enough for everyone to see.
’Uh oh, time to make a run.’ Vritra scanned his surroundings and soon saw a couple of cars parked not too far away; they were exactly the same as the one they had crashed.
Vritra left behind an illusion of himself before entering the disappearing state, then he gave his instructions to everyone else.
All the people looked at the two screens.
On the left one, there was a box resting safely under the bed of a man. And in the second image, a stone table with a button on top of it was present in the middle of the forest.
Onest walked into the room carefully, then without making a single sound he pulled out the box from under the bed. Patting himself, he left.
"..." Hundreds of hostile gazes instantly focused on Onest, ready to attack him, but then they noticed something on the other screen.
Vritra’s group walked near the table, and the monk actually pressed the button.
The large crowd looked towards Vritra and the group then at the screen then back at him in pin drop silence, as the wind breezed past them.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +296}
{Sin Point Gained: Suspected +296}
{Sin Point Gained: Trust Shattered +296}
"So it was you!!" All the people were baffled and furious—their guests were the ones who had blasted their houses and stolen their treasure.
"We don’t know these two, they just happened to walk along with us." Vritra’s image stepped away from them, joining the others with hostile gazes.
"Catch them all! We will give them to General Sirius. That baldy bastard almost killed all of us!" The shouts rang out from all around as they charged toward them.
"Oh! Keke, catch me if you can." Monk Shitless laughed before patting Bullo to run.
Finally, the group ran. Vritra was already inside one of the cars; he turned it on and drove close to them.
"Hurry inside." Vritra decreased the speed as they all climbed into the car before they ran away at full speed.
He had countless ways to escape, but Vritra just loved the thrill of a car chase. Glancing back, he saw that many of the men had started to fly and chase after them.
"Forbid: forward is backward."
[Forbidden activated.]

Instantly, aside from the car and the people inside, all the others were affected. When they tried to fly forward, their bodies moved backward on their own, and they were completely disoriented for a while.
That was enough for Vritra to create a big gap.
"Now, take the first right, then third left, and continue straight afterwards," Yasmine said, enjoying it all.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Vritra made sure that no one was following them. Monk Shitless was seated on top of the car along with Bullo.
The people back in the broken city sent messages to General Sirius, who was just about to beat the one-eyed demon general.
Sirius gave up on killing the demon general and at full speed flew back, regretting he didn’t check the culprit before jumping to conclusions.
"Whoever it might be, I will bring them to justice," he muttered, eyes filled with everlasting flames. He prioritized justice above all else.
A kind man who would let a hundred villains escape just to protect one innocent man.
He was kind enough to put the budget to rebuild the entire city outside the continent from his own pocket.
Since no one inside the Quartz Continent really cared for the lives of these people, though it burnt a hole in his pocket, he was happy—and yet all of it was lost because of those wretched people.
"Damn it, my money... those poor people are homeless again." He increased his speed to the max.
Vritra was driving the car in a relaxed manner. He still had quite a bit of sin points left, so he decided to invest some of them in the new Field Palette he had obtained.
But the moment he opened the status window, he discovered something really strange.
Stats:
Endurance: 202,032 (+1,000) (LOCKED)
Intelligence: 268,951 (+1,000)
Luck: 512
[Allocation points: 0]
’Huh? Why does my Endurance stat appear locked?’ Vritra was quite surprised and didn’t know if it was a good or a bad change.

"I think it must be because of the new Divine Physique you obtained, but I wonder what it means. I hope it doesn’t mean that you can’t ever upgrade your Endurance in the future," Yasmine said. She couldn’t really be too shocked in matters involving her husband.
’Sigh, I will check it out later, but first let’s buy the Palette Droplets.’ Vritra then glanced at the sin points he currently possessed.
{Sin Points: 88,683,021}

’Hmm... so I can get a total of forty-four Palette Droplets.’ Vritra calculated and decided to spend all his sin points on buying those droplets; he wasn’t in any urgent need of these sin points after all.
And he could just earn a lot more in this new continent. After all, he had several things planned.
Vritra spent all his sin points and bought the droplets.
{Sin Points: 683,021}
{Palette Droplet: 44}
Then he glanced at all his Fields and wondered where he should put these droplets. He decided not to put them all in a single field.

"Comprehending the Fields not only makes your control over that ability or element strong but also gives you a vast amount of... knowledge, so it would be better not to put all droplets at once," Yasmine warned. She really wanted to come out and sit with him, but there were outsiders there, so it wasn’t safe.
’Okay, as always, thank you, wifey,’ Vritra said in a soft tone, before bringing his focus back to the status panel.

’Dust Manipulation is still my main ability, so it will undoubtedly get half the points. As for the rest...’ After looking over them all, he quickly selected the two Fields he planned to invest in first.
Without wasting a moment and after scanning the surroundings, Vritra put his body on autopilot and focused his attention on his Fields.
{Elegy Parasite Activated.}

chapters.title: Chapter 361: Invincible?
paragraphs: {Elegy Parasite Activated.}
Instantly, a larva-shaped large tattoo appeared on Vritra’s back, and tiny thread-like lines stretched all over his body.
His body went on autopilot as he drove automatically. This skill had become quite nice after the upgrade.
’Now, let’s work on my Fields.’
{Palette Droplet: 44}
After making up his mind, Vritra decided to invest twenty-four droplets into Dust Manipulation.
One by one, he began to use the droplets, relaxing his mind completely.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 4%}
Instantly, just as Yasmine had told him, a large amount of information flooded into his brain.
It was as if he was understanding this ability better, his bond with the dust becoming stronger.
Invisible to the eyes, dust particles began to swirl around his body, though it was too faint to be noticed.
Comprehending wasn’t just obtaining more knowledge; he was connecting with the ability slightly better now.
Just increasing that percentage would increase the strength of the ability and give many more benefits.
Nearly five minutes had passed when Vritra returned to his senses.
Though faint, he could sense a slight change in the environment around him.
’This is... nice.’ The comprehension was still too low to notice any big changes, so Vritra began to spend one droplet after another.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 5%}
{Dust Manipulation: 6%}
{Dust Manipulation: 7%}
{Dust Manipulation: 10%}
The higher the comprehension went, the more obvious the changes became.
Though it might not be as obvious to other people, as they need a lot of time to raise their understanding of their field, Vritra was different.
’I can already feel that Dust Manipulation has grown tremendously. I would need to spend a quarter of the energy to launch an attack twice as powerful as before.’
Vritra was quite excited, but before he could use the next droplet, he sensed a figure rushing in their direction rapidly.
He deactivated the Elegy Parasite, and his consciousness returned to his body.
’If I am not wrong, it must be that General Sirius who is following us. Just the perfect moment to test a few things.’
Even though he was facing a general who was a lot stronger than him, he wasn’t really afraid.
Vritra looked back and saw that Fiona had fallen asleep with her head resting over Vanessa’s shoulder.
Diana had her eyes closed, and her body was glowing with a faint light.
She was also comprehending her Field, and her speed was quite fast. She also had many cheats because of being a goddess.
His mother seemed deep in thought.
Without disturbing them, he sent the entire car into his dimensional book and flew up into the air.
"Wifey, what is the strength of this general? Is he stronger than the three demon generals?" Vritra questioned, as he waited for the human general.
"Hmm, I would say they are quite similar in strength, but Thaddeus has a higher chance of defeating him. As for Silquor and Morvik, it’s fifty-fifty," Yasmine answered.
Vritra wondered why she wouldn’t just mention their levels.
But he decided to ask this later.
"Then everything should be fine. It is better to have backups." Vritra was still in Rich’s appearance; after all, it was quite useful to fool anyone.
After a short wait, the enraged figure of a middle-aged man finally came into view. He was dressed in a blue outfit, carrying himself with an air of pride.
Stopping in front of Vritra, he instantly recognized Rich as one of the people he had seen in that recording, one of those heinous criminals.
"You!! You are not Rich, right? Are you a demon or working for those evil organizations? Tell me, where are the other people that were with you?" Sirius asked.
By just the fact that he hadn’t immediately attacked him, Vritra had understood quite a bit about his personality, so he relaxed further.
"What do you mean? Of course, I am Rich," Vritra said, folding his arms in front of his chest.
"I am giving you one last chance. Tell me who you are and where the others are, and I won’t hurt you," Sirius said, as dense energy began to gather in his body.
"Heh, you are not going to get anything out of me. Try whatever you want," Vritra provoked.
"..." Sirius became even more enraged. He was sure that Vritra was just buying time for the others to escape.
Angered at so much of his money getting wasted and those people almost dying, he finally attacked.
Of course, Sirius didn’t use his full strength, but even so, Vritra wasn’t able to follow his movement.
The general’s body just disappeared as he flashed in front of Vritra and punched with enough strength to bring Vritra’s health down to twenty percent.
Vritra barely had time to place his arms in front of his chest as the heavy, terrifying punch landed on his body.
BOOOOM
His body was blasted back with a sonic boom, smashing into the ground and creating a crater, breaking all the surrounding trees.
Dust flew all around as Vritra’s figure disappeared into the deep pit.
"Haa, I let out too much power because of my strength. I hope he isn’t dead," Sirius muttered, and with a wave of his hand, the dust settled.
Vritra lay in the pit, staring at the sky in disbelief. A punch of that level could have easily made him unconscious for a while and badly injured him, but now...
’There is no pain, not even a mark aside from my clothes getting damaged,’ he thought in shock and joy. For the first time, his luck had truly worked for the better.
’Then, haven’t I become almost invincible? How difficult would it actually be for even demon lords to kill me?’ Vritra flew out of the pit. Aside from his disheveled state, he seemed completely fine.
"Whoa, hubby, that’s awesome," Yasmine said excitedly.
Not a drop of blood, no bone broken, not even a tiny wound.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
Sirius stared at Vritra in disbelief. He couldn’t believe such a powerful attack wouldn’t do anything to him when there is clearly a big difference in their strength.
"H-How...?" Sirius muttered.
"General Sirius, it is really me, Rich. I did hear someone was trying to impersonate me, and that’s exactly why I came here. See this if you don’t believe me."
After speaking, he pulled out the emblem he got from Rich.
"How do you think I could survive such a powerful attack if not for the strong armor from my family?" he added.
Sirius finally let his guard down. No wonder he was able to survive such an attack, and the emblem was certainly genuine.
"Oh, forgive me, I mistook you for those imbeciles. This is the first time we are meeting; let me introduce myself properly."
Vritra flew closer to him while dusting off his clothes.
The two shook hands. Sirius looked at Vritra with a friendly smile and began to introduce himself.
"I am the general, Sirius Gem. As an apology, why don’t you—"
But at that moment, Vritra’s smile twisted, and after pulling his leg back, he swung it with full force, hitting the general’s weakest area.
BAANNNNGGGGGGG

One by one, he began to use the droplets, relaxing his mind completely.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 4%}
Instantly, just as Yasmine had told him, a large amount of information flooded into his brain.
It was as if he was understanding this ability better, his bond with the dust becoming stronger.
Invisible to the eyes, dust particles began to swirl around his body, though it was too faint to be noticed.
Comprehending wasn’t just obtaining more knowledge; he was connecting with the ability slightly better now.
Just increasing that percentage would increase the strength of the ability and give many more benefits.
Nearly five minutes had passed when Vritra returned to his senses.
Though faint, he could sense a slight change in the environment around him.
’This is... nice.’ The comprehension was still too low to notice any big changes, so Vritra began to spend one droplet after another.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 5%}
{Dust Manipulation: 6%}
{Dust Manipulation: 7%}
{Dust Manipulation: 10%}
The higher the comprehension went, the more obvious the changes became.
Though it might not be as obvious to other people, as they need a lot of time to raise their understanding of their field, Vritra was different.
’I can already feel that Dust Manipulation has grown tremendously.
I would need to spend a quarter of the energy to launch an attack twice as powerful as before.’
Vritra was quite excited, but before he could use the next droplet, he sensed a figure rushing in their direction rapidly.
He deactivated the Elegy Parasite, and his consciousness returned to his body.
’If I am not wrong, it must be that General Sirius who is following us.
Just the perfect moment to test a few things.’
Even though he was facing a general who was a lot stronger than him, he wasn’t really afraid.
Vritra looked back and saw that Fiona had fallen asleep with her head resting over Vanessa’s shoulder.
Diana had her eyes closed, and her body was glowing with a faint light.
She was also comprehending her Field, and her speed was quite fast.
She also had many cheats because of being a goddess.
His mother seemed deep in thought.
Without disturbing them, he sent the entire car into his dimensional book and flew up into the air.
"Wifey, what is the strength of this general?
Is he stronger than the three demon generals?" Vritra questioned, as he waited for the human general.
"Hmm, I would say they are quite similar in strength, but Thaddeus has a higher chance of defeating him.
As for Silquor and Morvik, it’s fifty-fifty," Yasmine answered.
Vritra wondered why she wouldn’t just mention their levels.
But he decided to ask this later.
"Then everything should be fine.
It is better to have backups." Vritra was still in Rich’s appearance; after all, it was quite useful to fool anyone.
After a short wait, the enraged figure of a middle-aged man finally came into view.
He was dressed in a blue outfit, carrying himself with an air of pride.
Stopping in front of Vritra, he instantly recognized Rich as one of the people he had seen in that recording, one of those heinous criminals.
"You!!
You are not Rich, right?
Are you a demon or working for those evil organizations?
Tell me, where are the other people that were with you?" Sirius asked.
By just the fact that he hadn’t immediately attacked him, Vritra had understood quite a bit about his personality, so he relaxed further.
"What do you mean?
Of course, I am Rich," Vritra said, folding his arms in front of his chest.
"I am giving you one last chance.
Tell me who you are and where the others are, and I won’t hurt you," Sirius said, as dense energy began to gather in his body.
"Heh, you are not going to get anything out of me.
Try whatever you want," Vritra provoked.
"..." Sirius became even more enraged.
He was sure that Vritra was just buying time for the others to escape.
Angered at so much of his money getting wasted and those people almost dying, he finally attacked.
Of course, Sirius didn’t use his full strength, but even so, Vritra wasn’t able to follow his movement.
The general’s body just disappeared as he flashed in front of Vritra and punched with enough strength to bring Vritra’s health down to twenty percent.
Vritra barely had time to place his arms in front of his chest as the heavy, terrifying punch landed on his body.
BOOOOM
His body was blasted back with a sonic boom, smashing into the ground and creating a crater, breaking all the surrounding trees.
Dust flew all around as Vritra’s figure disappeared into the deep pit.
"Haa, I let out too much power because of my strength.
I hope he isn’t dead," Sirius muttered, and with a wave of his hand, the dust settled.
Vritra lay in the pit, staring at the sky in disbelief.
A punch of that level could have easily made him unconscious for a while and badly injured him, but now...
’There is no pain, not even a mark aside from my clothes getting damaged,’ he thought in shock and joy.
For the first time, his luck had truly worked for the better.
’Then, haven’t I become almost invincible?
How difficult would it actually be for even demon lords to kill me?’ Vritra flew out of the pit.
Aside from his disheveled state, he seemed completely fine.
"Whoa, hubby, that’s awesome," Yasmine said excitedly.
Not a drop of blood, no bone broken, not even a tiny wound.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
Sirius stared at Vritra in disbelief.
He couldn’t believe such a powerful attack wouldn’t do anything to him when there is clearly a big difference in their strength.
"H-How...?" Sirius muttered.
"General Sirius, it is really me, Rich.
I did hear someone was trying to impersonate me, and that’s exactly why I came here.
See this if you don’t believe me."
After speaking, he pulled out the emblem he got from Rich.
"How do you think I could survive such a powerful attack if not for the strong armor from my family?" he added.
Sirius finally let his guard down.
No wonder he was able to survive such an attack, and the emblem was certainly genuine.
"Oh, forgive me, I mistook you for those imbeciles.
This is the first time we are meeting; let me introduce myself properly."
Vritra flew closer to him while dusting off his clothes.
The two shook hands.
Sirius looked at Vritra with a friendly smile and began to introduce himself.
"I am the general, Sirius Gem.
As an apology, why don’t you—"
But at that moment, Vritra’s smile twisted, and after pulling his leg back, he swung it with full force, hitting the general’s weakest area.
BAANNNNGGGGGGG

chapters.title: Chapter 362: The Little Devourer
paragraphs: Sirius had a warm smile on his face as he shook hands with Vritra and was introducing himself properly.
But in the next moment, the unsuspecting man received a deadly attack.
[Shift Activated.]
[Agility + Endurance → Strength]
’Forbid: The pain received through the groin increases by ten times.’
[Forbidden Activated.]
He even decided to test dust manipulation, as a layer of dust appeared over his knee and hardened to an extreme state.
And then...
BAANNNGGGG!
"Ooff—" For a moment, Sirius stared at Vritra’s face in disbelief; it was his trust that was broken first and then the two eggs.
"Oh—god— nnnngh! ssssss—ahhhhhhhh!" strange noises rang out.
Vritra clearly saw how the trust in the general’s eyes crumbled as his body jerked and shot toward the ground.
{Sin Point Gained: Couldn’t Breathe +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Petrified +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Shattered Faith +1}
The general smashed into the ground and began to convulse violently while clutching his crotch, intense waves of pain running through his body.
Vritra ignored the general. He flew ahead and was overjoyed that his defenses had become almost invincible.
He would have to see in the future what things could still hurt him, but this Divine Physique was just as great as the messages indicated.
"I wonder how great the power of the Divine Bloodline would be. Wait—what would happen if I use the energy core of the demon lord?
If my body can handle it, then won’t I be able to have the strength of the demon lord?" Vritra halted for a moment, becoming even more excited.
Since he had yet to completely make that core his own, the natural rate of energy conversion of the core was too slow, and so if he used it all, the core would need some time to refill.
First, he removed Rich’s appearance and took on a new one—a blind, frail boy, looking handsome and pitiful; an image that could make warmth flood others’ hearts.
He wrapped a black piece of cloth over his eyes, then flew some distance away from Sirius and closer to the continent.
The general would be out for a while.
"Now, let’s give it a try. If I can succeed, then I can finally start to merge this core into my body." Taking a deep breath, Vritra pulled out the dimensional book.
The car was present in one of the pages, and the people hadn’t even noticed anything.
Then he moved into a different small realm, using so much demonic power openly would attract too much attention.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
After appearing over a vast desert, Vritra wasted no time and instantly started his experiment.
[Switch Activated.]
He decided to start small.
[Switch: Demonification (5%)]
WHOOOSH
Suddenly, a big part of the forest buzzed with heavy pressure as bluish aura spread to a large area.
Horns appeared over Vritra’s body and his eyes began to glow with a bright red color, while purplish veins became clearly visible all over his pale, smooth skin.
Incredible power filled his body. The core was still resisting, but the violent body couldn’t really affect Vritra at all.
After a few seconds, Vritra decided to increase the power when he sensed no pain.
[Switch: Demonification (10%)]
BOOM
"So much power..." Vritra felt as if he could tear this small realm apart with a single hand.
The purity of the energy seemed higher than ever before and he could utilize the violent energy more efficiently now.
[Switch: Demonification (15%)]
[Switch: Demonification (20%)]
[Switch: Demonification (25%)]
Vritra finally stopped at forty percent; his body could actually hold all that power without even the slightest injury.
Even as his veins bulged and blood boiled inside his body, he felt perfectly fine, while his strength rose to a whole new level.
To the point that he could squash the human general Sirius without any effort.
"Perfect!! We are almost ready to go to the Dragon Kingdom. At this speed it won’t be long before we can actually be together," Yasmine exclaimed happily.
She longed for his touch, to properly feel his warmth, and actually claim her place as his first wife.
"Can we head to the Dragon Kingdom directly from the Quartz continent?" Vritra questioned.
He was really happy with this new outcome, but still, this was not completely his own strength, so he wasn’t satisfied.
"Yes, but there is no hurry. Only once you are strong enough that you won’t be in danger there can we really go," Yasmine replied.
She didn’t really care what was going on with the dragons.
Instead, she just wanted to traverse the world with her husband, living every day drowned in love and also enjoying all sorts of dramas and dangers with him.
"..." Vritra nodded but remained silent.
After thinking for a few seconds, he wondered if it would be possible to let the Evil-Veyll God Essence core swallow the demon lord’s core.
After all, he had complete control over the Evil-Veyll God Essence core, and this core held higher potential.
It could be a bit dangerous, but not anymore. After finding out about the Divine Physique’s capability, his confidence had increased—but not to the point of overconfidence.
First, he focused on the Evil-Veyll God Essence core. He hadn’t used this purple core in quite some time, so quite a bit of Essence had already gathered inside.
This core was like an excited child, full of vitality and excitement but extremely destructive.
If Vritra could land a hit on his opponent’s body with this energy, then even demon-lord-ranked beings could be injured, it was that powerful and dangerous.
As Vritra’s consciousness interacted with the core, the purple core reacted quite cheerfully.
After observing the Evil-Veyll God Essence core for a few minutes, Vritra then began to lead a path towards the sealed demonic core.
And the purple core easily understood Vritra’s motive as it followed all his instructions.
Vritra loosened the seal slightly and connected the two cores directly, making a sort of energy channeling path.

The purple core had never disturbed the demon lord’s core before since it could hurt Vritra, but now that its own master was ordering it to do it, the godly core began to greedily devour the energy of the demonic core.
While the demon lord’s core, upon sensing the danger, began to rampage in his body, but now it was completely useless.
Seeing this, the blue core began to steal more and more of its energy.
Vritra observed the exchange for a while.
Thankfully, no matter how much the blue core tried to hurt him from inside, he remained perfectly fine.
After the process is complete, Vritra would finally be able to freely use that energy and even the replenishing speed would be faster, while his strength will have a very, very massive jump.
Though the whole process was going to take the time of a few days, probably.
Vritra let the two cores play among themselves. Satisfied with his experiments, he left the dimensional book and even brought the car out.
Back to the driver’s seat, his mind was filled with lots of thoughts about the future.
The best thing that happened now was him obtaining the invincible body and the Evil-Veyll God Essence core getting stronger rapidly.
While driving, Vritra turned his head back and spoke: "So mugger, show me, what is the treasure you stole from that city?"

chapters.title: Chapter 363: Zihong!!
paragraphs: "So mugger, show me, what is the treasure you stole from that city?" Vritra spoke, looking behind.
Onest, who was busy sightseeing with the windows closed, suddenly froze. He pretended not to have heard Vritra, scratching a spot on the glass window.
"Tell me, or I will hand you over to that General Sirius. I’m sure he would love to put a mugger like you to justice," Vritra threatened.
{Sin Point Gained: Frightened +1}
Previously, Onest still had confidence in defeating Vritra, but now, he felt afraid of him.
"O-okay, I don’t know what’s inside." Sighing, he took out the same box and passed it to Vritra.
Creating a third arm of dust, Vritra used it to control the steering wheel, then opened the box with force.
BANG
With a loud noise he broke the lock and removed the cover, finally revealing two objects.
There was a ring and a scroll inside. First he picked up the ring and tried his appraisal on it.
[Ring of Escape]
[Description]: A one-time use item. Whenever you are in danger, insert your mana and you will be teleported to a random location far enough from your original position.
Be careful though, it might end up landing you into an even bigger problem.
’It is useless for me,’ Vritra thought, but for now, he kept it in his inventory. Then he picked up the scroll and opened it.
There was a name mentioned at one of its corners.
THE TALES OF ZIHONG!
Vritra wondered which among the two things was the bigger treasure. The ring was certainly valuable but not enough to anger those people so much.
So, the scroll must be the main treasure. Sceptically, he began to read it.
It actually seemed to be a story about a person named Zihong, an ordinary kid who used to live outside the Quartz continent.
But in a demon invasion, he ended up losing his entire family and was kidnapped to become a slave.
Spending more than thirty years among the demons, when he came out, he had become a God.
’Hmm, God? Wifey, do you know anything about this?’ Vritra asked, pausing in the middle.
"Yeah, it is quite a famous tale. I had heard it when I was little. It was said that Zihong could destroy entire kingdoms and continents with a single punch.
For forty years, all the demons got into hiding, afraid that Zihong would come.
His attack, I think it was called something like Charged Fist or something, was famous and deadly.
Only after he disappeared did the demons finally dare to come out from their hiding," Yasmine replied, surprising Vritra with this tale.
’Whoa, he was that powerful? No wonder those people were so upset when this thing got stolen. But does it contain anything important?’ Vritra thought before continuing to read further.
Zihong ascended to Godhood but he left behind his strongest attack, The Charged Fist!
Among the ten locations mentioned, one contains Zihong’s legacy. Only this key can open the door.
’So this map is the key...’ Vritra understood its importance, but he wondered how such an important thing landed in the hands of that city chief.

"It is a good thing, let’s just keep it for now. If we are lucky enough to find the legacy, that would be great," Yasmine added, knowing just how fierce the competition for such things in the continent is.
’Hmm, it’s a nice thing. Anyway, before we reach the continent, let’s put all those droplets to use,’ Vritra thought as he put away the map and focused on the status panel.
[Elegy Parasite Activated.]
Instantly his body went on autopilot and Vritra began to absorb the large amount of knowledge as his connection with the skill became stronger rapidly.
It wasn’t long before a storm of dust began to swirl around the car. The higher his comprehension became, the more majestic the phenomenon around him became.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 11%}
{Dust Manipulation: 12%}
{Dust Manipulation: 13%}
Finally, he used the twenty-fourth palette droplet.
{Dust Manipulation: 27%}
{Palette Droplet: 20}
Just at the twenty-seven percent mark, the skill had grown tremendously. Normally, people would have to spend dozens upon dozens of years even to raise a quarter of that.
’Dust manipulation has grown quite a lot.’ Just based on his mood, it was as if the dust around him reacted. No wonder people put so much importance on Fields.
But now it was time to invest the remaining palette droplets into Null. He wasn’t sure what kind of changes would occur.
Excitedly, he began to put one palette droplet after another into the Null Field.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Null comprehension!}
{Null: 1%}
Maybe because Dust Manipulation was still not that high-ranked, but the amount of information he received with Null was several times higher.
Vritra had to take a small break after adding each of the droplets.
And by the time he was finished with the twentieth droplet, he could feel a vast change in his surroundings.
[Null Activated.]
Vritra stared into the empty space, seeing countless nodes that filled the whole space, each one connecting to every other.
By this time, they were already quite close to the continent. Just some more time and they would be able to enter.
He even felt a close connection with time. After a moment, he mumbled, "Pause."
The car and everything around him suddenly paused in time, frozen completely. Vritra could move just fine, but only ten or so meters around him were frozen.
At just twenty percent, he could already pause time. Vritra was amazed, though the consumption of Mana was quite high.
But with Suck! Suck! Suck! Vritra could continue this state for quite long.
He deactivated the skills as everything once again returned to normal. The people in the car didn’t seem to have noticed anything.

’Comprehending Fields is awesome. I need to increase them all to a hundred percent as soon as possible,’ Vritra thought, and to do that he would have to be as wild as he could in the Quartz continent.
As for his family, he was sure even their strength would shoot up in this continent—this was a place of countless opportunities.
[Null Activated.]
He focused on one of the nodes and then spent some of his energy while interacting with it.
Instantly, his body was teleported to a random point nearly two kilometers away in the sky. It was so sudden that Vritra was frozen for a moment.
"Whoa, awesome—wait, the car!" Only then did he remember the driverless car that was moving quite fast.
But just as he was about to take control of the steering wheel with the help of dust, the car smashed at full speed into an iron pole.
BANG!!
All the people inside were startled, but almost all of them quickly stabilized their bodies. Even Bullo jumped off in time.
Only Monk Shitless was the one who wasn’t able to react in time; the poor guy had just fallen asleep.
His body shot forward and broke through the window as his head smashed against the pole.
"Krrkkhhh—"
