’So this map is the key...’ Vritra understood its importance, but he wondered how such an important thing landed in the hands of that city chief.
"It is a good thing, let’s just keep it for now.
If we are lucky enough to find the legacy, that would be great," Yasmine added, knowing just how fierce the competition for such things in the continent is.
’Hmm, it’s a nice thing.
Anyway, before we reach the continent, let’s put all those droplets to use,’ Vritra thought as he put away the map and focused on the status panel.
[Elegy Parasite Activated.]
Instantly his body went on autopilot and Vritra began to absorb the large amount of knowledge as his connection with the skill became stronger rapidly.
It wasn’t long before a storm of dust began to swirl around the car.
The higher his comprehension became, the more majestic the phenomenon around him became.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 11%}
{Dust Manipulation: 12%}
{Dust Manipulation: 13%}
Finally, he used the twenty-fourth palette droplet.
{Dust Manipulation: 27%}
{Palette Droplet: 20}
Just at the twenty-seven percent mark, the skill had grown tremendously.
Normally, people would have to spend dozens upon dozens of years even to raise a quarter of that.
’Dust manipulation has grown quite a lot.’ Just based on his mood, it was as if the dust around him reacted.
No wonder people put so much importance on Fields.
But now it was time to invest the remaining palette droplets into Null.
He wasn’t sure what kind of changes would occur.
Excitedly, he began to put one palette droplet after another into the Null Field.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Null comprehension!}
{Null: 1%}
Maybe because Dust Manipulation was still not that high-ranked, but the amount of information he received with Null was several times higher.
Vritra had to take a small break after adding each of the droplets.
And by the time he was finished with the twentieth droplet, he could feel a vast change in his surroundings.
[Null Activated.]
Vritra stared into the empty space, seeing countless nodes that filled the whole space, each one connecting to every other.
By this time, they were already quite close to the continent.
Just some more time and they would be able to enter.
He even felt a close connection with time.
After a moment, he mumbled, "Pause."
The car and everything around him suddenly paused in time, frozen completely.
Vritra could move just fine, but only ten or so meters around him were frozen.
At just twenty percent, he could already pause time.
Vritra was amazed, though the consumption of Mana was quite high.
But with Suck!
Suck!
Suck!
Vritra could continue this state for quite long.
He deactivated the skills as everything once again returned to normal.
The people in the car didn’t seem to have noticed anything.
’Comprehending Fields is awesome.
I need to increase them all to a hundred percent as soon as possible,’ Vritra thought, and to do that he would have to be as wild as he could in the Quartz continent.
As for his family, he was sure even their strength would shoot up in this continent—this was a place of countless opportunities.
[Null Activated.]
He focused on one of the nodes and then spent some of his energy while interacting with it.
Instantly, his body was teleported to a random point nearly two kilometers away in the sky.
It was so sudden that Vritra was frozen for a moment.
"Whoa, awesome—wait, the car!" Only then did he remember the driverless car that was moving quite fast.
But just as he was about to take control of the steering wheel with the help of dust, the car smashed at full speed into an iron pole.
BANG!!
All the people inside were startled, but almost all of them quickly stabilized their bodies.
Even Bullo jumped off in time.
Only Monk Shitless was the one who wasn’t able to react in time; the poor guy had just fallen asleep.
His body shot forward and broke through the window as his head smashed against the pole.
"Krrkkhhh—"

chapters.title: Chapter 364: The Misery
paragraphs: "Krrkkhhh—" Monk Shitless almost bit his tongue as his head smashed into the pole. His head slid along the metallic pole as he fell on the bonnet of the car.
Vritra finally arrived close to the car. He scratched his cheek upon seeing the big lump appearing over the pitiful Monk, who let out a painful groan.
"Are you fine?" he asked while helping Shitless up.
"W- What happened? Ughh, I was just sleeping and then—then I was outside." Monk Shitless said in confusion; he was having such a nice dream of turning all the emperors into his slaves.
"I don’t know, here, drink this potion." Vritra said as he took out a potion and handed it to him.
After drinking the potion, the pain was gone, but strangely the big lump remained on top of his head.
MUOOOO
Bullo jumped back onto the top of the car and went back to sleep.
Vanessa glanced outside the window. For some reason, she had a strange feeling about this Quartz continent, though it was just impossible to tell why she was feeling like that.
Shifting slightly to not wake Fiona up, she glanced outside the window, looking at the distant houses.
A city situated outside the Quartz Continent was already visible.
’How strange, I feel like something is calling me from there.’ She thought.
After Vritra and Shitless got back into the car, the ride continued.
"Psycho, what was in that treasure box?" From the backseat, Onest asked.
"Nothing of importance. Anyway, do you plan to venture into this new continent on your own or...?" Vritra asked, driving close to the city. He could already see the majestic gates of the continent.
Everything here seemed hundreds or thousands of times better than the Topaz continent, more futuristic and majestic.
"...Yeah, it would be better to stick close in this new place, so let me travel with you for a bit longer." Onest replied, though very soon he was about to come to regret his decision.
There was a big wall built even around the city situated outside the continent. Vritra stopped the car in the line; there were two more cars ahead of him.
After both cars were thoroughly checked, the guards asked Vritra to come forward.
When the three guards saw him, they were shocked; Vritra had his eyes covered by a cloth after all.
"Hello, I am Eren Yeager." Vritra said with a faint smile.
"O- Oh Eren, why have you covered your eyes? Isn’t it dangerous to drive like that?" one of the guards asked, looking into the car, but there was no one inside.
"Sigh. What does it matter? The world is full of darkness for a blind guy like me. But I wasn’t always blind like this.
Two years before my birth, my parents were eaten by titans, then my entire town was blown to pieces and every single person was killed.
Then the new family I joined collectively committed suicide; then one day, the school I was studying at turned to dust by Thanos’s snap; then—"
Vritra began to tell the tale of how he became blind.
"Wait, wait, we understand. No need to bring such a tragic past. What is your purpose of entering?" the guard asked.
"I am from the golden Moon." Vritra said, as he showed his badge.
"Ah, hello sir, you can pass." The guards said before taking a step back.
Vritra nodded and drove into the city. The door of the continent wasn’t too far. He looked back and asked: "Should I stop at a hotel or something?"
"Nah, we are fine. Let’s just go into the continent first." Vanessa replied. She glanced to the side and saw that the glow around Diana was becoming brighter.
After driving for nearly three hours, they finally got close to the continent’s door.
There was a very long line gathered outside, all the people who wanted to enter, but only about twenty percent of them were being allowed inside.
He drove to the line of cars and stopped. Monk Shitless had once again fallen asleep.
Vanessa was gazing out of the window when her gaze focused on a figure wearing a black robe.
The person in the robe was about to enter the continent, but maybe sensing something, the said person turned their head and looked back at Vanessa for a moment before rushing inside.
"Honey, I need to leave for a while." Vanessa suddenly said.
"Hmm, what’s wrong?" Vritra glanced back, looking at his mom curiously.
"I have this strange feeling that something is calling me from inside this place, and I want to go check it." She replied, her gaze shifting between Vritra and the gate.
"How about we go together—" Vritra suddenly paused as he sensed the large number of people who were about to rush out of the gates.
"But it could be dangerous. We are new here and know nothing about this place." Vritra said, though he also didn’t want to limit their growth because of his worry.
"I will be fine, don’t worry." As she spoke, Vanessa’s body began to change drastically.
Her hair was still black. Aside from that, almost everything changed. Her appearance became so average that no one would even notice her in the crowd.
Freckles appeared on her face, and she looked to be in her fifties. In such an appearance, no one would really try to cause trouble for her.
"Hmm..." Vritra was still worried. After thinking for a moment, he gave her the teleportation ring he had just obtained.
Then ordered Hellmancer and Bob to follow along with her and keep her safe. He even gave her one of the glyphs that the three demon generals had given him.

"Okay, but be careful there, and use the ring to teleport away if you are in danger. Though Hell and Bob would be there to protect you, if they can’t then use this glyph to call for the three demon generals.
And if everything else fails, then they will be able to buy enough time for me to find you." Vritra said, and even gave her a page of his dimensional book. She could even hide inside it.

"Hehe, honey, you are worrying too much. Anyway, I will be extra careful. I will be back as soon as possible. Also, be safe yourself." Vanessa giggled, as she leaned forward and gave a soft kiss on his lips.
Then she got out of the car and got mixed up in the crowd.
"I feel Mom would be safer if she enters alone, the perfect decision hubby." Yasmine said.
Vritra nodded. He could tell that a lot of men were getting closer and closer, so he looked back at the two remaining ladies and asked:
"Do you also want to enter alone or stay in the dimensional book or the abandoned town?"
Fiona had finally woken up as Vanessa left in a hurry. Diana also ended her comprehension.
They thought for a few minutes, then the goddess was the first to answer:
"I can sense that a temple is quite close, and I would like to visit it. It won’t be dangerous, so we will also be entering separately, right Fiona?"
Fiona also nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: The Betrayal
paragraphs: Fiona also agreed to go with Diana. Vritra wasn’t all that worried; after all, he was the one who attracted the most trouble, and he also felt that going that way was better.
The two women got out of the car, and Diana used the Halo she had obtained before to change both of their appearances to look absolutely ordinary.
Vritra sent the Dark Knight, Bob, and Psyche with them, and also gave them each a glyph from the three demon generals; that way they would be completely safe.
"Now, what shall we do?" Onest asked, gazing at the countless soldiers flying out of the continent’s boundary, rushing in different directions.
All those people were certainly there for them; the trio had committed many crimes after all.
Onest had a high chance of running away, but he didn’t want to just escape alone. He waited for Vritra’s reply, ready to follow the strongest of the group.
"...We will resist with all our might, and after breaking their teamwork and thrashing them, we will escape into the continent," Vritra replied in a serious tone.
"Okay, just give me the signal when it’s time to run," Onest added, scanning all the men.
They were at 1st, 2nd, and even 3rd Legion ranks, so he was sure that he could beat most of them despite the large numbers.
Thankfully, the 4th or above ranked weren’t here yet.
It didn’t take long for those soldiers to locate Vritra and the others. The commanders commanded their men and made them encircle the car.
"Come out or we will kill you right here and now!" one of the commanders shouted, his voice full of rage.
"Let’s fight till death, no matter what, we won’t surrender," Vritra said, nodding towards Onest with a solemn expression.
"YES SIR, WE WILL BEAT ALL THEIR ASSES!" Monk Shitless shouted, trembling in excitement.
"..." Onest rolled his eyes; Monk Shitless could be beaten even by someone not at 1st Legion rank.
"Don’t worry, he is just for the motivation. Let’s go! No matter what, we won’t admit defeat!" Vritra said, as the three pushed open their doors and got out of the car.
Onest, despite his profession as a thief, was ready to prove that he was a man of his word.
He would never escape alone, leaving his friend behind. With a loud shout, he shot towards the soldiers, striking them with a heavy staff.
BANG
He hit the chest of a soldier, sending him flying back. Then, moving with great precision, he began to strike the soldiers left and right, slowly making up ground.
"Let’s keep going, we can do this," Onest shouted, moving faster and faster. He avoided the ones stronger than him and only hit the weaker.
"Catch the thief, this bastard alone isn’t planning to surrender, kill him if necessary!" another commander roared, as even stronger soldiers began to join.
Though these roars only made Onest more excited, but then something clicked in his mind.
’Alone? Then what about the others?’
Pausing for a moment, he looked back and almost slipped when seeing Vritra and Monk Shitless peacefully surrendering, getting cuffs over their hands.

"Sir, we are innocent! He is the mastermind, he forced us to do this! Sob, my brother is even blind, oh Amitabha bring justice to this sadistic bastard..." Monk Shitless said in his most pitiful tone.
{Sin Point Gained: Trust Shattered +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +803}
{Sin Point Gained: Pitied +783}
{Sin Point Gained: Sympathy +801}
Vritra enjoyed the sight of messages floating in front of him, but this was just the start.
Instead of getting thrown into trouble, he was jumping straight into it himself; after all, it is just impossible to kill him now.
Onest was just staring dumbly at the group, his eyes screaming the word betrayal, as something hit the back of his head, leaving him unconscious.
"And that’s how we ended up in this place," Vritra said, as he finished the large piece of meat.
"Ohh, such heavy offences!" one of the inmates said in shock, his own crime was not even half as bad.

"S- So I was arrested because they think I am not the real Rich? Sigh, thankfully the emperor will be able to help me. Don’t worry, I will help you out too, Eren," Rich said, remembering Vritra’s new identity.
BANG BANG
One of the prison guards hit the gate of the cell and shouted, "The four of you, it is time for your judgement."
The door was opened, and several guards surrounded the four as they were led out of the prison and towards the Judgement Hall.
While they were midway, one of the guards sighed and said, "Sigh, I pity them a bit. The emperor just had to leave to welcome a guest, so his younger brother will be overlooking their trial."
"W- What? That piece of utter shit?!!" Rich paused in bafflement, cursing out loud for the fifth time in his life.
The previous four times were also because of the emperor’s younger brother.
"Keep walking," one of the guards said, lightly patting his shoulder.
Monk Shitless and Onest wondered what sort of man it was, but judging from Rich’s expression it wasn’t going to be anything good.
But Vritra was interested in something else, so he began to gossip.
"Whoa, what sort of guest is it that the emperor himself had to go welcome?" he asked, taking a step towards one of the guards.
The guard naturally spoke, for a moment forgetting about their roles.
"I heard it is the Dragon Emperor."
Both Vritra and Yasmine were surprised upon hearing that, so he continued to ask.
"Hmm, what business could such a powerful person have here?"
"How would I know that?" the guard shrugged, so Vritra changed the topic.
"Have you ever seen the empress? I have heard she is very beautiful, sigh what a pity that I am blind," Vritra looked aggrieved.

"Hehe boy, of course I have seen her, but her face is always covered by that veil. Not many people are lucky enough to have seen her face," the guard said, suddenly getting more interested in the gossip.
"Is she also here? Will she be in the judgement hall?" Vritra asked.
"Yeah, for some reason, she had been staying here for a while now, but I don’t think she will be in the judgement hall—cough, stop talking!"
The guard finally came to his senses as they arrived at the entrance of the judgement hall.
As the guard told them to enter, a person standing by the throne’s side began to introduce the group and their crimes.
"They are responsible for a vast property loss of the continent, stealing very important treasures of the continent, almost killing the general, colluding with demons, killing..."
More than half of the crimes were just made up, using them as scapegoats.
At the front was a big throne, looking really luxurious and grand.

On it, a man who seemed to be in his thirties sat like the ruler of the world, arrogance dripping off his body; he just glanced at the new batch of criminals once before gazing to the side at a beautiful advisor.
On both sides of the path, dozens upon dozens of seats were present, filled with ministers and all sorts of important people.
"You are now in the presence of Prince Griffith."

paragraphs: Vanessa joined the line at the gate of the Quartz continent. It took some time, but she was able to pass.
Already being at the 3rd Legion rank, there were few who could do anything against her Hypnosis among the guards.
After passing through the gate, she followed the feeling in her heart, her gaze searching for the same person.
’That person is definitely close, they must have sensed me too,’ Vanessa thought, moving into the new continent.
She was amazed at how well every building was built and how different the daily life of people inside the walls was.
But she paid little attention to the sightseeing and soon saw the same black-robed person. It seemed they were also looking for her.
Again their gazes met, but instantly the robed person began to run away. Vanessa wasted no time as she moved at full speed, carefully moving through the crowd.
The other person was strong but nowhere near as powerful as her, so it wasn’t long before Vanessa caught up and dragged the robed person to a rather secluded street.
"L- Let go of me," the captive struggled, her voice sounding feminine.
Vanessa ignored her words and, after making sure no one was around, she pushed the hood back as the delicate face of a fifteen or sixteen-year-old girl was revealed.
But what was surprising were the two horns on her head and a tail on her back.
"You are a succubus?" Vanessa asked in surprise, gazing at the beautiful girl, looking so innocent.
"I- I am n- not, let go..." the girl panicked. She regretted sneaking out; the horrifying tales she had heard from her parents rang out in her head.
Her eyes were instantly filled with tears as she began to cry.
Vanessa was surprised; this girl was definitely at the peak of 1st Legion rank and here she was crying like a kid, though she was indeed a kid.
"Don’t cry, I am not going to hurt you," Vanessa said, and then she revealed her true appearance—long green hair and two small horns on her head.
"Sob Y- You are a sob succubus too?" the girl asked mid-sobs, finally relaxing.
"Yeah, so tell me why you were roaming all alone? And do you live openly in this city?" Vanessa questioned; her honey-like voice made the girl feel a lot better.
The first and biggest city of the Quartz continent was called Ghazi.
"N- No, I um..." the girl still seemed hesitant to speak. After all, she knew if others got to know of her house, everyone would be in danger.
"It is fine. Tell me where you live? Tell me about yourself," Vanessa asked, her eyes glowing with a faint pinkish light and a soothing aura automatically appearing around her body.
"Hello, I am Gia. I live in the secret Succubus kingdom located here on the continent," Gia replied, calming down completely and feeling as if she was just meeting a family member.
"Oh!" Vanessa was surprised by the news, but this was also a chance; she was certain that something in that place was calling out to her.
She fell silent for a few moments, contacting Vritra through Hellmancer. After telling him about this, they made a decision.
"Gia, can you lead me to this place?" Vanessa asked. She possessed the bloodline and physique of the Succubus Queen, which is extremely rare.
The previously known Queen of the succubus had died a long time ago, and since then, the succubus race had gone into hiding.
"Okay." Gia nodded, feeling no sense of danger from Vanessa as the two began to move through the busy streets of Ghazi city.
"So what is the plan?" Onest asked, still feeling hurt from the previous betrayal. He knew Vritra won’t just accept any sort of punishment.
"No matter what, we won’t kneel or beg for mercy, we will oppose the prince!" Vritra said, right before they were about to enter the hall.
Onest nodded but thought: ’Hmph, do they think I am a fool? Of course, I will do anything for survival. They are trying to fool me like last time.’
And finally, they entered.
The prince had long blonde hair and a buffed physique, lying back on the throne.
He seemed like the perfect definition of narcissism, arrogance, and corruption.
In the large hall, nearly three hundred people were present: some ministers, advisors, guards, servants, and many others.
They stopped in the middle of the large hall. Vritra scanned the entire hall; Yennefer really wasn’t there.
’Looks like I will have to call her out.’
"You are now in the presence of Prince Griffith!" one of the men announced after speaking of their crimes.
’Griffith!!’ Vritra repeated the name, unpleasant memories resurfacing in his mind, and he already hated this guy.
"Do you admit to your crimes?" Griffith asked.
Onest was the first to act, as he fell to his knees and said in a loud tone: "Please forgive me, I- I..."
He looked to the side and saw the two looking at him with disgust; Vritra and Shitless spat before saying: "What a spineless bug."
"Are you the emperor?" Vritra ignored Onest and turned his face towards the emperor. While speaking, he released his aura and broke the cuffs as if to put pressure.
But in reality, it was just to grab someone’s attention.
Griffith frowned; he stopped the female servant who was there just to feed him fruit. No one dares to speak like that in his presence.
"No, I am not, but—" Griffith was just replying arrogantly, but Vritra interrupted.
"Then crawl away, eunuch. I don’t talk to half-men, lapdogs, or vermin. Call the emperor if you wish to communicate with me.
Tch, what a stench of cheap filth. Sigh, only if the emperor didn’t have the habit of visiting brothels so often." Vritra said, shaking his head, and after that, there was utter silence in the hall.

Everyone was aware that there were a few things that Griffith absolutely hated: being called the son of a whore, eunuch, and dog of his brother. And Vritra just seemed to have hit all his painful marks.
Born out of a sex worker, he was castrated at birth so that the royal bloodline wouldn’t be mixed with his filthy blood in the future.
Because of his mother, he wasn’t even given a chance at becoming the emperor.
Though he was able to get back his member through other means, he could never erase the insults.
"Y- You..." Griffith was just speechless. Despite all that, no one actually dared to speak a single word in front of him.
Monk Shitless nodded before speaking in a loud tone: "You Pest, how dare you be so arrogant in front of my Lord.
Courting death, kowtow ten thousand times, cripple your cultivation, then crawl from between my legs, and call me your father. Only then can we leave you alive."
Onest was horrified, shrinking behind the two. He understood that traveling along with them was a mistake.
He was definitely going to die now.
BOOM!
Griffith suddenly stood up, his eyes red and face twisted in utter rage. He had never been this angry in his entire life.
"You bastards, I am going to tear you apart—"
But just then the door of the hall was opened with incredible force.
BANG

chapters.title: Chapter 367: The Deadly Punishment
paragraphs: Fiona and Diana were able to enter the continent rather easily.
If people didn’t have a high identity, then they would have to pay a big fee for entering—that was why a lot of people couldn’t enter the continent.
Though that amount was nothing for the two ladies, after paying, they were allowed inside.
Diana’s control over the Misty Halo had become a lot better. Though it can’t compare to a mythic halo, it was still quite strong.
After entering the city Ghazi, the two first explored the streets of the new place, seeing all sorts of new and amazing things.
They even did some shopping, buying clothes for everyone that matched the place.
"But why did you want to visit the temple out of nowhere?"
Fiona asked, holding a gift box that she purchased for Vritra. She really wanted to go back and give it to him.
"Follow along, you will know soon." Diana said, then she added:

"Your comprehension is coming along quite nicely, but if you truly want to look for great opportunities then you should visit the south part of the continent. That region is completely occupied by the Phoenix race."
"Oh, humans and phoenix have such a good relation? I obtained that inheritance, won’t it cause some sort of problem?" she asked. Fiona knew how greedy people could be, whether humans or anyone else.

"Yeah, revealing your inheritance might not be a good idea. There are four emperors of the three races, the phoenix race had been in conflict ever since its previous ruler died and so it has two emperors. Going there would be dangerous and beneficial at the same time."
While talking, they walked towards the big temple. The big white building was visible from a long distance.
The two maintained their ordinary appearances and even wore veils. It was only around two in the afternoon, so the streets were bustling with crowd.
Arriving at the temple, the two walked inside. Diana removed the illusion and headed straight to the pope who was busy giving advice to people.
"I am Diana, the Goddess from the Topaz continent." She announced directly, making everyone around fall silent for a few seconds.
Even though Diana was not a true god, her authority was quite high.
’Hmm, what was the point of hiding our identities when she was going to reveal it like this?’ Fiona thought.
"G- Goddess, thank you for rewarding us with your presence." The pope and others instantly knelt down; that ethereal aura was proof enough.
Diana smiled faintly under the veil, then she ordered: "I need you to gather a few things for me, get it done as soon as possible."
"Yes, goddess!!" Pope nodded hurriedly.
Fiona was quite surprised. Wasn’t Diana just a no-name goddess from a small kingdom? How could she be so... cool?
"Hehe, now I can finally do some serious experiments, I have a lot of ideas. Anyway, you must be confused let me explain it to you." Diana said, upon seeing the surprised Fiona.
Soon, materials worth a large fortune were brought to Diana, and even a big residence was provided to the two. They sent Vritra the messages through the soul wraiths.
Vritra felt better after getting messages from Fiona and Diana. Even his mother was fine and going to a new place.
It looked like trouble was nowhere near them.
He was brought out of his thoughts by the loud shout of Prince Griffith, as hundreds upon hundreds of sin points rained down.
Just then, with a loud bang, the door to the hall opened, and a figure wearing a beautiful red dress came into sight.
Even Griffith became silent upon seeing the empress, her presence as heavy and dangerous as ever.
Yennefer scanned the hall, and her eyes soon focused on the guy with his eyes covered. She had sensed right; he was really here.
After seeing that message in the sky about Vritra, Yennefer had stayed close to the palace, completely sure that he was going to arrive there.
Her eyes were full of excitement upon seeing him again. She almost ran to embrace him, but after just a glance, Vritra just turned his head away, ignoring her.
Yennefer composed herself, then she walked forward, an elegant air surrounding her sensual body.
All the people stood up in respect, not daring to look straight at her, wondering why the deadly empress would appear there suddenly.
Narrowing her eyes at Griffith, she muttered: "Scram."
"Ah Y- Yes, empress." All anger disappeared as Griffith hastily moved away from the two thrones that were placed at least two meters apart.
Yennefer knew she can’t show affection in public or it would only put Vritra in danger, so she acted nonchalant and sat on the other throne.
"What’s going on here?" she asked, her gaze fixed on Vritra, but he wouldn’t even look at her.
She knew it was her fault for just leaving like that the last time; it clearly showed her priorities, so she knew why Vritra would be upset with her.

"T- Those bastards, they destroyed the newly built city, almost killed... a- and even cursed me just now. They all deserve to die instantly the worst possible deaths, especially those two." Griffith said angrily but had to be respectful in Yennefer’s presence.
"What do you have to say?" Yennefer asked, hating the feeling of getting ignored by him.
"..." Vritra said nothing. He looked to the side and saw a beautiful advisor standing nervously.
"Hello there, I am Eren. What’s a gorgeous lady like you doing in a boring place like this?" he asked, taking her soft hand. His figure flashed beside her all of a sudden.
"Uh... T- Thank you." She answered as her cheeks flushed, now getting a proper look at his face. Vritra still looked extremely handsome.
The lady felt her heart flutter at the praise and his gesture of brushing her hair behind her ear gently.
CRACK
A loud sound made everyone in the hall jump in fear. They looked towards the empress and saw that the armrest had been crushed by the empress.
A strong feeling of jealousy pricked her heart like a needle. Despite knowing he was doing this to anger her, she didn’t like seeing this.
"Ignore her, tell me more about yourself. Are you single?" Vritra asked, making her sit over her seat.
"U- Uhm... Y- Yes I am." She replied, looking even more shy, liking Vritra’s personality more and more.
"Tsk These criminals need to be punished." Yennefer felt as if something uncomfortable was crawling under her skin, she couldn’t hold back any longer as she added,
"Do whatever you want with that Baldy and beggar, I am going to punish this one myself." After saying this, her figure appeared right beside Vritra.
Without saying a word, she held his hand and rushed towards her house present close to the hall.
’M- My sister-in-law cares so much about me?!!’
Griffith was shocked, utterly bewildered. If she was the one who was going to punish Vritra, then his fate was the most pitiful.
After the two arrived in her temporary house, Vritra returned to his original appearance as he asked with a fake smile: "What’s the matter empress? Are you-"
But before he could say anything, the empress pushed him against the wall making a loud noise, pressing her soft moist lips against his in a violent manner.
BANG
’Kekeke the punishment has begun!!’ Griffith gloated.

This was the main headquarters of the Golden Moon where the six seats had called a meeting after more than ten years.
Only when something major takes place in the continent would the six seats ever gather.
One of the guys was wearing a white outfit, and aside from his clothes, his body looked completely invisible.
It was the Oracle of the Golden Moon, the fastest person of the six who had a firm grasp over Light. With just a thought, he could turn night into day over a big part of the continent.
He was famous by the name Oracle and the sharpest blade, since with his light attribute and Field he could not only move fast but even cut almost anything.

The Oracle was the brain of the Golden Moon, but when he was young he somehow lost his ability to speak, yet through a miracle or lucky encounter he gained an ability to glimpse into the future or look at places at a vast distance away from his location.
Aside from the six men, a woman was also present there currently.

It was none other than Yennefer who held such a high position in this organisation.
Her body was a red blur, but out of the six, three or four of them couldn’t help but steal glances towards her.
The seven were, of course, aware of each other’s identities, and even outsiders knew about it.
Yet the reason to meet in such a manner was because the information about this meeting couldn’t be leaked.
"So Oracle, why have you called me here this time?
Couldn’t you have just handled it yourself?" the oldest man with a frail and trembling body said, his voice sounding sleepy.
"Sir Giant, I am sure you are also aware of the Divine’s announcement." Oracle said.
Despite not being able to speak, his thoughts manifested in the form of words, a useful skill he had long ago.
"Yeah, who could be so ignorant to not have seen that?
Even the Gods weren’t left out of it.
So have you found out about this Vritra?" another man spoke, his voice heavy and thick, just like his burly body.
Two among the six were twins from one of the prominent families of the continent, called Tin and Vin.
If the two fought together they were just extremely difficult to defeat and even harder to kill.
Their appearance was still that of young men in their twenties despite already having experienced so many centuries.
Their nature was quite playboy-like.
"What does the empress have to say about it?
It’s been so long since I heard your voice.
Sigh, back in the day we brothers received so many slaps from you that the marks became a permanent tattoo on our cheeks." Tin said, interrupting Oracle in the middle.
"Please don’t interrupt us in the middle, otherwise I will ask Sir Pink to touch you both inappropriately." Oracle said without a change in his tone.
"..." Tin and Vin both glanced towards the pinkish blur; they could almost see the perverted old man dressed in lingerie, making strange gestures.
"Ughh, shut up Tin, and Oracle, I didn’t even speak." Vin said pitifully.
If others were to see the spectacle, they wouldn’t believe that these six were actually the powerful and feared six seats of the Golden Moon, fighting almost like kids.
"Cough, Sir Big Guy, about this matter, I have tried reading the stars a few times and got some important information."
Oracle said, looking at the man with the heavy voice who was called Big Guy, since his normal height was well over three meters.
"Hihi, what a cute boy, I knew you were quite capable, so what are you waiting for?
Blessings from this elderly?
Fine, go ahead and deal with Vritra, you will succeed.
So are we done here?
I have to go back and prepare for my little pumpkin’s birthday." Giant, the old man said, thinking about his grandson’s daughter whose marriage trial was approaching.
"Sir Giant, I know you have other important matters but please don’t think this lightly.
It is, after all, related to The Divine!" Big Guy said, his tone heavy and solemn.
Finally, the atmosphere in the white hall turned a little serious; no one could take the Divine’s name lightly.
Clearing her throat, Yennefer spoke: "So the new Divine, Vritra, he is in the White Kingdom?
What if this is just some made-up news by those demon lords?"
She was the youngest among all the others present and possessed little knowledge about the Divine, and the ones who knew anything wouldn’t share.
"No, he is already in the continent, in Ghazi City." Oracle said with confidence.
Yennefer didn’t care whether Vritra had any relation to the Divine or not but she was not going to let any of them harm him.
At least this way, she would be sure to protect him as much as she can.
"Oracle, what else have you found?" Pink asked, his voice had a feminine touch to it, as he moved his chair closer to the twins.
"I have thought of all possibilities and peeked into the future but for now there is no way to capture or kill him." Oracle replied.
"Then are you saying we just let him grow?
If that announcement was really true, then we can’t even leave Vritra alive for a month.
His growth is already monstrous from what I have heard about him." The big guy said, tension evident in his voice.
"Don’t worry, I am well aware of the danger.
Rest assured, I have already devised a net; you just have to do a few things for now." Oracle had very high intelligence.
In the past, only because of him the continent had survived many dangers.
So all the members trusted him completely.
Aside from the old man called Giant, all others wouldn’t use their brains and would just follow his orders.
"For now, Tin and Vin, you two should go and watch over the Midnight party." Oracle added.
’Midnight Party...?’ Yennefer pondered, but Vritra didn’t seem to have any relation with that place.
It was the biggest black market in the entire continent, located at the boundary of Ghazi City.
Most of the criminals could casually be found there.
"Okay boss, but wouldn’t it be better if we know what we are looking for?" Vin said, looking at the empress from the side of his eyes.
"Just stay there for a while, you will know when the time comes." Oracle said, giving no further explanations.
"That will be all for now, I will send more information and details of the plan separately to you all." This way even if any of them tried to betray, he would still be in control.
"Haha, Lad, good job as always.
If you were any younger I might have just married my cute butterfly to you." Giant said.

chapters.title: Chapter 371: The Charm Land
paragraphs: Then after bidding their goodbyes, all of the Seats began to disappear one by one from the room. In the end, only Pink was left there.
A few minutes after everyone had disappeared, he tapped his chin and mumbled:

"What a great opportunity, just perfect! Us demons have been quiet for way too long and everyone has forgotten what terror is after experiencing this peace. Finally, we can infiltrate the Quartz continent completely."
Pink pondered for a moment.
It was extremely difficult to do much under the presence of the Oracle and Giant, but he could make use of others.
And reaping benefits as the third party in a war, what could be better than that?
After a moment, his appearance changed and he looked like an old man in his eighties, his head full of white hair.

In reality, he was a demon lord who had already infiltrated several human organizations, like Golden Moon, Bone Blood Cult, and even the Nine Pacts, along with many other powerful ones in the continent.
Not only was he a great source of information but he could easily disrupt others’ plans, though dealing with Oracle was extremely difficult.
"Now it is time to go and visit the Bone Blood Cult, these mindless cultists will be very happy upon hearing the news of chaos." He said and disappeared from his position.
From what information all of them had gathered about Vritra, his strength should at most be in the 2nd Legion rank, though it was already astonishing since he was called to this world not long ago.
And that level of growth while staying in that small continent without any external support—not any they were aware of—truly was monstrous.

But Pink felt that Vritra couldn’t be of much use in his plan, though Vritra’s value wasn’t based on his current strength but his potential, which he could make use of to attract powerful beings and create one of the biggest wars.

Vanessa followed Gia, walking through strange desolate streets and passing through many barriers, and after travelling for nearly an hour, they finally arrived in front of a rundown house where no person should be living.
"You live here?" she asked, looking around. The succubus Queen couldn’t sense the presence of a single person around.
"Yes, hehe, just come with me inside, you will be surprised." Gia giggled. While travelling the two chatted about various things, and the young girl had completely relaxed already.
Nodding, Vanessa followed her into the house. It was full of garbage and rubble, but in the corner stairs could be seen which seemed to be barely holding on; they were leading underground.
Holding Vanessa’s hand, Gia pulled her towards the stairs, and the two walked nearly a hundred steps before finally arriving in a tunnel.
’So much security, the few succubus who had managed to escape must be living here.’ She thought, as they reached the end of the cave, a bright light hit her face.
Vanessa shut her eyes for a moment, then finally opened them.
Unlike her expectations, in front of her lay an enormous city with thousands of houses and a vast area. There was even a sky, even though this place was underground.
Knowing the concept of realms, Vanessa felt maybe that cave led her to a different realm. Still gazing in shock, wherever she looked, there were so many succubus.
"Welcome to my home, the city of Charms," Gia said with a big smile.

The Charms city originally used to be at least a hundred times bigger, almost like a big kingdom, but after that hunt—where everyone, whether humans, demons, or most other races tried to capture the succubus—only this city was left.
It was all thanks to the previous Succubus Queen who hid them all and made an agreement with the four emperors, as they were finally able to live in peace in this place.
There wasn’t a single man in sight, all of them were female.
"Uhm... If you want to enter and stay here, you should first meet up with our princess. She will punish me twice for sneaking out and bringing in a stranger," Gia said, looking troubled.

"Alright, lead me to her." Vanessa nodded, looking at the peaceful and beautiful city. Unlike what one would expect of the succubus race, they lived rather peacefully; it wasn’t a debauched area or anything.

First, Vanessa sent all the information back to Vritra while following the young girl. Her presence was already known by many in the city, and before long, she stood in front of a group of beautiful women.
All the women here were extremely charming, with small horns on their heads and long tails swinging on their backs.
"Introduce yourself," one of the warriors asked, looking vigilant.
They don’t really welcome strangers—one wrong move and all of them might just become a tool for others to grow stronger.
"I am a succubus..." Vanessa said and revealed her true appearance; as the others relaxed a bit, but upon sensing her presence they were surprised.
It had been so long since the death of the previous Queen for a new candidate to appear, and finally someone had arrived.
The warrior looked at Vanessa intently for a few seconds, then said: "Come with me to meet the princess."
Vanessa nodded; she was still taking in the shocking sight, but finally she would be able to know more about the succubus and progress faster.
After leaving the palace, Vritra, Onest, and Shitless headed towards the temple to meet up with Fiona and Diana.
Vritra had received the message from his mother and after taking the two women he planned to visit that place; if possible, the four of them could stay there for the time being.
With the extreme level of danger brewing around him, Vritra needed to get stronger even faster, though for now there weren’t many things he could think of.
Zihong inheritance was one of the places where he might increase his strength; aside from that, he could earn the Sin Points, but gaining levels normally was going to be quite difficult.
On his side, he could call those three demon generals, but bringing them will show his connection with the demons, which might increase the danger further.

’Wifey, if we were to return to the Dragon kingdom now, what are the chances of you getting your body back and taking charge of the dragons for now?’ Vritra asked; that seemed to be the only possible help he could get for now.

"Well, I am not sure how the dragon race’s condition is now, still we just might end up in more danger. We can try, but it won’t be easy, though if I can return to my peak, then all others wouldn’t just recklessly attack us."
Yasmine replied, fully aware that an even more extreme storm was brewing silently in the continent.
Nodding, he decided to infiltrate the dragon race as soon as possible; the dragon emperor was already here, so he was already the enemy of the dragons.
Soon the trio arrived at the temple. Onest and Shitless had perfectly hidden their faces.
"Darling~" Fiona, who was waiting outside, shook her hand and jumped into his arms with a big beautiful smile.
Diana slowly climbed down the stairs, somehow looking even more ethereal.

chapters.title: Chapter 372: The Succubus Princess
paragraphs: "You two need to change your appearance and stay in the temple, you would be much safer," Vritra said, looking at Shitless and Onest.
Though if they wanted to venture on their own in this new continent, they were free to do so.
"Alright, I am always ready for situations like these," Onest said, and using an appearance glyph, his appearance completely changed to that of a middle-aged man.
"..." Shitless hesitated, then took out the only appearance glyph in his possession and transformed into Sonia.
"Ohhh! Shit—you look beautiful," Onest said while laughing.
"Shut up, I am Sonia," Shitless said before asking, "How do we contact you in case of any emergency?"
"Just shout my name. If I am nearby I might come to check, though it would be better if you two could just settle together here in the temple," Vritra replied as he turned to leave.
He hoped they wouldn’t put themselves into too much trouble.

"How unexpected for a city of succubus to exist in the middle of Ghazi City. It is impossible that they could stay here without anyone knowing," Diana pondered as the three headed towards the city of Charms.
"Yeah, they must have formed some sort of agreement or possess something to stop others. Anyway, let’s go see that place," Vritra said.
They quickly arrived near the entrance of the rundown house.
Just as they started climbing down the stairs, they only saw endless darkness, and even after crossing a few hundred stairs they couldn’t arrive anywhere.
"Looks like this is a formation. We can break it, but it would be better if they welcome us on their own," Yasmine said, and Vritra contacted his mother.
Vanessa, at this moment, was meeting the princess, who was the younger sister of the late succubus empress.
After finding that Vanessa is an Empress candidate, the princess’s behaviour towards her became more respectful and warm.
While talking, Vanessa got to know many things.
The princess had long black hair and a doll-like face. She looked really beautiful and hot, dressed in a white dress, she looked quite graceful.
"Have you already formed a connection with a man?" the princess asked, narrowing her eyes.
"Yes." Vanessa nodded. She had finally understood what that feeling of being called was.
"Sigh. Who is it? Is he aware of your real identity?" the princess questioned, her brows furrowing.
Ever since they were forced to live in this small city and a lot of the succubus were captured or a few even killed, she had come to hate all other races, especially men.
"He is—Oh, he is here!" Vanessa said before asking, "Can you allow him inside?"
"..." The princess fell into contemplation. Vanessa seemed to trust this person a lot, but it might put them all at risk.
"Let’s first go meet him," the princess said, as she observed the stairs.
Her strength was nearly at the Lord rank, so if she didn’t want, there was no way anyone could enter.
Vanessa nodded and the two, along with several other succubus, made their way towards the entrance of the city.
Vritra, Diana, and Fiona were finally able to arrive in the cave. After walking for a while, they saw the beautiful sight of the city.
"Wow, so beautiful, is this a separate realm?" Fiona asked, her eyes sparkling as she looked at the vast city where thousands of beautiful women were present.
"Yes, though this is a weaker realm, with just one entrance. Still, this place is quite safe," Diana was the one to answer.
They waited and soon a group of women appeared in front of them. Vanessa felt quite happy upon seeing Vritra; she gave him a tight embrace and stood beside him.
"She is the princess..." Vanessa quickly told him a few important things.
"Hello Princess, it’s a pleasure meeting you," Vritra said. Although she looked really charming, he wasn’t affected.
"You wish to stay here?" The princess got directly to the point, looking at him with an unfriendly gaze.
"Well yeah, temporarily," Vritra nodded. For now, his main focus was increasing strength and somehow getting through this dangerous phase.
After staring into his eyes for a while, the princess stretched her right hand towards Vritra, with her palm facing up.
"Is there an entry fee?" he asked, looking at her palm then at her face.
"Haa. Give me your hand." Sighing, the princess held her anger.
"What? That’s a rather expensive fee—oh fine, fine, here you go." Vritra stopped joking and put his palm over her soft palm.
The princess closed her eyes and remained silent for a whole ten minutes.
Finally, she gave him another long, hard look before saying, "Fine, you three can stay here as well for now, but you would better be careful not to bring any trouble here."
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +589}
{Sin Point Gained: Liked +589}
{Sin Point Gained: Seduced +589}
"I will do my best," Vritra nodded seriously. He looked to the side and saw hundreds of succubus who had come out of their houses, as waves of sin points rushed in.
’This is a nice place to farm sin points, but let’s do that later.’ It was already getting late. First, they were brought to a house by one of the warriors.
Most of the women here had never seen men, so they kept looking at him with interest and something more...
A succubus’s lifespan is several centuries normally, as they level up they live even longer.
And when it comes to having a child, they don’t even need to get intimate with a man; through a skill they could absorb a man’s essence without even touching him, and could have the child.
Soon the four entered a nice spacious house. After arranging a few things, they had dinner.
Vritra planned to stay a couple of days there to know more about this place, before going to find the Zihong’s inheritance.
After dinner, they strolled casually over the streets. Without even doing anything, Vritra was gathering a lot of sin points.
In his original appearance, he looked exceptionally handsome, easily making these girls and women fall.
"Yes, this place is perfectly safe. Not only have they formed a contract with the emperors but the late succubus Queen had made some arrangements before passing away," Vanessa explained.
All the women bowed towards her respectfully; her status in this place was already equivalent to the princess.
"That’s good, but did you find anything else?" Vritra asked, as he and Yasmine carefully observed the surroundings and the people.
No matter what, it was impossible to just trust anyone.

"...Yeah, before the selection of any Queen there is a sort of test, which would also help me increase my strength tremendously," Vanessa added, slightly hesitant to tell him since it was a dangerous path.
"Oh, and what is the ’but’ here?" Vritra asked, knowing nothing could be so easy in this world.
"When the previous Succubus Queen entered, another candidate was there along with her.
Only one was able to survive, though when she came out her strength was a lot higher," Vanessa replied.
"..." After a brief silence, Vritra nodded and said, "Let’s first find out more about all this before coming to a decision."
To remove the tense atmosphere, after arriving at home, the group started intense group training like before.

"...Yeah, before the selection of any Queen there is a sort of test, which would also help me increase my strength tremendously," Vanessa added, slightly hesitant to tell him since it was a dangerous path.
"Oh, and what is the ’but’ here?" Vritra asked, knowing nothing could be so easy in this world.
"When the previous Succubus Queen entered, another candidate was there along with her.
Only one was able to survive, though when she came out her strength was a lot higher," Vanessa replied.
"..." After a brief silence, Vritra nodded and said, "Let’s first find out more about all this before coming to a decision."
To remove the tense atmosphere, after arriving at home, the group started intense group training like before.

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Raelion
paragraphs: Two days had passed since Yennefer met Vritra in the palace.
After the meeting of the six seats, she hadn’t found exactly what Oracle’s plan was.
She planned to move away from Ghazi City along with Vritra for the time being.
Even at her strength, she wasn’t confident to face all the people who were after Vritra currently.
But she didn’t know where exactly he had gone.
Just while she was searching for him, the empress received a message from the people of her family who were working for her.
"We have located the demon lord; she is badly injured and poisoned. We are currently chasing her," said the voice in the message.
Yennefer instantly dropped all her other tasks and headed towards them, a dangerous aura swirling around her body.
She hates all demons to the core, and this female demon lord even more, since she stole something very important, and she has been chasing her for so long yet that damned demon always slipped away.
"I won’t let you escape this time; you are going to die," Yennefer muttered. She was quite frustrated at her failure to catch her.
Shooting through the sky at full speed, it wasn’t long before she met up with the group of humans who were chasing after the gravely injured demon lord.
Running through the sky in front of the group was a Demon Queen in a red dress.
Her body was covered with blood; she had changed her appearance to that of an ordinary human.
Her pale skin was turning blue because of the poison, energy depleting rapidly, and before long her body would be completely paralyzed.
"What proud creatures, using sneak attacks and poison against an already injured demon," the demon Queen said in a mocking tone, barely avoiding the attacks.
"As if you pests need fair treatment. What’s wrong with killing you with your method?" one of the men said, grinning wildly.
This was Maeve Hale, one of the strongest Demon lords who had directly barged into Yennefer’s family house and stole one of their treasures.
Upon seeing Yennefer join the group, her heart sank, and the chances of her escape had reduced infinitely.
For so long now, she had been running all over the place just to escape from them, but despite using up all her abilities and tricks, she just couldn’t escape.
And now her body was so badly injured, especially the poison that, although won’t kill her in a short time, was making her body slower and slower.
Coughing out blood, Maeve pinched the air and left behind a cloud of greyish fog that barely proved to be a hindrance for her pursuers.
"..." Yennefer didn’t really care if the others had used any sneak attacks. When dealing with demons, what matters is that they should be killed at any cost.
BOOOOOM
Maeve’s body was blasted forward as Yennefer’s attack landed on her back.
Her already bad condition worsened as her vision began to darken and her strength weakened greatly.
Even her disguise began to slowly shatter, and her speed slowed down.
"Finally!!" Yennefer pushed her speed to the limit, aiming to destroy her head in a single strike.
The group of men rushing behind her had gloating expressions on their faces. It had been nearly a month since they had been running all over the place just to catch her.
The one who had inflicted the deadly poison on Maeve was already thinking what sort of reward he was going to get from the empress.
Using the last bit of her energy, Maeve brought both her hands close, forming strange patterns and then pulling them apart.
Instantly, a large domain made of beautiful but black flowers and deadly thorns circled around the group. It made all the men freeze in the air for a few seconds.
Yennefer might have been slightly affected had the demon Queen not been at the end of her rope. Gently slashing at the air with her hand, she cut the spherical domain in two.
Maeve only succeeded in creating a distance of a few meters in this duration, and the group caught up with her within moments.
’Tsk, I didn’t want to use this.’ Maeve was backed into the corner and was left with no other choice but to call for her asshole of a brother.
Just as several of the attacks were about to strike her body, a glyph appeared in her hand and, with a light squeeze, it shattered into countless pieces.

’I have to kill her now!’ Yennefer was determined to finish her off and take back her treasure. Ripples ran through the air and even the space quivered ever so slightly, as she gathered a vast amount of mana into her fists.
With this strike, Yennefer was sure that Maeve’s body would be torn to pieces.
But just then a voice rang out in front of the empress.
"Hello Dear, did you miss me?"
The attack that she had just sent hurtling towards Maeve was blocked as a black wall appeared in front of the group.
Then another demon lord appeared in front of them.
With two round horns on his head and greyish skin, he was over six feet tall and looked quite handsome—or so his mother used to say.

"Well, no hard feelings, I do love you but haa this time I will have to stop you, although half—but she is my sister and I do need to help her out in return of a promise. So why don’t we have a nice long chat?"
The demon named Raelion bowed, trying to look like a gentleman as he spoke.
Seeing him, Yennefer’s anger only flared up. She hates all demons but Raelion is definitely at the top of her list.
Knowing that the two were almost equally matched in strength, Yennefer didn’t attack immediately and allowed her group to chase after Maeve.
Raelion made no move; it wasn’t like he cared about his sister or anything, he just needed to hold back Yennefer for a while and his part of the deal would be complete.
"When did you get out of that gutter?" Frowning, Yennefer was ready to attack, wishing to kill the sibling right here and now.
"Aww, were you waiting for me? Those bastards trapped me in that... well gutter haha. You know how much I missed you? How about you give me a hug?"
Spreading his arms, he took a step towards Yennefer.
Only to be blasted away in the next moment. The empress looked at him with disgust, feeling frustrated that she couldn’t kill him.
At least, the others from her group were still chasing after Maeve and soon she would be captured.
Ever since seeing Yennefer several decades ago, like many men, Raelion was head over heels for her. The more disgust and hate she showed, the more determined he became to get her.
"Don’t you worry, I will get you away from that shitty emperor." Raelion said, but he knew there was no way he could defeat the human emperor.
"You are too late, I already have a man." Seeing Maeve and the group fly away, she stopped attacking and said with a smile full of rage.
Raelion didn’t get angry, after all he knew that between Emperor and her, it was nothing more than a sort of arrangement.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: The Demoness
paragraphs: "Ha! You mean that spineless emperor, don’t worry I will—" Raelion, of course, knew about that arrangement between them.
"No, I have got a man." Yennefer repeated, satisfaction filling her eyes as she watched the demon lord’s expression shift.
Along the side of her neck, where the milky skin was only faintly exposed, the demon lord noticed a subtle mark—barely visible, yet enough for him to understand its meaning.
His body shivered in rage and a deadly aura burst out of his body. The fact that someone else had touched and even gotten intimate with the woman he loves pissed him off completely.
"WHO WAS IT? TELL ME NOW, WHO IS THAT BASTARD?!!"
Raelion seemed to have gone mad. He was feeling exactly what the protagonist feels in the NTR genre.
Yennefer felt so satisfied; she ignored him and flew in a different direction.
He had always annoyed her and finally she got her revenge. Thankfully, the marks Vritra left on her body were still present, and he happened to see one.
’Haa Husband, where are you? I am already missing you...’ Yennefer had already thrown Raelion out of her mind.
She decided to continue her search for Vritra; the others could easily catch Maeve at this point.
As Yennefer flew away, Raelion was left there seething, feeling as if someone had made him wear a green hat.
He wanted to tear everything apart but knew he couldn’t linger around for too long.
He had never been this angry and sad in his life; his expressions were twisted as he disappeared, Yennefer’s words ringing in his ears.
’Whoever this man is, I am going to tear him limb to limb.’ Before leaving, he made a promise to himself.
Achoo!
Vritra sneezed while leaving the city of Charms. He had spent two days with the three women and got to know quite a bit about this place.
And it seemed this was just the perfect place for them now.
Diana was increasing her comprehension and doing all sorts of experiments, Fiona was also busy with her training, and Vanessa was the one who would benefit the most by staying there.
Although the princess couldn’t tell him more about that test, she assured that no matter what, Vanessa would be safe.
And since it was a way for her to get stronger and take the reign of the entire succubus race, of course Vanessa was going to do it; she wanted to protect her son after all.
Before Vritra had left, the princess had started to teach various things to Vanessa before she could start the test.
The news of Vritra staying in that city travelled on the first day, and quite a lot of succubus came to watch the new residents, especially Vritra.
"I wonder if someone is thinking about me." Vritra wondered, rubbing his nose.
"Yes certainly, you have quite a lot of passionate enemies after all, who must only be thinking about you day and night ignoring their sleep and food."
Yasmine joked, as they once again arrived in the bustling streets of Ghazi City.
Taking out the scroll mentioning the ten places where the Zihong’s inheritance could possibly be, Vritra decided to check them all one by one.
Two were in Ghazi City while the rest were outside.
"Let’s check this out first." Vritra mumbled and put away the scroll. If one skill could make Zihong such a legend, then he certainly needed to get it.
"My strength has recovered to almost the fourth Legion rank by now, sigh it feels like I am starting leveling up from the beginning." Yasmine muttered; even this growth felt slow to her.
’Maybe we should empty the treasury here too; there must be a whole lot of soul potions here.’ Vritra pondered, though he knew it was going to be extremely difficult.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
While the two chatted, he entered the dimensional book and flew at full speed. Getting that skill wasn’t going to be easy even if he found it; otherwise, others could have already gotten it.
It wasn’t long before Vritra arrived near the boundary of the city.
There was a cave inside the forest. Vritra carefully entered and after walking for nearly twenty minutes, he arrived in a vast space that was filled with all sorts of snakes.
There lay thousands of snakes from tiny to enormous, a perfect place for all the nature lovers and ex.
Marking this place off his list, Vritra then moved towards the second location but similarly couldn’t find anything.
Then he flew out of the city, always careful to hide his presence to the best of his ability, even his dragon waifu helped.
"And here comes the third location." Yasmine announced as Vritra landed in front of yet another cave.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
"Hm? This cave has humans inside, are they here to explore as well?" Yasmine wondered.
There were nearly ten people inside the cave and they certainly weren’t there for a picnic.
’Yeah, maybe others are looking for that skill as well. Anyway, let’s check it out.’ Vritra ignored those humans and walked inside, completely unnoticed.
Soon he walked out in disappointment yet again. Without wasting a moment he headed towards the next location.
Soon they were at the fourth location.
After scanning it from outside, Vritra headed inside.
After an hour, he came back, a frown on his face. God knows what sort of creature lived there, but it smelled extremely bad.
"Haa it seems searching for that skill might be the most difficult part of it." Vritra said as he flew up, before heading towards the next location.
A few kilometres from there, the injured Maeve was flying aimlessly, barely keeping herself alive as the humans chased after her and kept attacking.
She scanned her surroundings, and all of a sudden changed her direction, pushing the space behind with every bit of her remaining strength.
Even her mind had stopped to work properly at this moment, but she wasn’t going to give up easily.
Maeve saw a familiar man, someone she had seen not long ago in the White kingdom along with the empress.
Someone who could make the empress express such emotions and expressions was certainly not ordinary and was definitely quite important.
So she decided to gamble; her life and death depended on this last attempt.
Gathering every bit of strength she could, the demon queen rushed towards the ordinary-looking human.
It was Ben from the White kingdom, or rather, Vritra who was busy chatting with his wife and just minding his own business.
"!!!" Vritra sensed several presences heading in his direction. He paused in the air for a moment and looked back.
A woman whose body was covered in blood and whose appearance looked quite strange, as if her disguise was only half complete, was flying towards him at a fast speed.
’Why is this giving me a feeling of déjà vu?’ he wondered, remembering the time the empress had charged towards him.

Vritra wasn’t planning to get involved needlessly in others’ affairs but just as he was about to disappear into his dimensional book, a faint pink cloud surrounded him and made his head muddled for a couple of seconds.
"Stop her!!" the men shouted, trying to catch up with that burst of speed.
When Vritra returned to his senses, Maeve was exactly in front of him, her glowing eyes looking into his for a moment and then...
BITE!

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Surprise Surprise
paragraphs: Although Vritra’s body was nearly invincible currently, his mental defenses weren’t as strong. The moment his body was clouded by the fog, his mind became muddled.
Even Yasmine, with her limited strength, wasn’t able to react as fast. Even though wounded, Maeve was still a demon lord.
Getting close to Vritra, after a brief pause, she opened her mouth wide, displaying her vampire-like fangs, and then bit Vritra’s neck.
Maeve was shocked to find that her fangs failed to pierce his skin, but using some sort of ability, she drew a few drops of Vritra’s blood and gulped them down.
GULP
As Vritra’s mind became clear, he sensed the faint sensation of her bite on his neck. There was no pain, but it felt like something had touched a vein.
[Blood Life Pact has been established.]
A message flashed before his eyes, surprising Vritra, as he pulled back from Maeve.
Yasmine spoke before Vritra could ask: "This is a form of life pact in which if one party dies, then the other will die as well. It means if she dies, you will die as well."
’Uh...’ it all happened so fast that Vritra had no time to think. Then Yasmine added: "Well, to remove it, either your strength should be higher than hers, or only she can remove it."
’Didn’t I possess two lives? Maybe even if she dies, I will be able to survive?’ Vritra thought, his mind working at full speed.
He referred to the two hearts beating in his chest.
"That might work, but this is no time for experiments. Tsk, we have to first move to a safe location." Yasmine replied. All this conversation hadn’t even taken a moment.
As the group of men got closer, they saw Vritra and the weakened demon queen.
"Catch them both." The man in the lead, whose fangs were full of deadly poison, shouted.
Whether Vritra had any relation to the demons or not didn’t matter, they would rather kill a thousand innocents than let one demon escape.
"S- Save me..." Maeve muttered, looking at Vritra through her blurry vision, then her body went completely limp and she fell unconscious.
"Fuck!" Vritra felt so angry, he really wanted to just kick that demoness.
"Well, this might not be as bad. She is a demon lord and has countless tricks and a strong network.
So if she survives, we might as well be able to use her, remember Nihil-anima." Yasmine reminded, and finally Vritra relaxed a bit.
He floated forward and wrapped an arm around Maeve’s waist before pulling her into a princess-carry style, then he looked at the group of men.
Many of them were at the rank of generals, while a couple of them were even above it. Without revealing his demonic side, it wouldn’t be easy to kill them, so for now it was better not to fight.

"I am giving you all three moments worth of time, disappear from my sight or you will regret it for the rest of your one minute long life." Vritra said provocatively, standing confidently in front of the group with Maeve in his arms.
"How dare you?! With that meager strength, you dare to threaten us? Do you even know who we are?
The empress will be here soon; surrender while we are still giving you the chance." The man didn’t attack Vritra, as the group stopped a few meters from him.
The man in the green robe, his long nails dripping with poison, wondered what was giving Vritra so much confidence.
He looked around cautiously but there was no one around; maybe he was using some sort of formation or glyphs.
"One!" Vritra didn’t care about their words, as he began to count.
"..." the group became even more vigilant, activating their defensive skills and items, ready to defend against whatever Vritra planned to do.
"Two!" he said. For some reason, his three moments were exceptionally big.
Their foreheads creased and they took a step back, wondering why hasn’t the empress caught up yet.
All the men stared at Vritra, their bodies tensing up.
"Three!!" After saying the last count loudly, Vritra took a step forward, making the group tremble collectively.

"Surprise, surprise motherfuckers, fools to the very end!"
While speaking he spread his arms, as Maeve turned into smoke and disappeared, then he added: "How truly pitiful your parents are, they must be crying in a corner after giving birth—"
The green-robed man let out a furious roar as he charged forward and pierced his hand through Vritra’s chest, his body shivering in rage.
But a mocking smile remained on Vritra’s face as his figure slowly crumbled into dust.
"What just happened? Who was that?" he screamed.
"T- That was Rich, but the real Rich was in the palace, so it might be someone fake." Someone in the group answered.
Without anyone in the group noticing, Vritra had trapped them all inside the Dimensional Book and used Misty Essence mythic halo to completely fool them all.
Flying away at full speed, Vritra chuckled seeing their reactions.
He had left them trapped in a page and fled right after, and he had hidden his face the moment he sensed someone around.
"Well, that was easier than expected." He mumbled, then looking down at the unconscious demon queen in his arms he wondered where he could bring her.
The succubus princess certainly wouldn’t allow a demon lord in her city, so returning there wasn’t an option.
So he found a cave, took out a bed, put down Maeve on it and then covered the surroundings so that no one would be able to find them.
"That should be enough..." After doing all the necessary work, he looked at the demon queen, whose camouflage had already disappeared and her real appearance was visible now.
She possessed a warrior-like strong physique, with perfect curves and milky skin. Despite the slight muscles, her body looked quite soft and voluptuous.
Her thighs looked especially thick and her large pair of breasts made her look really seductive.
There was a fox-like tail on her back and two ears over her head. Despite her body being covered in blackish blood, she looked absolutely gorgeous.
Her pale skin had turned slightly bluish because of the poison.

"Haa, look at her innocent face, who would say this is a mindless demon." Vritra mumbled with a shake of his head. On the basis of appearance, she certainly wouldn’t be ranked below Yasmine or Yennefer.
Since demons aren’t counted in the beauty list, that’s why she wasn’t mentioned.
"Now, let’s start." Vritra rubbed his palms together as he walked closer to the unconscious Maeve.
He sat beside her and then placed his palm over her chest, touching her blood-soaked clothes.
"Kyaa Hubby, I didn’t know you were this naughty. Don’t worry, I am not looking, so you can start hehe." As usual, Yasmine said in a teasing tone.
"Wifey, don’t you worry, I am keeping perfect count of the spanks you will be getting soon." Vritra said, trying to focus at the boob at hand—cough, task at hand.
"Umu, how am I going to command the dragons and support you if I wouldn’t even be able to sit on the throne?" She added.

sentences.text: Although Vritra’s body was nearly invincible currently, his mental defenses weren’t as strong.
The moment his body was clouded by the fog, his mind became muddled.
Even Yasmine, with her limited strength, wasn’t able to react as fast.
Even though wounded, Maeve was still a demon lord.
Getting close to Vritra, after a brief pause, she opened her mouth wide, displaying her vampire-like fangs, and then bit Vritra’s neck.

GULP

She is a demon lord and has countless tricks and a strong network.
So if she survives, we might as well be able to use her, remember Nihil-anima." Yasmine reminded, and finally Vritra relaxed a bit.

Many of them were at the rank of generals, while a couple of them were even above it.
Without revealing his demonic side, it wouldn’t be easy to kill them, so for now it was better not to fight.

With that meager strength, you dare to threaten us?
Do you even know who we are?
The empress will be here soon; surrender while we are still giving you the chance." The man didn’t attack Vritra, as the group stopped a few meters from him.

He looked around cautiously but there was no one around; maybe he was using some sort of formation or glyphs.

"..." the group became even more vigilant, activating their defensive skills and items, ready to defend against whatever Vritra planned to do.
