chapters.title: Chapter 376: The Bargain
paragraphs: In the Midnight Party, the biggest black market in the continent, located near the inner boundary of Ghazi City.
A pair of same-looking men could be seen quarrelling with a shopkeeper to lower the price of a candy.
The twins were none other than the two seats of the Golden Moon, Tin and Vin. Just as the Oracle had instructed, they had come to the black market.
"I am only going to give 3 copper coins for this," Vin said, holding his head up high proudly; he was the self-proclaimed master of bargaining.
"Sigh, sir, this thing costs 50 copper coins, how can I sell it to you for so cheap?" The shopkeeper said in frustration.
The two were wearing expensive clothes but were arguing just for a few copper coins.
They had a height a bit above five feet and seemed to be in their late twenties. Both of them had a handprint on each of their cheeks.
"I only have ten copper coins, what can you sell for that much?"
Vin continued, while Tin sighed, feeling embarrassed as quite a few people began laughing at the two.
His stupid brother had just wasted hundreds of gold coins just to travel a little in a carriage, and here he was fighting.
"Ah, for ten copper coins? I have this newly built ten copper worth of coin," the shopkeeper said, taking out a coin with the number ten written on it.
It was difficult to carry too many coins for normal people, so later on the currency had changed into this form.
"Hmm, I will give you 2 coins for it," Vin said, seriously.
"Sigh, here, you can have it for free, may god bless you," the shopkeeper said, as if giving the coin to a beggar.
Finally, the twins walked away.
"Hehe, did you see my bargaining skills? I got this coin for absolutely nothing. Did you see how those girls were smiling at me?" Vin spoke happily.
"Haa, that’s not bargaining but begging no matter how you look at it, and those girls were laughing at you."

Tin corrected, slapping his younger brother’s head before adding, "Anyway, I wonder why the Oracle had sent us both here. Even if Vritra is here, with his ability to disguise, it would be almost impossible to find him."
"Yeah, I wonder—oh wait, look, the Green Claw Poison master! Kwahaha, look at his face as if he had been constipated for three whole days."
The twins saw the man in the green robe who had been chasing after Maeve and leading the group.
After getting fooled by Vritra, they were extremely angry. Breaking out of that small realm wasn’t hard, since their strength was higher than Vritra’s.
But upon getting out, they weren’t able to find Maeve or the person who helped her. Not to mention when they met with the empress, she was so angry that she had given them all harsh punishments.
"Yo, Lizard! Where are you sneaking off to?" Tin shouted loudly, finally finding something interesting to do.
Poison Claw looked back and shivered at the sight, knowing fully well how troublesome the duo is, so he first tried to act ignorant and rushed forward.
"Hey, don’t act like you didn’t see us. Didn’t we become good friends when we made your toilet explode just as you had started doing your business there?
Haha, I still remember, you walked in such a funny manner at that time." Tin and Vin put their arms over his shoulder and decided to have fun.
"Ah, S-Sir, I am sorry but I need to do some urgent work for empress, s-so..." he spoke but knew fully well that it was of no use.
And so the trio walked deeper into the market.
With his hand pressed against Maeve’s chest just a bit above her breasts, Vritra sent the invisible flames into her body.
It would be great to have a demon lord as his servant.
"It seems my physique isn’t exactly invincible; although it didn’t hurt me, she was able to draw my blood. So there might be some other limitations. I wonder what ability she used."
Vritra wondered to himself while letting Nihil Anima move towards her soul.
"This high of a defense is already an anomaly, especially at your level. Anyway, I wonder how long this is going to take," Yasmine muttered.

A few minutes passed, but before the invisible flame could make contact with Maeve’s soul, it was stopped by some sort of barrier. Vritra frowned and used more energy, but the result was still the same.
Unlike the Misty Essence, Nihil Anima still hadn’t recovered to its peak; its strength wasn’t even at ten percent right now, just like Yasmine.
And so Vritra failed to turn her into a slave.
"Tch, looks like she has some sort of treasure to protect her soul, what a pity." Yasmine frowned. Aside from this method, she couldn’t think of anything else to remove that pact.
Just then, Maeve’s eyes fluttered open and her gaze focused on the handsome man in front of her, then at his hand that was pressed against her chest.
"Huff, what are you... haa... doing?" Despite being weak, she asked in an enraged tone.
"Well, I was planning to give you CPR, but it seems there is no need now. Anyway, why don’t you remove that pact now?" Vritra said as he pulled back his hand slowly.
Maeve took a deep breath; she felt incredibly angry being touched by a mere human. If not for her condition, she would have killed him already.
"Hoo, I can’t right now, first huff help me get rid of this poison. If I die y-you will die with me."
She said, although the poison won’t be able to kill her soon, but she would be completely paralyzed.
Although she could contact the demons or even her brother, there is no way she could trust just anyone in this condition.
This time Vritra frowned; he didn’t want to be used by others just like that.

"Why should I? I have a potion that would put your body in a coma and decrease the speed of poison, and by the time you would be about to die, my strength would already be high enough to sever this pact." Vritra said confidently.
Maeve didn’t trust every word he said, but right now she was just too weak and this unknown man truly was her last option. Gritting her teeth, she knew she would have to compromise.
"F-Fine, if you help me recover and hide, I will let you choose two things from all the treasures I possess." Maeve proposed, though her eyes were full of anger.
Vritra pondered and then suggested a better offer:
"Hmm, how about you give me all your treasures? The risk here is high and what are you going to do with those treasures if you are dead?"
"How about I bite my tongue and die?" Maeve became angrier at his shameless proposal.
"Fine, how about five things?" Knowing the arrogance of all the strong beings, Vritra decided to lower his fees.
"...Okay, but first we need to move away from here, they might sense me and you—"
Maeve paused, as if contemplating over an extremely difficult choice, then she said with immense difficulty, "You have to help me clean my body of this poison and blood, or they could track me."

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Foxie
paragraphs: After meeting up with Raelion, Yennefer searched for Vritra for a while, then went to meet the Green Claw and the group.
But unlike her expectations, that bunch of men failed to capture Maeve yet again even though she was in that bad condition.
Giving them all appropriate punishments, Yennefer began to return to the palace; she needed to inform everything about the return of Raelion.
Although his strength wasn’t threatening for the emperor and others, he was one of the most troublesome demon lords.
She had to let others know before he destroyed a city or two.
Upon arriving back at the palace, Yennefer found that the emperor and Han Gratt had returned from the meeting with the other emperors.

’I almost forgot, that announcement had threatened even the emperors, so they must be planning some way to catch husband too.’ Yennefer thought, shaking her head at the level of trouble Vritra was in.
While delivering the news, she decided to get some information.
She walked into the large hall where the emperor and Han were present.
On the throne sat a man wearing leather clothes made from the skin of a Lord-level beast.
After reaching the 10th Legion rank, a person reaches the General rank, while the rank high above it is referred to as the Lord rank.
With long brown hair fluttering, the emperor possessed sharp features like a man who is always suspicious, and a body full of strong muscles.

They were discussing the matter of a search; when Han saw Yennefer, he smiled but soon became neutral. The emperor named Darius Ford also smiled upon seeing her; it was like his entire personality had changed.
"Empress, I was waiting for you, join us on this important discussion," he said, standing up and extending his hand towards Yennefer.
Ignoring him, she took a seat away from the emperor and asked: "What important discussion?"
"You remember that announcement; I just found out Vritra is already in this city. And we have started the search." Darius said, his presence alone made all the people in the palace tense up.
Darius was a great emperor who used force and rewards perfectly; the people of the continent were afraid of him but also liked him to some extent.
The reason why demons hadn’t made any move was especially because of him; his strength was just that high.
"Is that all? For someone with such a high threat level, will that be enough?" she asked casually.
"Hah, as expected of the woman I chose, you know me perfectly, sigh it’s been so long; don’t you think we should now get married?" Darius said, his tone becoming unbefitting of an emperor.
"No, it is not time yet." Shaking her head, she refused outright, then added: "I met Raelion today, he has returned."
"What?! That crazy demon, the last time he came, he almost succeeded in exploding half of the continent. We have to get rid of him before he does something again." Han said angrily.
Darius finally turned serious; he stretched his hand and a man from the shadows emerged carrying a tray. Picking up the wine glass from it, he spoke:
"Hmm if only we can bring him out of his hole, but I wonder how we make it work."
After thinking for a few moments, he hid a smirk and suggested: "Right, he is obsessed with you, empress, so if he hears that you are getting married, even if he knows it’s a trap he will come out."
Yennefer frowned, knowing fully well Darius’s nature. Every once in a while, he would spread such rumors across the land to put pressure on her to marry him.
"No, I am sure there is some other way—" Yennefer obviously refused; if it was before, then she wouldn’t mind but now she didn’t want Vritra to misunderstand.
But the emperor interrupted: "It’s not like we are having a real wedding or anything. Let’s organise a small party and spread the rumour about our wedding.
I am sure he will come out on his own, and that is when we kill Raelion. Don’t you want to kill the despicable, hateful, disgusting demon?"
He said, knowing fully well her obsession with slaughtering demons.
Yennefer was torn between the two choices; she didn’t want to upset Vritra but also didn’t want to miss this chance to kill or at least severely injure one of the demon lords.
After a long pause, she nodded.
"Fine, spread this news, but don’t try anything else or I will break our agreement," Yennefer said emotionlessly and she left the hall.

’It will be fine, I just need to inform Vritra about this arrangement.’ Yennefer reasoned with herself, though she did have a bad feeling about this, but how could she miss even a chance of killing a demon.
’But where exactly are you?’
"Oh so Foxie needs a bath? Sure." Vritra nodded and smiled, then bringing a bucket full of water from his inventory, he poured it all down on her body.
Maeve was baffled as the cold water fell on her body; she was so angry that she really wanted to kill him immediately.
"Anything else you want me to do?" he asked, enjoying her reaction.
"You- how dare you?" she shouted, breathing heavily, right now her body was weaker than an average human.
"Oh, did our little Foxie get angry? Here I have got a tonic for you; wanna drink it?" Vritra asked, pulling out a potion.
If he could he would have certainly put her into a coma and increased his strength but it was just a bluff just to scare her.
Maeve shut her mouth; she controlled her anger and said: "Fine, I will behave until our deal is done, so—"
ACHOO!
Maeve had started to shiver, as cold crept into her body; she had never felt this vulnerable.
Her teeth chattered and her body shivered; in a shaky voice she spoke: "H- Help me..."
"Now, how do you want me to help you?" Vritra asked, crossing his arms but his senses warned him about some sort of danger.
"I- Change my... clothes." Maeve was feeling as if she would freeze to death, although it was humiliating but in her condition she had no choice but to beg for his help.
Though her body repulsed at the thought of getting naked in front of a stranger, she was a respected demon lord, but was reduced to this state now.
"Oh sure, but you see I will have to charge you extra for that; how about six treasures? Also show me you do have good treasures, I don’t want to be scammed," Vritra said, as he got ready to leave.
"F-Fine, just help me." She said, her voice becoming weaker; this poison had made her way too weak.
Just as Vritra was about to speak, a loud heart-wrenching scream rang from deep within the cave.
Only now did he remember that this was also one of the caves that he needed to check for Zihong’s inheritance.
An extreme sense of danger permeated from deep inside the cave; strange noises of countless blades striking, churning rang out.
The screams of the humans disappeared one by one, until only the screeching of metal remained.
"Well well, we are just in luck. Looks like you will have to wait a little longer, Foxie, I will be back ASAP."

On the throne sat a man wearing leather clothes made from the skin of a Lord-level beast.
After reaching the 10th Legion rank, a person reaches the General rank, while the rank high above it is referred to as the Lord rank.
With long brown hair fluttering, the emperor possessed sharp features like a man who is always suspicious, and a body full of strong muscles.
They were discussing the matter of a search; when Han saw Yennefer, he smiled but soon became neutral.
The emperor named Darius Ford also smiled upon seeing her; it was like his entire personality had changed.
"Empress, I was waiting for you, join us on this important discussion," he said, standing up and extending his hand towards Yennefer.
Ignoring him, she took a seat away from the emperor and asked: "What important discussion?"
"You remember that announcement; I just found out Vritra is already in this city.
And we have started the search." Darius said, his presence alone made all the people in the palace tense up.
Darius was a great emperor who used force and rewards perfectly; the people of the continent were afraid of him but also liked him to some extent.
The reason why demons hadn’t made any move was especially because of him; his strength was just that high.
"Is that all?
For someone with such a high threat level, will that be enough?" she asked casually.
"Hah, as expected of the woman I chose, you know me perfectly, sigh it’s been so long; don’t you think we should now get married?" Darius said, his tone becoming unbefitting of an emperor.
"No, it is not time yet." Shaking her head, she refused outright, then added: "I met Raelion today, he has returned."
"What?!
That crazy demon, the last time he came, he almost succeeded in exploding half of the continent.
We have to get rid of him before he does something again." Han said angrily.
Darius finally turned serious; he stretched his hand and a man from the shadows emerged carrying a tray.
Picking up the wine glass from it, he spoke:
"Hmm if only we can bring him out of his hole, but I wonder how we make it work."
After thinking for a few moments, he hid a smirk and suggested: "Right, he is obsessed with you, empress, so if he hears that you are getting married, even if he knows it’s a trap he will come out."
Yennefer frowned, knowing fully well Darius’s nature.
Every once in a while, he would spread such rumors across the land to put pressure on her to marry him.
"No, I am sure there is some other way—" Yennefer obviously refused; if it was before, then she wouldn’t mind but now she didn’t want Vritra to misunderstand.
But the emperor interrupted: "It’s not like we are having a real wedding or anything.
Let’s organise a small party and spread the rumour about our wedding.
I am sure he will come out on his own, and that is when we kill Raelion.
Don’t you want to kill the despicable, hateful, disgusting demon?"
He said, knowing fully well her obsession with slaughtering demons.
Yennefer was torn between the two choices; she didn’t want to upset Vritra but also didn’t want to miss this chance to kill or at least severely injure one of the demon lords.
After a long pause, she nodded.
"Fine, spread this news, but don’t try anything else or I will break our agreement," Yennefer said emotionlessly and she left the hall.

’It will be fine, I just need to inform Vritra about this arrangement.’ Yennefer reasoned with herself, though she did have a bad feeling about this, but how could she miss even a chance of killing a demon.
’But where exactly are you?’
"Oh so Foxie needs a bath?
Sure." Vritra nodded and smiled, then bringing a bucket full of water from his inventory, he poured it all down on her body.
Maeve was baffled as the cold water fell on her body; she was so angry that she really wanted to kill him immediately.
"Anything else you want me to do?" he asked, enjoying her reaction.
"You- how dare you?" she shouted, breathing heavily, right now her body was weaker than an average human.
"Oh, did our little Foxie get angry?
Here I have got a tonic for you; wanna drink it?" Vritra asked, pulling out a potion.
If he could he would have certainly put her into a coma and increased his strength but it was just a bluff just to scare her.
Maeve shut her mouth; she controlled her anger and said: "Fine, I will behave until our deal is done, so—"
ACHOO!
Maeve had started to shiver, as cold crept into her body; she had never felt this vulnerable.
Her teeth chattered and her body shivered; in a shaky voice she spoke: "H- Help me..."
"Now, how do you want me to help you?" Vritra asked, crossing his arms but his senses warned him about some sort of danger.
"I- Change my... clothes." Maeve was feeling as if she would freeze to death, although it was humiliating but in her condition she had no choice but to beg for his help.
Though her body repulsed at the thought of getting naked in front of a stranger, she was a respected demon lord, but was reduced to this state now.
"Oh sure, but you see I will have to charge you extra for that; how about six treasures?
Also show me you do have good treasures, I don’t want to be scammed," Vritra said, as he got ready to leave.
"F-Fine, just help me." She said, her voice becoming weaker; this poison had made her way too weak.
Just as Vritra was about to speak, a loud heart-wrenching scream rang from deep within the cave.
Only now did he remember that this was also one of the caves that he needed to check for Zihong’s inheritance.
An extreme sense of danger permeated from deep inside the cave; strange noises of countless blades striking, churning rang out.
The screams of the humans disappeared one by one, until only the screeching of metal remained.
"Well well, we are just in luck.
Looks like you will have to wait a little longer, Foxie, I will be back ASAP."

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Femme Fatale
paragraphs: Vritra paused upon hearing the pain-filled screams. He tried scanning the deeper part of the cave but failed.
"Well, Foxie, guess you will have to wait for a while. Make sure to not die from the cold," Vritra said, getting ready to go deeper.
"M-My name is... haa haa... Maeve," she corrected, getting irritated by the word Foxie. If he left, then she might really die because of the cold.
"W-Wait, help me...ugh...please..." the demoness pleaded, though growing angrier inside.
’T-This darned human, I am going to—’ but she stopped herself from having any bad thoughts and accidentally releasing killing intent.
"Haa, fine." Vritra agreed and approached the drenched Maeve. Luckily, he had spare clothes that belonged to Vanessa.
Maeve’s clothes were already in a very bad state, so Vritra directly tore her clothes and threw them away until she lay naked in front of him.
His eyes first moved to her pale but beautiful face before moving down across her body—her ample breasts, her smooth buttery skin; her thick thighs were squeezed tightly, hiding her petals.
Finally, his eyes locked onto her tail.
Feeling his gaze on her bare skin, breasts, and down there, Maeve felt embarrassed. For the first time in her life, she felt so exposed.
"Wow, your tail is so soft." Vritra held her tail gently, caressing it as Maeve felt a shiver run through her body.
"Ahh! L-Let go..." she spoke with difficulty, feeling his fingers rub against her tail, as if electric current was coursing through her body.
Vritra ignored her words, squeezing and caressing her tail, as Maeve’s body twisted slightly and she released strange noises.
She was fuming inside but could do nothing but let him humiliate her. If it was before, anyone who dared to stare at her for too long would have his head cut off.
After a couple of minutes, Vritra finally stopped after having his fill, then he took out Vanessa’s clothes and slowly put them over her body.
"Are you feeling better now?" Vritra asked. Now that she was all washed up and dressed, Maeve looked quite devilishly beautiful—though a bit less than when she was completely naked.
’Just you wait, once I get better I will pay you back for everything,’ Maeve thought, but she tried her best to hold back her emotions and nodded.
’So cold, why did he have to throw such cold water at me?’ She really wanted to throw him into an ice-cold sea.
"Then wait here for me. I will be back after exploring this place," Vritra said as he turned and began to walk into the cave.
"No, don’t leave...haa...behind...p-please," Maeve called out, using every bit of her willpower to speak out.
Right now, even a child would be able to kill her—or, rather, her physical body. Her soul would be able to escape, but still she would be quite vulnerable.

Vritra rolled his eyes and decided to bring her along. It was a risk for his own life as well to leave her behind after all. And when he needed to fight, he could just put her in the dimensional book without letting her notice anything.
Moving towards the bed, he picked Maeve up and threw her over his shoulder.
"Oww! You will hurt me like this," she complained, though meekly.
Vritra almost threw her away, but taking a long breath, he moved the demoness to his back.
Her chin rested over his shoulder, and to make her stable he even tied a cloth, tightening it as her soft boobs squished against his back, with her legs wrapped around his waist.
"Are you fine now?" he asked. With his strength, carrying her like this wouldn’t be a problem; he just had to be careful not to accidentally kill her.
"Mmm," she hummed, closing her eyes. With her body pressed against his so tightly, she could feel his body heat which felt quite nice, so she relaxed on his back.
"Be careful, hubby, of the challenges inside and this fox. You know foxes have the habit of stabbing in the back. But don’t worry, I will keep a close eye on her," Yasmine said.
’Thank you wifey, I will be leaving my back to you.’
Then he began to venture into the dark cave, the sound of blades churning still going strong.
TIP TIP
From several places, water drops kept dripping onto the ground, but strangely there was no collected water, though the walls were painted red.
Vritra had just walked twenty or so meters when one of the drops fell over his shoulder.
Instantly, the land under his feet disappeared, arrows at extreme speed were shot out from the walls on both sides, aiming directly at his head.
And Vritra only now noticed that flying in this region was somehow prohibited.
But he stood unmoved over a small disc made of dust, with one hand gripping Maeve’s fleshy thigh, he caught all the arrows that were about to hit him easily.
"Oh, what kind of place is this? And I forgot to ask, what is your name?" Maeve asked, her comfortable rest broken by the sound of arrows.
Throwing the arrows away, Vritra began to walk forward; as he moved, ground began to form under his feet.
"I am Ben Tennyson, protector of the universe and wielder of—" but before he could speak, his words were cut off as countless balls were launched towards him from the front.
Vritra’s body turned to dust as the balls just passed through him and struck behind, causing the area to rot and burn.
But then he felt that he had missed something, as Maeve’s scream rang out. He finally remembered the demoness who was falling into the darkness.
"Oh, why are you in such a hurry?" Vritra caught her and once again put her on his back, before tightly tying the cloth.
"Haa haa, y-you did that knowingly!" Maeve said, and now she understood who exactly was in power here; without even killing her he could do so much.
"Ah, sorry, I forgot about the demon Queen who forcefully formed a life-death pact with me."
Vritra once again continued, but the deeper he was going the more difficult the challenges were becoming.
It was like this place was testing his limits, and after walking nearly two kilometres, hundreds of strange insects flew towards him.
Vritra had to take them seriously, since Yasmine informed him just how dangerous those things could be.
On his back, Maeve was just relaxing and enjoying the warmth of his body; it felt quite nice. She took a few sniffs and smelled something fragrant and sweet.
Unknowingly, a strong thirst for his blood filled her body; as her lips moved closer to his neck, Maeve could only slightly shift her body.

’How strange, humans and demons’ blood smell so foul—but why does his blood smell so darn good?’ She gulped her saliva and couldn’t hold on any longer, parting her pink moist lips, she bit his skin with her fangs.
"Mmm," but unlike before she couldn’t draw out any blood, no matter how much she tried to bite or suck his neck, since she couldn’t use her abilities.
"What are you doing?" Vritra was cutting the insects with a sword when he felt Maeve biting and sucking at his neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: A good person...
paragraphs: Maeve finally came to her senses and pulled her lips away from his neck, then acted asleep.
This day couldn’t get any weirder; she couldn’t believe that as a powerful and feared Demon Queen, she was reduced to this state.
Vritra continued into the cave, only after killing those insects was he finally able to arrive at the door of Zihong’s inheritance.
Right after entering, a strong stench of blood assaulted their senses; the ground was full of flesh and organs, and Vritra clearly sensed that he had just stepped into a different realm.
In this realm, there were several restrictions, like on space, time, and many others.
Just at the moment he stepped into Zihong’s realm, a wave of mental and soul attack landed on his body, almost making him stumble.
The attack wasn’t strong enough to injure his soul, but it almost made him faint. Maeve came out of her intoxication and asked with worry: "Are you alright?"
After all, if Vritra died then she would die as well—soul, body, and mind, everything would be destroyed. That’s why she only used that pact as her last resort.
"...Yeah." Vritra straightened up after a few seconds; it was obvious this inheritance had been probing for his limits and weaknesses.
Looking ahead, he saw countless stairs leading upwards. The stairs were made of wood and all of them had strange patterns carved on them that kept changing rapidly.
After a few seconds, they paused and a few stairs had similar patterns that only slightly changed as they moved above while others were completely different.
But Vritra’s main focus was on the messages flashing before his eyes.
[Mutamorphis Activated.]
[Sensing the surrounding...]
[Soul damage detected.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
His soul was already quite strong after drinking all those soul potions, but with this who knows how much it could improve.
Having a strong soul could also be a deadly weapon; if he could just erase the soul of an opponent, then eradicating him would just be a matter of moments.

"It seems they might show what kind of attack we will be facing on each step," Maeve said. She was feeling a little better now. If she hadn’t swallowed that small amount of Vritra’s blood, she would still be unconscious.
For her, it was the most delicious treat possible.

"And this place has found your weakness—your soul and mental strength—so it will certainly be targeting those. Just what is this place?" she questioned, after all, anyone who could create it should have very high strength and a lot of time.
"Well, it’s an inheritance." Vritra said as he approached the stairs, readying himself for the pain.
"I can try blocking the mental and soul attacks; after all, only my physical body is weak. What do you think?"
Maeve asked, barely focusing on the challenge ahead; she felt quite comfortable on his back, her tail swinging as if dancing to a rhythm.
"Yes, but only block around 30% of the soul attack and completely block the mental attack for now," Vritra said as he stopped in front of the stairs.
"Okay, uhm... in return can you give me a l-little of your blood?" Maeve asked; she knew it was humiliating to act like this but the thirst for blood was just that strong.
"Sure, that is, if you can draw it out." Vritra shrugged, and Maeve created two barriers around him.
Finally, Vritra climbed onto the first stair and—just as he expected—invisible attacks several times stronger than the last rushed towards him.
But just as he suffered the soul damage...
[Soul damage detected.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
Vritra paused on the stair as attacks kept coming; after a while he even made Maeve remove the soul barrier.
He withstood the pain affecting his soul directly and watched the same messages flashing again and again.
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
After the first stair could no longer give any benefits, he stepped on the second, asking Maeve to put up the barrier again to stop 40% of the attack initially.
"Hubby, are you okay? It isn’t good to receive too much damage to your soul, even if it is giving you benefits..." knowing how stubborn Vritra could be, Yasmine suggested after a moment.
"Let Nihil Anima help you; it can rapidly heal your soul. Just don’t make yourself suffer so much, I don’t like this." Yasmine said.
Aside from the improvement, the pain he must be suffering is just unbearable.
Not even pain tolerance could do anything against the pain of soul damage.
Vritra followed her advice and wrapped his soul with Nihil Anima, which healed his soul rapidly after suffering damage each time.
"Remove the soul barrier now," Vritra said, his breathing slightly fast.
Maeve couldn’t understand what exactly he was doing, but she was a bit surprised by his resolve and tenacity.
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
There were hundreds upon hundreds of stairs, and after each stair, the power of the soul attack kept increasing exponentially.
Vritra’s soul was growing rapidly; it had already surpassed the 6th Legion rank and Vritra had just climbed a bit over 30 stairs.
Vritra was holding Maeve’s thighs, his hands were shaking and his body had gotten slightly cold, face looking quite pale.
If Nihil Anima wasn’t healing his soul, then he would have needed to stop several times already, but Vritra persevered as sweat dripped down his body.
Maeve was silently observing him; whatever was the reason behind him taking all this damage head-on, she was already quite impressed by Vritra.
"Are you sure you can continue like this? Let’s rest a bit here." Maeve said, looking at his face; she had a feeling that both his name and face were fake.
It made her wonder just who he could be, even the strongest demons can’t show such perseverance.
Vritra looked up; there were only stairs in his vision. Taking a long breath, he stepped onto the next stair as even more terrifying soul attacks struck his body.
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
After standing there for over thirty minutes, Vritra sat down, drinking some water as Maeve covered him with the barrier, blocking the mental and soul attacks.
"Are you alright?" Yasmine and Maeve asked at the same time.
"Huff, huff, y-yeah, just need a little rest." Putting Maeve down, he sat beside her, panting heavily.
He felt incredibly exhausted, and within moments, he slipped onto Maeve’s lap and fell asleep.
At first, the two women were worried, but they relaxed after sensing that he was just sleeping.
Maeve stared at Vritra’s face, several thoughts passing through her mind.
But she realised at least this person wasn’t like most others she had met in her life—smile on face, knife in hand, full of deceit and bad intentions.
’He should just be around the 5th Legion yet he is venturing in such a dangerous place,’ she thought. All of this was so new for her, his playful nature, such an adventure, and of course his blood.
The time in this realm was moving slower than outside though Vritra wasn’t sure what exactly was the difference.
After sleeping for a bit over eight hours, Vritra woke up, completely refreshed and ready to go even higher.
It seemed aside from that Charged Fist, he might gain something just as special.

If Nihil Anima wasn’t healing his soul, then he would have needed to stop several times already, but Vritra persevered as sweat dripped down his body.
Maeve was silently observing him; whatever was the reason behind him taking all this damage head-on, she was already quite impressed by Vritra.
"Are you sure you can continue like this?
Let’s rest a bit here." Maeve said, looking at his face; she had a feeling that both his name and face were fake.
It made her wonder just who he could be, even the strongest demons can’t show such perseverance.
Vritra looked up; there were only stairs in his vision.
Taking a long breath, he stepped onto the next stair as even more terrifying soul attacks struck his body.
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
After standing there for over thirty minutes, Vritra sat down, drinking some water as Maeve covered him with the barrier, blocking the mental and soul attacks.
"Are you alright?" Yasmine and Maeve asked at the same time.
"Huff, huff, y-yeah, just need a little rest." Putting Maeve down, he sat beside her, panting heavily.
He felt incredibly exhausted, and within moments, he slipped onto Maeve’s lap and fell asleep.
At first, the two women were worried, but they relaxed after sensing that he was just sleeping.
Maeve stared at Vritra’s face, several thoughts passing through her mind.
But she realised at least this person wasn’t like most others she had met in her life—smile on face, knife in hand, full of deceit and bad intentions.
’He should just be around the 5th Legion yet he is venturing in such a dangerous place,’ she thought.
All of this was so new for her, his playful nature, such an adventure, and of course his blood.
The time in this realm was moving slower than outside though Vritra wasn’t sure what exactly was the difference.
After sleeping for a bit over eight hours, Vritra woke up, completely refreshed and ready to go even higher.
It seemed aside from that Charged Fist, he might gain something just as special.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: And so, the Grind Begins
paragraphs: Maeve stared at the sleeping Vritra, several questions and thoughts swirling in her mind, but living among demons for so long she had learned not to trust anyone easily.
Each person is covered by countless layers; on the surface he might be the protector of people but deep beneath, the same person could be a heartless sadist.
With a thought, a bluish butterfly appeared in the space, then disappeared.
This spiritual butterfly would carry her message to one of her most trusted subordinates but only by the time when her body gets better.
Then she silently waited for him to wake up.
After a long sleep, Vritra woke up. Yasmine’s soul was already quite weak so he had sealed her deep within to stop it from getting damaged, otherwise she could have noticed Maeve’s actions.
"Hoo, that feels a lot better." He sat up and looked at the countless stairs that didn’t seem to have any end; then, stretching his body, he got up.
"Ready to leave?" Vritra questioned, the pain in his soul had completely disappeared.
"Yeah, we shouldn’t waste too much time here. What if my condition worsens? We will both be in trouble," Maeve said, though her complexion seemed a bit better than before.
Without saying anything, Vritra just picked her up and put her on his back, tying a cloth tightly around their bodies.
"Hubby, don’t overexert yourself. I don’t like seeing you get hurt," Yasmine said, as Vritra removed the seal for a moment.
’Don’t worry, wifey, I am not dying before giving you those spanks.’ He said and once again sealed Yasmine and stepped onto the next stair, as Maeve created the two barriers.
The soul one only stopping around 30% of the damage, Vritra’s body trembled as waves after waves of attacks struck his soul and the familiar messages kept popping.
[Soul damage detected.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
[Your soul grows stronger.]
Vritra was in no hurry; until he couldn’t gain anything more from a stair, he wouldn’t move up.
Vanessa and the others were safe outside, so it wouldn’t matter if he stayed here a little longer.
Just like that, Vritra continued to climb one step at a time, stopping nearly thirty minutes on each as the power of the blow increased.
When he couldn’t handle it anymore, he would take breaks and have a good long sleep.
Hours after hours, day after day, Vritra did nothing but climb the stairs, nurturing his soul through the pain.
It was growing at a terrifying rate.
On the twentieth day, Vritra had stopped quite close to the three hundredth stair, but he still seemed only halfway there.
He sat on a stair after a long relaxing sleep, his mind, body, and soul were at their peak. Taking out food from his inventory, Vritra began to devour the meat.
"Thankfully we have enough food, or with so much exertion on your body, we might even have starved here," Yasmine said, carefully observing the demoness.
’Well, I would still have been fine; we are carrying emergency rations after all.’ Vritra joked, glancing at Maeve, who was staring at Vritra with hunger clearly written on her face.
"You want some?" Vritra asked, moving the piece of meat from side to side as the demon queen’s eyes followed it around.
With her body being so weak, after so long she experienced just what hunger is.
Although her personality is completely different from what she had shown in front of Vritra, he had been working to make her more and more dependent on himself.
Though she would display her demon-like personality whenever she got angry, and fox-like cunning.
"Uh... Yeah." Maeve nodded.
She had gotten used to his way of talking, though she was still keeping track of how many times she was going to kill him later on.
"Hmm, are you still thinking of torturing me after getting better?" Vritra asked, eating up the meat piece, as Maeve became tense.
She didn’t usually carry food around, since normally she could go without food and water for years.
"N-No, I am not..." she replied, acting pitiful.
"What a vixen, hubby, don’t fall for her tricks." Yasmine said. For some reason, his first wife had a bad impression of this woman.
"Anyway, you haven’t told me how am I to help you get better?" Vritra said, pulling out another piece of meat and turning dust into flames.
"Oh f-for that, you have to get me a nail of a person called Green Claw. I can manage the rest. Remember that green-robed man when we met?" Maeve replied, her gaze fixed on Vritra’s neck.
To be honest, more than the meat, she was more hungry for his blood, but had no way of drawing it out now.
Vritra had allowed her to try it and no matter how many times she tried to bite his neck or wrist, she couldn’t pierce through his skin.
"..." He certainly remembered that man, although he wasn’t at the lord rank yet, but his strength was definitely higher than General rank.

"Well, let’s talk about it later. First, why don’t you ask nicely for the meat? Come on, or I am just going to start climbing up." Vritra said, swinging the grilled piece of meat in front of her eyes.
"Uhm... P-Please... damn it, cough... please, can you feed that meat to me..." Maeve said, with so much difficulty, as if someone had asked her to cut her own head off.
"Hmm?" Vritra tilted his head, waiting for her to continue.
"M-Master, please g-give it to me r-rawr~" Maeve’s face had turned bright red as she spoke those embarrassing words.
"Good job, Foxie." Vritra patted her head and slowly fed her some meat.
After he was finished, Vritra asked: "Now, where is your thank you?"
"Mmm... Thank you m-master..." Maeve said. Even after doing it a couple of times before, she hadn’t gotten used to it.
But Vritra quite enjoyed this whole thing; this was a demon queen who could destroy entire kingdoms within seconds, and here she was following his orders.
Again, the grind continued.
The power behind those attacks was now enough to shatter the souls of people at even the 7th or 8th rank, but Vritra wasn’t affected.
And just like that, another twenty days passed.
Vritra climbed more than 200 stairs; the difficulty had increased immensely.
By now, he had finally arrived close to the top; only ten or so stairs were left to climb and in at most a day, he would arrive at whatever challenge lay ahead.
Maeve only covered her body with the soul barrier, and even she could feel the ripple caused by the powerful attacks. But Vritra, without any barrier, was standing as if he was enjoying a cold wind.
By this time, the attacks had grown strong enough to even injure a Lord rank person; even Maeve wasn’t sure she could take so many attacks like Vritra.
While his presence was growing at a monstrous rate, his soul far surpassed the rank of a General and already neared the Lord rank.
Finally, a day later, Vritra had finished such a difficult challenge.
He had climbed around six hundred stairs, with Mutamorphis and all the suffering his soul growing extremely powerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 381: Kryn
paragraphs: Inside a large hall that spanned over a few kilometres, a table could be seen at the stage on the forefront.
More than twenty figures were seated around the round table; some had human-like appearances while others were nothing more than greyish fogs.
The leader of the Grieves in the continent was Kryn; he had taken over the body of the previous protector of the human emperor.
Gazing at the others, some of whom were playing with glyphs while others were patiently waiting.
"Cough," grabbing everyone’s attention, Kryn began to speak, his voice serious:
"Vritra Arclis, I am sure all of you know what is happening in the continent and he is the centre of all the changes."
"Kryn, from our investigations, he is also a suspect of the death of our team in the Blue kingdom," one of the Grieves said.
"Hmm, but this is no time for small gains; we have to break into the abyss prison and get all our brethren out."
Kryn interrupted; his mastery over the glyphs was definitely the best in the entire Quartz continent.
A long, long time ago, when all races began the hunt for Grieves after demons had gone into hiding because of a person named Zihong.
It was also the time when the strongest summoned hero had made a great name for himself by killing one of the demon lords.
Many of the Grieves were killed and quite a lot of them were captured to be used as nothing more than fuel, as they slowly got tortured to death.
If that number of Grieves were to be freed, all of the continents would be in great turmoil; even the demons wouldn’t be spared.
"Yes, but all our previous tries at entering the abyss prison had resulted in failure. That place is way too sinister." Another Grieve said, his face scrunched up in fear and hate.
"We have to try; that is our first goal. If we can get them out, we will finally be able to get to Rodrick Mech, the creator of Glyphs and the betrayer of the entire Grieve race."
Kryn said, endless hate surging in his eyes.
Unlike what everyone thinks or wants to believe, Rodrick Mech wasn’t a human to begin with.
He was a Grieve.
"So what orders do you have for us? Have you formulated a plan yet?" another Grieve asked.

"Yes, the decisive battle that will forever change the Quartz kingdom will be coming. As I said, Vritra will certainly be at the centre but with his current strength I doubt he could stir too much trouble." Kryn said with a suggestive tone.
"You mean..."
"Yes, let’s help him. Let’s fight against the emperors, use his name and make your presence known, show the world—no, make everyone believe, the Grieves and Vritra are on the same side.
That will be all for now." Kryn said dismissively, then gazed in front where hundreds of thousands of Grieves in human or Fog form were just roaming around.
"Turn the Quartz continent upside down."
Several days had passed since Vanessa, Fiona, and Diana had even heard anything from Vritra but unlike before, they weren’t as worried.
With the soul wraiths close to them, they were sure that at least Vritra was safe and on another adventure.
Diana was busy experimenting with all the recipes she had created a long time ago, and with her top-notch talent, she had even succeeded in creating several unique and miraculous potions.
After mixing many expensive materials, a potion was created that was glistening and seemed full of tiny stars; it looked beautiful.
"Drink this."
Diana gave the red-coloured potion to Fiona who was busy comprehending currently.
Although the redhead was quite sceptical about her capabilities before, now she had complete trust in the goddess.
At least she wasn’t completely useless.
Fiona took the small glass bottle and drank the whole potion in one gulp; it was warm and slightly spicy in taste. Just after a few seconds, her skin became red and she sat with her eyes closed.
Her speed of comprehension had increased by nearly two times.
"Heh, just perfect. I have gotten better at this." Diana nodded in satisfaction, then she quickly created a milky coloured potion and drank it herself before sitting down in concentration.
It had been days since they had even talked to Vanessa since the other women were too busy with the training and the test.
The princess had taught her many skills: defensive, offensive, and much more. Her speed of comprehending the Charm Field had skyrocketed at this place.
The princess didn’t hesitate to give her all sorts of treasures that could benefit her, and so Vanessa finally got ready to start the test.
’Honey, where are you? I wish I could have seen you one more time before entering.’ Vanessa thought and sighed, looking at the majestic doors made entirely of diamond-like material.
She didn’t know how long she would have to stay inside and what sort of dangers lay ahead, but once she returns from there,
Vanessa would have completely transformed; she would be the new Queen of Succubus and her strength would be much higher.
After looking at Vritra’s image, she walked into the heavy doors which shut close after she had entered.
Princess, Gia, and hundreds of other succubus stood there and watched Vanessa enter.
"Please come out safely and as our new Queen." The princess mumbled, her expression solemn.
Back inside Zihong’s inheritance, after climbing all the stairs, Vritra arrived back in a cave with darkness ahead. He just lay on the ground and took several long breaths.
The past days had been constant torture; it was like his body was being chopped from within every passing moment, again and again.
But all that pain had paid off, as he focussed his gaze on the empty air, exerting pressure from his soul.
The space trembled, thin lines appearing in the emptiness.
’My soul power is already at the Lord rank!!’ Vritra exclaimed in his mind; this trip had already benefitted him greatly.
Now, 7th, 8th legion rank or even the Generals could be killed with just one attack, especially the nether eye’s rotting ability which depended on his soul.
He could even injure a lord-ranked person.
"..." Maeve was just baffled. She could also sense the growth of his soul. A 5th Legion possessing such a strong soul was just unheard of.
Even among the strongest families, even if they drowned their youngest members in the strongest soul potions, the growth wouldn’t be too fast and potions would soon be ineffective.
’Just what kind of creature is he? He can’t be a human...’ Maeve thought and decided to be careful. Play nice and continue with her evil plan, to win his trust.
’It’s fine, this is all part of my great evil plan.’ Maeve thought.
"Foxie, let’s go." Vritra called out suddenly, picking her up.
"Yes master~" she replied.
After walking ahead, Vritra once again went through all sorts of traps but none could do anything to him. And again, he found himself at the foot of stairs that disappeared up into the sky.
But this time, it wasn’t the attack to soul but body.
’Oh this will be a piece of cake.’ Vritra smiled and got ready to head up; this might be a terrifying trap for some but this for Vritra was nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Demon Lord? God? What is he?
paragraphs: Vritra was about to climb, but then he remembered that Maeve was with him too, and in her current state she wouldn’t be able to handle the physical blows.
So, putting her down against the wall, Vritra spoke: "Wait here a little, I will be done soon."
"H- Huh? Okay..." she said in a pitiful tone, her white fluffy tail wiggling in a downcast manner.
Vritra ignored her, turning towards the stairs, and climbed onto the first one. As expected, from all directions, several attacks landed on his body.
He wasn’t even shaken by just this much; without a pause, he began to climb rapidly, letting all the attacks hit his body.
’Oh, he is moving so fast, almost like these attacks could do nothing to him.
Even I can’t pierce through his skin, just what kind of physique is it?’ Maeve wondered, her expression looking quite cunning, like an evil fox.
Within just a few minutes, Vritra had arrived at the top, and even attacks that could hurt Lord rank held no danger towards him.
Seeing this, Maeve gulped—the more she watched him, the more absurd and monstrous he seemed.
"Foxie, are you okay?" Vritra’s voice came from the top.
"Yes, master~" Maeve replied in a coquettish tone.
Vritra looked ahead.
Now there were no stairs but another door, even bigger than the previous one, and he had a feeling that this might just be the last challenge.
He had already been there for more than a month.
Although he couldn’t contact the outside now, since all his soul wraiths were perfectly fine, he wasn’t worried about any of his women.
"Now, let’s bring her here." Vritra focused on the countless spatial nodes. Although there were restrictions, with his current mastery he could at least move things around inside there.
"Foxie, I am going to teleport you up here," Vritra shouted from the top of the stairs.
"Have you tried something like this before?" Maeve asked. She felt safer around him, so she too didn’t want to stay on the cold floor for too long.
"Uh, no, let me try it first with the stone lying beside you," Vritra replied, and after a few seconds of deep focus, he used Null.
[Null Activated.]
Instantly, the fist-sized stone disappeared from there, and then appeared to Vritra’s left and right, torn into several pieces.
"Uh... M-Master, I think I can wait here for a while." Maeve’s face turned pale, imagining herself being torn into pieces.
Vritra chuckled. The next time, he directly teleported Maeve in front of him.
Without giving her any time he picked her up and turned around.
"Be careful, this challenge might be the toughest." After speaking, he walked up to the doors and kicked the heavy door, as it skidded across the floor and opened.
Instantly, more than a hundred ten-meter-tall strange figures were revealed. They were more like dolls but were covered with skin and flesh, looking quite grotesque.
Each and every single one of them emitted a dangerous feeling.
With all the restrictions, their strength could almost be compared to the weakest of the lords.
At least they were all stronger than the General rank.
"Oh—" Just as Vritra took a step inside, the eyes of all the human dolls rolled and turned bright red, the fingers and hands of some turned into blades as they began to create terrifying noises.
All hundred rushed towards the two. Maeve could have dealt with them at her peak, but now she could only cling to Vritra for protection.
’Forbid: Mana.’
[Forbidden Activated.]
Vritra hastily tried several things with the Forbidden skill, but none worked, and the strange dolls rushed towards him at full speed, ready to cut the two intruders into pieces.
Releasing his breath, Vritra’s eyes narrowed at the few dolls at the front, and with the pressure of his soul, they were blasted backwards. But this attack was just useless.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
Then Vritra used the corrosive ability of his third eye. Matched with super strong soul, even this attack had become extremely deadly.
An invisible wave of corrosive attack struck several dolls, and their bodies actually began to melt. Although this attack was effective, to defeat them Vritra would need to waste quite a lot of time.
’It seems I need to use my true demonic form to defeat them all.’ Blasting several of the charging dolls away, Vritra gently put Maeve on the floor.
Then he turned and an extremely powerful wave of energy was released, even taking the demoness by surprise.
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification (50%)]
Two horns appeared on Vritra’s head, his face was covered by emptiness as purplish energy began to burst out of his body.
Some time ago, the entire energy of the demonic core was devoured into the Evil Veyll God Essence core, hence instead of blue the colour of the energy was purple.
This energy was extremely deadly—the strength of a demon lord’s energy was nowhere near it.
The Switch barrier naturally covered the purple core, just to be safe.

’W-What? He is a demon as well? But how come that energy seems countless times more potent than even mine? Was he just hiding his strength all this time? Why didn’t the empress kill him then?’ Maeve just stared in shock.
{Sin Point Gained: Baffled +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Confused +1}

Vritra ignored the messages, slightly stretching his body. He felt the energy moving across his body. Even his veins glowed with a purple colour; even just moving his hand in the air seemed to make the space shake.
Even at 50%, his body was perfectly holding on, though it was still a bit overwhelming; at least he won’t die while using so much energy.
CLANG CLANG
The dolls finally were upon him, attacking with perfect coordination, and rushing at him from all sides.
"Let’s see how much you can take." Raising one leg in the air, Vritra twisted his waist and kicked several dolls away.
Their skin was torn and flesh began to leak out as their bodies smashed against the others.
It seemed this much strength was perfectly fine.
The blades of one of the dolls struck his neck; Vritra made no effort in dodging. Instead, he held its arms and ripped them away.
BOOM!
Then smashed the head into minced meat with a powerful stomp.
Maeve just watched as the demon in front of her created a one-sided slaughter; he easily tore their heads to pieces with his hands.
Within just a few moments, he had created a bloodbath, massacring the poor human dolls. Anyone seeing this scene might even start to pity them.
With blood floating around Vritra, stopped by the dust particles, torn limbs and heads in his hands.
He truly looked like a crazed demon, leaving Maeve staring at him dazedly.
Soon, Vritra crushed the last human doll, then jerked off the blood from his hand.
"Wait here for a bit." Vritra looked at Maeve emotionlessly before turning towards the door that opened automatically upon the death of the last doll.
"O- Okay Master~"
Leaving the demon queen there with countless thoughts to ponder, Vritra entered through the door, stepping into a small room with just a table in the middle.
And on top of that table, a sphere could be seen buzzing with energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 383: The Empress Betrayal?
paragraphs: [You have obtained the Active skill Charged Fist.]
A single message flashed in front of Vritra as he crushed the sphere. He stood in the room and decided to read its description first.
[Charged Fist]
[Skill Description]: A strike charged upon receiving or dealing damage to your opponent. Charge continues to increase with time as well.
[Current Charge: 0%]
The description was rather short and simple. Vritra wondered how with such a skill Zihong scared off all the demon lords.
Even if this charged fist could create an extremely powerful strike, enough to kill a demon lord, wouldn’t he be powerless afterward, waiting to charge it up again?
Doesn’t that mean, with a bluff, he made the demons cower?
Vritra shook his head. He decided to check it out later on. First, he needed to get out of this place and meet up with his family.
He directly walked out. All the traps and attacks had ceased; the path back was rather uneventful.
Vritra carried Maeve to the outer cave and paused there.
"I can’t carry you around, so how about I put you in a hotel or something? I will try to get that nail you want," Vritra said.
Maeve was on his back; her soft and large boobs pressed against his back, her thick thighs wrapped around his waist.
All this time, she had done her best to behave. Vritra made it apparent who was the one in power here, and after a month together the demon queen seemed to have some changes.
"Okay..." she nodded, drowning herself in the sweet smell of his blood. She so wished to keep him close and keep drinking his blood.
’Everything is going perfectly, he has started to trust me more. I just need to continue like this for my evil plan to succeed.’
The demonic fox thought, still trying to bite his neck. But now Vritra had gotten used to such random bites, though she would end up leaving faint marks on his skin every now and then.
Covering themselves with Misty Essence, Vritra flew away from there, while the demon queen was busy formulating her plans and biting his neck.
After a while, he booked a room in Ghazi City and put down Maeve on the bed.
The fox demon’s charms and that cunning devilish smile were enough to seduce any man; even wearing those loose modest clothes, her body looked sizzling hot.
"When will you return?" Maeve questioned. By now she could already move her limbs a little.
"As soon as I get that nail, I will return. Make sure to hide yourself properly," Vritra said and disappeared in the next moment. He left behind a soul wraith just in case.
Maeve stared at the ceiling; after a moment, she thought with determination: ’I need to seduce him, j- just for the sake of my plan, nothing else.’
Then, taking a deep breath, she calmed her mind, appearing completely different than she was in front of Vritra.
First, Vritra flew directly towards the City of Charms; he was able to enter easily.
Upon arriving at home, he didn’t find anyone there, so he directly went to Diana’s lab.
"Darling, you are back?" Fiona jumped into his arms upon seeing Vritra enter.
Diana stopped her experiments and gave him a tight hug as well.
"You have been gone for more than fifteen days, we were starting to get really worried about you." The goddess said, breathing in his scent while remaining in his embrace.
But along with Vritra’s scent, she also smelled another feminine scent that certainly didn’t belong to the empress.
"I am fine. How is your research going? There is no problem here, right?" he asked, caressing the heads of the two women.
He seemed to have gotten a habit of patting after patting Maeve’s head for so many days; her soft ears and smooth hair felt quite nice to the touch, not to mention that soft tail.
"Yes, there is absolutely no problem. And Mom has already entered for the test." Fiona added.
Vritra just nodded. He knew now to meet her again he would have to wait until she was out. He was quite worried about his mother.
The three went to eat food together. Vritra had decided to spend a day with them to relax before heading out.
The next morning, Vritra bid farewell to the two women and left the City of Charms after meeting up with the princess and getting quite a bit of sin points from all the succubus.
"Now, let’s see if anything major happened while I was gone."
The time difference between that realm and outside was over two times, so more than a month had passed inside but nearly 15-16 days had passed outside.
Vritra was in Ben’s appearance. Arriving at the temple, he found Shitless and Onest; the two were in their disguised forms.
For some reason, the whole city seemed to be decorated as if some sort of big event was about to take place.
The number of guards around was several times higher.
"Did anything big happen while I was away?" Vritra questioned. The three sat in a small shop, waiting for their drinks.

"Uh... Yes, pitiful one, many things happened while you were away. Sigh, on our first meeting I had warned you to be careful of women; betrayals might come, sigh..." Monk Shitless shook his head, letting Onest tell everything.
"Hmm? What happened exactly?" Vritra became confused, looking at the two who seemed hesitant.

"COUGH Well, you have become quite popular across the city in the past few days. The Grieves have been moving quite a bit and targeting anyone who is searching for you, they had clearly shown support towards you.
Even the Nine Pacts and Bone Blood Cult are showing that you are on the same side. Even the demons.
Sigh The continent has surely been quite lively lately; your threat level has risen to the top and now the search for you is being carried everywhere by several forces." Onest explained.
Vritra nodded. He knew all these forces were just taking advantage of the chaos, trying to get benefits for themselves.
"Is that all?" he asked further, thinking to meet the empress to get more information.
"Uh..." Onest looked at Shitless and looked hesitant.
"Just tell me what is the matter? Is there something even worse than that?" Vritra frowned; he was prepared that there was just going to be bad news from the start.
"So... uhm there is going to be a wedding soon..." Onest spoke.
"And?" Vritra waited.
Shitless sighed and just spoke directly: "Very soon, the empress is going to marry Darius, the emperor."
"Oh-" Vritra fell silent, his expressions changing, his frown deepened as he contemplated.
Knowing the empress, the only reason she would agree to marry him would be either because of some deal or because of her obsession with some demon.
Whatever may be the case, he certainly wasn’t happy to hear that.
"Is that all?" he asked, his tone emotionless.
"Yes... Actually the wedding is going to be tomorrow." Onest added, wondering why they were in such a hurry.
"I see, anyway do you know anything about someone named Green Claw?" Vritra questioned, though the matter of wedding kept bugging his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: The Game
paragraphs: "Green Claw? Hmm, I did hear something about him being punished into the Midnight Party by the empress. It is the biggest black market, by the way," Onest said.
For the past few days, he hadn’t been idle.
As a professional and respected thief, he of course collected quite a bit of information.
"I see," Vritra replied emotionlessly. Despite appearing calm, his mind was quite unstable after hearing of that wedding news.
"...Has the empress made any statement related to that marriage news?" Vritra questioned after a moment. He had forgiven her the previous time, but this was just too much.
"No, she has been silent. Actually, there hasn’t been any official news about the marriage yet—it’s like someone is spreading rumors.
But the announcement about a special event being held tomorrow was announced, so everyone believes it to be true," Onest replied, while Shitless got busy gulping the drinks.
"..." Vritra nodded.
Whatever may be the reason behind it, even if there was some reason behind it, he was still quite upset after hearing this and felt like seeing her would only make him angrier.
"Don’t worry hubby, I am right here with you. And... let’s first see what exactly is going on. It just might be someone taking advantage of the situation," Yasmine said, trying to lighten his mood.
’Hmm...’ Vritra knew if this was just fake news then Yennefer should have already made some announcement, unless she knows nothing of it, which is just impossible.
Pushing this matter to the back of his mind for now, he looked at the two and shared his plan.
"Will that be okay?" Onest asked in concern.
"Let’s do it!" Shitless said. It’s been so many days since he’s done anything.
"Sigh, I still remember the time when Green Claw used to piss in his clothes. Haha, remember you almost cut off his little claw when he leaked on your new armor?"
Vin laughed, patting the middle-aged man’s back.
’Sob, how long are they going to stay here? They have been torturing me for nearly twenty days now, so this is why the empress sent me here?’
Green Claw felt like crying, he was happy that the punishment was very easy before.
"MUNCH MUNCH Sigh, look how much he has grown, he looks older than us now," Tin added, wiping away fake tears.
"Brothers and their sisters, fat and thin, tall and short.
All of you are invited to come and try this wonderful game, and get a chance to win FREE gold coin!!" Suddenly a loud female voice attracted the attention of three wandering men.
They turned their heads and saw a stall with three people standing behind it.
One was a beautiful blonde woman, one was a man in his late fifties, while one was a handsome, weak-looking young master with a paper fan in hand.
Quite a few people were attracted towards their stall; the frail-looking young master was holding a red knife, looking just as weak as him.

"The greatest young master, the man who makes others’ existence seem as insignificant as the word ’hand’ in ’handicap’; the main character who makes everyone feel like useless extras; the man whose sight alone can make all your wives we-"
"COUGH That’s enough." While waving the paper fan, the young master stopped the blonde beauty from continuing.
"Behold, this is the young master from the greatest family, strongest, richest—he is none other than Fang Yan!" Shit-Sonia announced, grabbing attention of lots of passersby.
Vritra stood with his face half-covered with the fan, he knew it was going to be a bad idea but at least Shitless got him a lot of sin points.
"Did you say free coins? What is going on here?" The moment he heard ’free,’ Vin’s interest was already peaked, not to mention the sight of such a beautiful woman.
The twin pulled Green Claw along towards the stall and pushed all the others back.
"Yes, yes, this is a small game. You just need a bronze coin to enter and if you win, you can get one gold coin.
Additionally, a comfortable massage from me," Onest spoke, scanning the crowd to see anything of value.
He also possessed the ability to peek into others’ inventory or storage glyphs.
"Oh, what kind of game?" Vin asked excitedly.
"Let me play it first." Tin said, with a flirtatious smile towards Sonia.
"Yes, it’s a game to see just how manly you actually are." Sonia said, batting her eyes seductively and then added:

"The participants have to put their hand on the table, then our greatest young master will use that knife to strike the table, in the space between your fingers. If you can remain perfectly still, then you win."
"Just that? Isn’t that too easy?" Green Claw said with a frown, he just wanted to leave.
"Here is the bronze coin, now let me participate," Vin wasted no time and pulled out a bronze coin, tossing it to the table.
"Wait, what if you accidentally hit our fingers or hand?" Green Claw said, but looking at the knife, he doubted it could even cut through their defences.
"Then you get five gold coins and a chance to go out with me~" Sonia replied, leaning forward slightly, as the gazes of all the men focused on her.
"COUGH Let’s not waste any time, start this game asap." Vin said hurriedly, he had been bored in this place anyway.
And there were no signs of the person they were searching for, so it wouldn’t hurt to play with this beauty a bit.
"Tsk, let me try it first." Tin said, his gaze fixed on Sonia.
But Vin had already placed his right hand over the table, a confident smile on his face as he looked at Shitless.
"I am going to start," Vritra said, then he held the knife upside down and began to strike the table rapidly, without even looking down.
TUK TUK TUK TUK

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Sad...
paragraphs: [D-Day 20]
Across the entire continent, the search for Vritra was going at full force.
Almost the entire forces and army had been deployed; they were even thoroughly checking all the houses.
Based on the info that his strength should be at most around 3rd or even an impossible 4th legion rank, they had spread their strongest warriors.
Not just humans; even phoenix and other races were mixed in this search.
While the demons, Nine Pacts, Grieves, Bone Blood Cult, and many other dark forces were causing even more trouble, showing their connection and support for Vritra.
Now that a big event will soon be happening, there were speculations that something big could happen there.
Though big shots like emperors and many others were invited there, such info makes everyone believe that it really might be the day of the emperor and empress’s wedding.
Especially since unlike many times before, the empress didn’t make any statements.
The emperor previously had spread such rumors to put pressure on her but she outright rejected everything, but not this time.
"H-Huh? Ukkhhyyaaaaa!"
Green Claw let out a painful scream as one of his fingers was cut off clean.
He pulled his hand back as blood spluttered out.
Though at their level, the regeneration speed of most is exceptional, and pain tolerance is high.
But someone like Green Claw, who had depended on his family for all his achievements, almost cried from just this much pain.
Not to mention, each of his fingers was a great treasure for him; all the nails were filled with a very deadly poison created by spending a vast amount of family money.
"Oh forgive us, here are your extra five gold coins." Vritra said and threw five coins at Vin.
"...Oh haha, good job Greeny, I didn’t think of that."
The twins were surprised that such a knife was able to cut his finger off.
But winning free money, Vin was just happy while Tin was busy getting his massage from Sonia, so he didn’t really care.
"Alright, that will be all, we have spent all our money.
We will be back again tomorrow, so don’t forget to come and play and earn a lot of money."
Vritra clapped his hand as the finger on the table disappeared suddenly.
"Woah look at that bird with ten heads flying with its tongue and shitting out gold!" Sonia shouted, pointing towards the sky.
And naturally the gaze of all the men shifted towards the sky, but there was nothing except the setting sun.
Then they looked back but the three people along with the stall had completely disappeared.
"W- Where are they? Fang Yan! Catch them, they are thieves!" clutching his hand, Green Claw shouted.
The people quickly checked their storages and most heaved a sigh of relief.
While Tin, Vin, and Green Claw were the only ones who had their inventories or storage glyphs emptied by nearly half.
Before those men knew it, Vritra, Shitless, and Onest had already escaped.
Two of them returned to the temple, while Vritra headed towards the hotel where the demoness was staying.
He had done the whole thing half-heartedly.
After hearing that news, he was not in the mood to do anything.
Though he was still quite calm, countless questions kept popping in his mind.
Maeve lay on the bed, staring outside the window.
She could move her arms now though moving her entire body was still quite difficult.
’Don’t tell me he is planning to just abandon me?
Then how am I going to succeed with my plan?’ she thought, feeling troubled.
Staying more than a month together, she had gotten quite used to his playful nature, his jokes, and had started to enjoy his company.
Just while she was deep in thought, Maeve sensed a gust of wind and then a figure appeared close to the bed.
"You are back! COUGH I mean, did you finish the task?"
She was happy to see Vritra return, even though he had a different appearance right now, but no one else could have that sweet smell.
But she acted like a tsundere.
The demon queen was ready, or rather eager, to hear him speak, call her Foxie, and joke around but none of that sort happened.
"Yeah, I got what you wanted." He said simply, his appearance changing back to Ben.
Pulling out the finger from his inventory, he put it over the table.
"Wha- Hahaha You cut off the entire finger, I wish I was there to watch it."
Maeve laughed, but then quieted down, seeing his emotionless face.
"Treat yourself with that poison, then our deal will be complete after I get the treasures. And we can part ways."
Vritra said, sending a jolt through her body.
"Hmm... we part ways?" she muttered, wondering if their time together really is going to end so soon; it was like breathing in fresh air after living her whole life in a gutter.
"Okay... I would be very happy to get away, no one has ever treated me like that." she added in a low voice, her tail slowly became still.
Vritra nodded, not noticing the change in the fox demon’s emotions and expression.
Maeve was a demon and had undoubtedly done many evil things in her life. Till now, she just wanted to recover and kill him.
But without her knowing, the thought of killing him had disappeared; she just liked being around him.
"I will be sleeping here for the night."
The sky outside had already gone dark and Vritra didn’t wish to go back to the City of Charms.
This was the first such big difficulty in his love life.
There had been that one time with Fiona but it was easily resolved and wasn’t a big matter.
But knowing that Yennefer hadn’t made any announcement to deny this news made him angry at her.
Then he lay down on the bed beside Maeve, closing his eyes, trying to empty his mind.
’Did something happen? Why does he seem so... sad?’ Maeve wondered.
She turned to her side with great difficulty and stared at his face.
Looking at his features, she really wondered what exactly he looks like.
The image of his demonic self was still etched deep in her mind, that sight of pure slaughter.
The only thing she had ever wanted was for someone to care for her, but whether it be her parents, her brothers or any other demon, they had all been selfish and brutal.
Ready to even kill her if the opportunity arrived.
Though she knew Vritra didn’t care about her, but him helping her and protecting her made her feel nice.
"Um... can you show me your true appearance?" she called out after a while, but even after a few seconds received no response from him.
Wriggling her body, she moved a bit closer to him while pretending as if nothing was wrong.
’I hope he is fine.’ She thought, missing his comments, jokes, and insults.
While she was busy with her own thoughts, Vritra stared at a display in his mind in bafflement.
It was a message from the Divine system, but unlike anything before.
He didn’t read anything else but was completely focused on just a single line that made him wonder if it was some sort of joke or some bad omen.
That one line in the middle of the whole message...
{Completion Requirement: Death!}
