chapters.title: Chapter 386: The Wedding Dress
paragraphs: {Recreation}
{Requirement: A death and a sacrifice.}
The messages that popped in Vritra’s mind were vague and didn’t give away any details, sounding completely absurd.
’Death? Sacrifice? What is this all about?’ Vritra’s already bad mood worsened, seeing those two words.
But even after thinking for a while about it, he couldn’t think of anything.
The matter of Yennefer and these new messages kept flashing in his mind, making it impossible for him to sleep.
Maeve was staring at his face, noting even the slightest movement.
After a while, she held Green Claw’s finger in her hand; with a light squeeze, a drop of blood was squeezed out of the nail.
Then she pulled out a potion from her inventory, and using just her mental strength, moved the poison into the potion and waited for some time.
Once the colour of the potion had changed completely to black, she dipped her finger into the potion and stayed still.
Slowly, all the poison was being pulled out of her body and mixing into the potion, changing its colour once again.
After nearly two to three hours, the potion was once again colourless and Maeve was almost back to her peak.
Even the few internal injuries she had disappeared within moments.
Putting the potion away, she just lay there, though initially, she had thought of a thousand ways to pay him back for all the disrespect.
’Why does he look so sad?’ she wondered; this was the first person in her life she could call a friend. She really enjoyed spending time with him.
Feeling that it was better not to interrupt him right now, Maeve closed her eyes, her soft tail slowly coming to rest over Vritra’s arm.
[D-Day 19]
Early in the morning, Vritra opened his eyes; he wasn’t able to sleep.
He didn’t want to meet the empress but also wanted to question her about this news.
The sky outside was already bright. Looking down, he saw Maeve who was sleeping in a really weird posture.
Half her body was over him, her leg placed over his belly, and tail spread across his chest.
Vritra knew that she was most probably already healed.
Slowly pushing her off, Vritra stood up. Deciding to get those treasures from her later on, he flew out of the hotel.
"Hubby, don’t think about it too much, I am sure everything will be fine once we meet her. Should we go meet her before that... event tonight?"
Yasmine asked, though she had a bad feeling about this all.
She felt quite angry at Yennefer for making Vritra feel sad and hurt, and knowing that woman, it should be because of her obsession with demons or strength.
’I am fine, but maybe Shitless was right, women are dangerous and non-trustable creatures,’ Vritra thought, before adding: ’Of course, you, mom, Fiona, and Diana excluded.’
After just roaming around and feeling the fresh air, Vritra calmed down a little and decided to go check things out later at the said wedding.
"First let’s go see Fiona and Diana, I wonder if there is any news about mom today." He wondered and flew back towards the city of charms.
Just when he was midway there, Vritra heard a scream and upon looking down, he was quite surprised at the sight.
There were several men and one of them was Vritra or rather someone who looked almost like him, though with many dissimilarities.
"Sigh, as if I am already not popular enough, and here they are hoarding my chance to earn sin points." Vritra shook his head.
At one glance, he could tell that it was the maniacs from the Bone Blood Cult.
That stench of blood is always clinging to their bodies, and here they were attacking random people.
Not in the mood to deal with them, Vritra just sent a weak soul attack towards the group, without even using the nether eye.
And without even knowing what had happened, over twenty men dropped dead, their levels under 1st Legion rank.
Ignoring the messages popping in front of him, Vritra wondered if his new skill charged fist was really going to be as great as it was said to be.
"I guess I would be getting the chance to check it out very soon."
It wasn’t long before he arrived inside the city of charms, he was quite surprised at how fast the two women were progressing.
Diana’s potions were also quite useful, as their comprehension was rapidly increasing.
"Is there any news about mom?" he asked, getting comfort in the tight and warm embrace of the goddess.
Living together with them for this long, Diana had changed a lot, though she was still a bit greedy about money and treasures but that was acceptable.
"No, but the princess assured that there is no danger to mom’s life. Her talent and dedication are off the charts, or so she said." Fiona answered, missing Vanessa as well.
"Anyway, darling try this potion out, it’s magical. After observing the empty legion stone, Diana had created this potion which would be quite helpful even for your comprehension."
Fiona said, picking up a potion.
"I will try it later." Vritra said, putting the potion into his inventory.
"Is everything alright?" Diana asked, putting away the materials and walking closer to him.
"...Yeah, I am just worried about mom." He said, giving a faint smile.
"Let’s go eat a delicious breakfast. You won’t believe how tasty the dishes the new hotel we found here creates are." The three then headed away.
Inside a room, near the palace.
Yennefer was sitting over her bed, with a slight frown she was staring at the wall.

"It is so hard to find him, what if he hears this news and misunderstands? But I am sure he will understand me, I have to catch and kill that rat Raelion, no matter what." She muttered to herself before sighing.
She really wanted to explain it to Vritra first, but maybe he hadn’t heard it or he would have come to meet her.
And if he hadn’t yet heard, then there was just no need to worry since everyone will know about the whole thing by tomorrow.
"This time, I am going to kill him." Just while she was deep in thought, there was a knock on the door.
"Enter." Yennefer said, putting back her veil and scanning the person on the other side of the door.
Then a woman entered, she bowed respectfully and explained:
"Empress, I have come here under the emperor’s order with the dresses from which you can choose what to wear tonight."
Yennefer frowned, knowing fully well what the emperor was thinking and what he wanted to do.
"Show them to me." Yennefer ordered.
"Yes, empress." The woman then took out a storage glyph and one by one pulled out beautiful dresses suited for a bride.
"That’s enough, take them back and tell the emperor that I won’t be wearing them." Yennefer said, her tone frosty, making the woman shiver.
"U- Uh... T- The emperor told me to give this message to you." The woman bowed a full 90 degrees and pointed a scroll towards her.
Yennefer glanced at the scroll and tapped at it, then the image of the emperor appeared in the air.
"I knew you wouldn’t agree, sigh, how is Raelion going to believe in all this act if you just wear your usual outfit to the event?
After seeing you, he might just keep hiding and not appear at all. Remember, this is all just an act, don’t you want to kill Raelion?" the emperor said.
"Leave!" Yennefer glared at the frightened woman, making her run out of her room
Taking a deep breath, she calmed down, but there was some truth to it so in the end she decided to just wear a slightly better dress.
"It will all be over, the only thing that matters is Raelion’s death." She muttered, hoping that Vritra wouldn’t hear of this matter until the next day.
Inside the hotel, Maeve rolled over the bed and stretched her arms lazily, releasing a soft hum.
Her fluffy white tail touched the bed around but couldn’t sense Vritra anywhere. Her eyes shot open as she looked around.
"Ben, are you here?" she called out, but she couldn’t even sense him anywhere near.
"D- Did he just leave? Certainly not, right? The pact between us hasn’t been resolved, and he hadn’t even taken those treasures yet, maybe he just went out." The fox demon thought, calming herself.
Getting off the bed, she glanced out of the window and saw dozens upon dozens of guards moving across the streets and buildings.
"Are they searching for me?" she wondered. If Maeve wanted, she could sever the pact and leave already, but she would just be returning to that world of deceit and backstabbing.
"Anyway, I can finally have a taste of his blood and being the honest demon I am, how can I just leave without fulfilling my promise." Maeve muttered, and sat back on the bed.
Vritra spent his day with Fiona and Diana; their company made him feel a lot better, though with the passage of time he was getting worried about the danger approaching from all sides.
When the sky had started to turn dark, Vritra ate dinner with them and bid them farewell, asking them not to leave this place at any cost for now.
Then he visited the place which Vanessa had entered; despite being far away, he could almost feel her through their shared connection.
"Mom, hurry up and come out, I am waiting for you." He muttered and finally turned to leave.
It was time to crash into the wedding and check just how much truth that news held.

After a while, she held Green Claw’s finger in her hand; with a light squeeze, a drop of blood was squeezed out of the nail.
Then she pulled out a potion from her inventory, and using just her mental strength, moved the poison into the potion and waited for some time.
Once the colour of the potion had changed completely to black, she dipped her finger into the potion and stayed still.
Slowly, all the poison was being pulled out of her body and mixing into the potion, changing its colour once again.
After nearly two to three hours, the potion was once again colourless and Maeve was almost back to her peak.
Even the few internal injuries she had disappeared within moments.
Putting the potion away, she just lay there, though initially, she had thought of a thousand ways to pay him back for all the disrespect.
’Why does he look so sad?’ she wondered; this was the first person in her life she could call a friend.
She really enjoyed spending time with him.
Feeling that it was better not to interrupt him right now, Maeve closed her eyes, her soft tail slowly coming to rest over Vritra’s arm.
[D-Day 19]
Early in the morning, Vritra opened his eyes; he wasn’t able to sleep.
He didn’t want to meet the empress but also wanted to question her about this news.
The sky outside was already bright.
Looking down, he saw Maeve who was sleeping in a really weird posture.
Half her body was over him, her leg placed over his belly, and tail spread across his chest.
Vritra knew that she was most probably already healed.
Slowly pushing her off, Vritra stood up.
Deciding to get those treasures from her later on, he flew out of the hotel.
"Hubby, don’t think about it too much, I am sure everything will be fine once we meet her.
Should we go meet her before that... event tonight?"
Yasmine asked, though she had a bad feeling about this all.
She felt quite angry at Yennefer for making Vritra feel sad and hurt, and knowing that woman, it should be because of her obsession with demons or strength.
’I am fine, but maybe Shitless was right, women are dangerous and non-trustable creatures,’ Vritra thought, before adding: ’Of course, you, mom, Fiona, and Diana excluded.’
After just roaming around and feeling the fresh air, Vritra calmed down a little and decided to go check things out later at the said wedding.
"First let’s go see Fiona and Diana, I wonder if there is any news about mom today." He wondered and flew back towards the city of charms.
Just when he was midway there, Vritra heard a scream and upon looking down, he was quite surprised at the sight.
There were several men and one of them was Vritra or rather someone who looked almost like him, though with many dissimilarities.
"Sigh, as if I am already not popular enough, and here they are hoarding my chance to earn sin points." Vritra shook his head.
At one glance, he could tell that it was the maniacs from the Bone Blood Cult.
That stench of blood is always clinging to their bodies, and here they were attacking random people.
Not in the mood to deal with them, Vritra just sent a weak soul attack towards the group, without even using the nether eye.
And without even knowing what had happened, over twenty men dropped dead, their levels under 1st Legion rank.
Ignoring the messages popping in front of him, Vritra wondered if his new skill charged fist was really going to be as great as it was said to be.
"I guess I would be getting the chance to check it out very soon."
It wasn’t long before he arrived inside the city of charms, he was quite surprised at how fast the two women were progressing.
Diana’s potions were also quite useful, as their comprehension was rapidly increasing.
"Is there any news about mom?" he asked, getting comfort in the tight and warm embrace of the goddess.
Living together with them for this long, Diana had changed a lot, though she was still a bit greedy about money and treasures but that was acceptable.
"No, but the princess assured that there is no danger to mom’s life.
Her talent and dedication are off the charts, or so she said." Fiona answered, missing Vanessa as well.
"Anyway, darling try this potion out, it’s magical.
After observing the empty legion stone, Diana had created this potion which would be quite helpful even for your comprehension."
Fiona said, picking up a potion.
"I will try it later." Vritra said, putting the potion into his inventory.
"Is everything alright?" Diana asked, putting away the materials and walking closer to him.
"...Yeah, I am just worried about mom." He said, giving a faint smile.
"Let’s go eat a delicious breakfast.
You won’t believe how tasty the dishes the new hotel we found here creates are." The three then headed away.
Inside a room, near the palace.
Yennefer was sitting over her bed, with a slight frown she was staring at the wall.
"It is so hard to find him, what if he hears this news and misunderstands?
But I am sure he will understand me, I have to catch and kill that rat Raelion, no matter what." She muttered to herself before sighing.
She really wanted to explain it to Vritra first, but maybe he hadn’t heard it or he would have come to meet her.
And if he hadn’t yet heard, then there was just no need to worry since everyone will know about the whole thing by tomorrow.
"This time, I am going to kill him." Just while she was deep in thought, there was a knock on the door.
"Enter." Yennefer said, putting back her veil and scanning the person on the other side of the door.
Then a woman entered, she bowed respectfully and explained:
"Empress, I have come here under the emperor’s order with the dresses from which you can choose what to wear tonight."
Yennefer frowned, knowing fully well what the emperor was thinking and what he wanted to do.
"Show them to me." Yennefer ordered.
"Yes, empress." The woman then took out a storage glyph and one by one pulled out beautiful dresses suited for a bride.
"That’s enough, take them back and tell the emperor that I won’t be wearing them." Yennefer said, her tone frosty, making the woman shiver.
T- The emperor told me to give this message to you." The woman bowed a full 90 degrees and pointed a scroll towards her.
Yennefer glanced at the scroll and tapped at it, then the image of the emperor appeared in the air.
"I knew you wouldn’t agree, sigh, how is Raelion going to believe in all this act if you just wear your usual outfit to the event?
After seeing you, he might just keep hiding and not appear at all.
Remember, this is all just an act, don’t you want to kill Raelion?" the emperor said.
"Leave!" Yennefer glared at the frightened woman, making her run out of her room
Taking a deep breath, she calmed down, but there was some truth to it so in the end she decided to just wear a slightly better dress.
"It will all be over, the only thing that matters is Raelion’s death." She muttered, hoping that Vritra wouldn’t hear of this matter until the next day.
Inside the hotel, Maeve rolled over the bed and stretched her arms lazily, releasing a soft hum.
Her fluffy white tail touched the bed around but couldn’t sense Vritra anywhere.
Her eyes shot open as she looked around.
"Ben, are you here?" she called out, but she couldn’t even sense him anywhere near.
"D- Did he just leave?
Certainly not, right?
The pact between us hasn’t been resolved, and he hadn’t even taken those treasures yet, maybe he just went out." The fox demon thought, calming herself.
Getting off the bed, she glanced out of the window and saw dozens upon dozens of guards moving across the streets and buildings.
"Are they searching for me?" she wondered.
If Maeve wanted, she could sever the pact and leave already, but she would just be returning to that world of deceit and backstabbing.
"Anyway, I can finally have a taste of his blood and being the honest demon I am, how can I just leave without fulfilling my promise." Maeve muttered, and sat back on the bed.
Vritra spent his day with Fiona and Diana; their company made him feel a lot better, though with the passage of time he was getting worried about the danger approaching from all sides.
When the sky had started to turn dark, Vritra ate dinner with them and bid them farewell, asking them not to leave this place at any cost for now.
Then he visited the place which Vanessa had entered; despite being far away, he could almost feel her through their shared connection.
"Mom, hurry up and come out, I am waiting for you." He muttered and finally turned to leave.
It was time to crash into the wedding and check just how much truth that news held.

chapters.title: Chapter 387: The Wedding
paragraphs: Vritra was standing in front of the palace door; the whole place was decorated to the extreme, as if the emperor was really getting married.
"Hubby, stay calm and don’t take any impulsive steps. Remember, I am here with you and for you, now and forever."
Yasmine said softly; she didn’t care about Yennefer but didn’t want her husband to suffer because of her or anyone else.
’Yeah, don’t worry.’ Vritra had taken on a middle-aged man’s appearance. Holding a gift box in hand, he took a deep breath and walked towards the guards.
Quite a lot of people were entering, though only special people were invited to this event, and the checking was quite strict.
The whole thing was prepared in a hurry, but surely a lot of money had been spent on it all.
"I thought the empress was never going to agree to the marriage, sigh, time is changing so fast."
"How many years has it been since they got engaged? Everyone knows the empress never wanted to marry the emperor. I wonder if these rumors are even true."
"Shh, don’t talk so loudly, what if you get heard? You know the emperor’s temper when it comes to the empress."
A group of four men whispered to each other; all of them looked like rich merchants.
"Show me your invitation." The guard said respectfully while looking at them with a scrutinizing gaze.
"Here." One of them took out a blue emblem and gave it to the guard.
"Hmm, lowest rank, sorry but you can only bring two people inside with you." The guard said, while handing back the emblem.
"Ah, so just three of us can enter?" the man muttered, then he glanced at his group and fixed his gaze on one of the men.

"I- I have to leave? Why always me?" the pitiful man looked sad as he spoke, then he turned around and began walking while muttering: "Why do good things happen to others, while with me, things happen for the good?"
The man with the runny nose ran away from there, but he would only come to know that it truly was for the good that he left.
"Your invitation sir?" the guard asked, after taking a long look at Vritra.
Nodding, he took out a similar-looking emblem but with red colour.
After taking a long look at it, the guard became even more respectful and handed it back.
"Please head inside sir, this butler will lead you."
This emblem was stolen by Onest from someone very rich, though he had to follow the guy around for several hours.
Many servants were standing near the gates. One of them stepped forward and bowed before gesturing for Vritra to walk along.
"Sir, may I know your name?" the butler asked, his tone polite.
"I am Ben." Vritra said without much interest. There were a lot of guests, but since the place was enormous, it wasn’t crowded.
Strong guards of 4th, 5th, and higher legions were walking around; a few of them scanned Vritra but passed after not sensing any mana from him.
Currently, not even the empress would be able to recognise him.
"Sir, the food is on the left if you wish you can sit there, and if there is anything you need, you may call me directly by ringing this bell." The butler said and passed him a small bell.
Vritra nodded and just held the bell before throwing it away and walking towards the seats. The butler shrugged and left.
Scanning the seats, Vritra found Rich sitting there and he decided to sit beside him.
"Can I sit here?" Vritra asked as he sat on the chair and placed his gift over the table.
"Ah, sure, but you are already seated. Anyway, hello, I am Rich." He said with a smile, eating sweets.
Vritra looked around; on the left, countless types of food items were present.
Thousands of seats were spread across the vast area, and in the front was a stage with two thrones on top.
From the looks of it, this event certainly seemed to be a wedding with all the flowers and décor.
"So Rich, what kind of event is this?" Vritra asked. The sound of the crowd seemed like noise to him and all the brilliance around was annoying him to the point he wanted it all to explode.
"I am not sure, Darius sent me the invitation but didn’t tell what it might be." Then lowering his voice, he spoke:
"But it might very well be a wedding. I know how he has been trying to impress the empress."
"Hmm." Vritra decided to wait a little longer, though each moment he sat there, it was like this whole place was digging a nail into his skull.
One of the butlers approached the two and asked: "Sirs, can I take your presents away? I will place them among the presents that the emperor will open later on."
Seeing that it was Rich, the butler knew these guests were important, so he was extremely polite.
"Sure." Both Vritra and Rich agreed. The butler bowed and placed the gifts over a tray before bringing them away.
He placed it near the side of the stage; around twenty or so gifts were present there, while some distance away thousands of gifts were lying around.
"Sigh, my sister, the marriage trial is approaching, and I really wish someone could take away that— that thing from home.
She had made living a nightmare for me, sigh..." Rich said suddenly, remembering something traumatizing.
"Have the competitions for those candidates ended already?" Vritra asked; he had once participated in such a competition.
"No, but it is nearing its end. But it will take some time for the marriage trials to start. I had selected someone to throw my sister at but it seems he isn’t all that interested in that."
Rich answered, thinking of his problematic sister.
"Ah, I see." Vritra wasn’t really all that interested, but it was really hard to pass the time.
"COUGH COUGH Hello everyone!" suddenly a loud voice rang out across the place, grabbing everyone’s attention.
A man with a long blonde beard jumped onto the stage, wearing a strange black outfit, holding a staff.
"I welcome you all to this wonderful event, I am sure you are all curious about something." The blonde man said, as he looked at everyone’s expressions.
All the people focused, thinking that he was going to tell whether or not this is a marriage.
"Yeah yeah, I am not married and completely single, so ladies I am ready for any offers." Then clearing his thoughts he added:
"Jokes aside, I am Beady, today’s host who will be with you all until the morning."
"This event is very special for us all, as for that question ringing in your minds, well the emperor himself will answer that." Beady said, pointing towards the long carpet.
All the gazes drifted but aside from Griffith, the emperor’s half-brother, no one was there.
"Hey everyone." Griffith said, waving his hand arrogantly; he was quite happy about this event. After that previous incident, he had high respect for his sister-in-law.
Just then everything went dark, and a single spotlight appeared, and amidst the silence, the sound of faint footsteps sounded.
Then Darius wearing a stylish outfit, with white flower patterns and containing beautiful gems, had a big smile on his face.
At a hand’s distance from him was the empress, her face still covered by a veil but she wore a beautiful red dress with a similar flower pattern on it.
When the two appeared, all sorts of whispers began to ring out, and it seemed more evident that this event might be their wedding or maybe something like a pre-wedding.
Darius glanced at Yennefer, his heart fluttering at the dazzling sight. He really wished he could turn this moment into reality, and not just a fake marriage but a real one.
Griffith began to clap and soon all the people were clapping; the place was full of cheerfulness and excitement.
The two walked up to the stage, after climbing the stairs Darius turned and extended his hand to help the empress but Yennefer just climbed up, as if she hadn’t noticed anything.
The two nodded at Beady before sitting down on the two thrones.
Vritra’s mood had sunken even more after all this; he was barely stopping himself from leaving this place, hoping that it doesn’t turn out to be what he is thinking.
"..." Rich glanced at Vritra, since he was using the misty essence mythic halo to change his appearance so the change in his expression wasn’t visible.
"Haa, don’t they look like a good couple? But honestly, I never believed Yennefer would agree to it, knowing her, she hated Darius quite a lot before.
But I guess time changes everything." Rich muttered, taking a glass of wine from a waiter’s tray
and offering one to Vritra.
"No thanks, I don’t drink." Vritra said, or rather even if he did drink it wouldn’t have any effect on him since he is immune to every sort of poison, he can’t even get drunk.
"What a great sight we got to see today, no one else has the charisma like our emperor. And the empress, she is the definition of beauty, the highest peak and the—"
Beady paused when feeling Yennefer’s eyes on him, then he took a step towards the emperor’s side and announced:
"Anyway, Emperor will be taking over from here."
Then he took a step back. Darius stood up and glanced over them all before speaking in a loud voice:
"Everyone, I welcome you all to mine and Yennefer’s wedding!"

chapters.title: Chapter 388: The Wedding-2
paragraphs: After the emperor’s announcement, there was complete silence for a few seconds, but then everyone burst out with loud discussions, filled with shock.
Yennefer didn’t care about any of that as she scanned the area and soon she sensed a demonic presence around; surely Raelion had come.
But then she felt that it wasn’t just one but two demonic presences. Yennefer scanned the crowd again.
Her gaze lingered on a middle-aged man for a bit longer, though nothing seemed strange about him, but it was like her sixth senses were ringing.
’Did Raelion bring someone along to destroy this event? Or maybe it is Maeve, that thieving demon!’ Yennefer thought, trying to locate them.
With the precautions taken already, the chances of others getting hurt in this event were low.
She was sure that it won’t be long before she could find them.
Vritra stopped himself from letting his demonic aura burst out; he grabbed the edge of the table, breaking it with a crunching sound.
It was Yennefer’s silence that made him feel that stinging pain.
It seemed because of her obsession, she would even leave him; from her action, he could tell there was something else she was planning.
But he suddenly felt like he couldn’t trust her anymore. Won’t she actually betray him in the future? The more Vritra looked at Yennefer, the more pain he felt.
It was so strange; previously, seeing her would make him happy, but now it felt so suffocating to just be around her.
"Yes, I know this is random and too sudden, but when you are the ruler you get to do whatever you want haha." Darius joked; the man trying to appease him laughed hard at his joke.
"Anyway, it is a great occasion, I had been waiting for this day for so long.
When the most beautiful woman in the world would become my wife, may God bless us with a happy life together." The emperor said before sitting back at his throne.
Just after his speech, the sky was filled with countless firecrackers; beautiful patterns appeared in the sky.

"Woah woah, I never thought our emperor would be so romantic. Everyone, if you have filled your bellies with the food, then we would like to invite a few people onto the stage who would like to congratulate our couple here."
Beady announced, jumping into the air.
Some distance away, mixed in the crowd was Raelion who was also fuming in rage; he wanted to see if this was really a marriage or just a ploy to bring him here.
But hearing those words, he felt like exploding.
If only he had enough strength to kill the emperor.
"First I would like to invite the three emperors, the Dragon emperor and the two Phoenix emperors!" Beady shouted, his voice mixing with the sound of firecrackers.
Music had already started and hundreds of women were dancing on the side.
Three spotlights appeared among the special seats, three men were highlighted. Two were wearing red outfits; even their hair was red and they had buffed-out bodies.
While one was wearing a white outfit, his cheeks were covered by dragon scales and in front of him, the two other emperors looked like children.
Yasmine frowned seeing the dragon emperor; in her peak, she could defeat the four emperors at once without receiving so much as a scratch.
Though it seemed in the time she had been away, a lot of things had changed among the dragons.
This man named Dago was none other than her uncle’s son.
He was certainly talented but never fit to be a good ruler.
He was just too violent and short-tempered.
Three of them stood up; the phoenix emperors glared at one another. They hated each other to extremes despite being great friends before.
But both were so obsessed with the title of the emperor that they even changed their names to Emperor.
"First, sir Dago, please grace us with your presence on the stage." Beady spoke, bowing respectfully; the strength of the dragon emperor was quite similar to the human emperor.
Though the phoenix emperors would have to fight together to match any of the two.
Dago stood tall and climbed onto the stage; he was at least ten times as arrogant as Griffith.
Pushing back his long hair, he walked up to Darius and patted his shoulder.
"Good job, we men are made to conquer the strongest and arrogant women; you didn’t disappoint me." Dago said, before letting out a loud laugh.
One of the servants brought the gift that Dago had brought up to them and stood beside the emperor.
"Yennefer, would you like to open it?" Darius asked, his voice bursting with joy; it felt so good.
Though he would have loved to call her wife, he knew not to push her too much.
Upon opening the gift, the emperor found a stone inside the box.
"Hmm?" Darius looked at Dago, wondering why he had brought here a random pebble.
"...This is my lucky stone." Dago said, turning around.
"Ah, it’s fine; it’s the thought that counts." Darius said, before turning to one of the servants and whispering: "Throw it outside right away."
Then the two phoenix emperors climbed onto the stage one by one.
They congratulated him and unlike Dago, who forgot to bring any gifts, they had brought expensive things.
Most people had brought gifts because of the rumours, though some were shameless like the dragon emperor.
"I will be going there as well." Rich stood up with a big smile before making his way towards the stage.
"Darius, congratulations. I couldn’t think of what to bring, so I brought you what I have in excess." Rich said and gave him a storage glyph loaded with mountains of gold.
"Haha Rich, there was no need for this, just your presence was enough." Darius said with a hard laugh before storing the glyph away safely.
Rich returned to his seat; a few more people went to congratulate them on the stage.
Yennefer paid little attention to everything else; her aura spread across the area and she began to locate Raelion.
Seeing all this, he was definitely angry and had started to leak his aura.
’Close, close, I am very close to discovering him.’ Yennefer had almost pinpointed Raelion’s location but then another person climbed onto the stage.
It was a middle-aged man; Yennefer didn’t know why but she had this strange feeling when seeing him.
As the guard brought the gift, which was a cubical box with half a meter length. Picking it up, he handed it over to the emperor and said:
"Congratulations, emperor."
"Thank you." Darius wondered who this person was; anyone who was allowed to come on the stage should be someone he knows well.
But just as he was about to ask, the middle-aged man looked at the empress and said: "Congratulations to you too, Yenni, have a long happy life."
The emperor felt that maybe it was someone insignificant from Yennefer’s family so he didn’t pay him any attention and told the servant to throw the gift near the mountain of gifts.
"!!!" On the other hand, Yennefer froze, hearing those words although the voice was different but she instantly recognised him.
She stood up abruptly, her gaze locking onto the back of the middle-aged man walking away from there, her heart thumped in panic and anticipation.
This was exactly what she didn’t want to happen, Vritra was definitely misunderstanding her, and she didn’t want to lose him at any cost.
He was the only one she cared for now; all others had died a long time ago after all, right in front of her.
One by one, in a very traumatising manner, their screams still rang in her ears at every passing moment.
"Is everything alright?" Darius asked, wondering if she had really found Raelion; he hoped to keep this event going for a little longer.
But seeing Vritra’s disappearing figure in the crowd, Yennefer rushed towards him, not caring about anything else.
Just as Yennefer had left, Darius frowned, as he too had sensed Raelion.
’Why is she going in the wrong direction?’ the emperor wondered before rushing towards the demon in hiding.
On the other hand, just as Yennefer arrived among the crowd, they all parted but there were no signs of Vritra.
Biting her lip she flew towards the exit at full speed; she wanted him to listen to her at least.
’Where are you?’ Yennefer suddenly felt as if the air was turning cold; her mind buzzing, she knew because of her obsession she makes mistakes but didn’t think it might lead to this.
Rushing out of the palace, Yennefer saw Vritra who had paused in the air, with his back facing her.
"Vritra!" Thankfully he hadn’t left; if he really disappeared then she might never be able to find him for the rest of her life.
"T- This is all a misunderstanding, this was never a true wedding, we were just trying to catc-"
Yennefer began to explain but Vritra’s emotionless voice cut her off; he had returned to his actual appearance right now.
"What does it matter?" Vritra slowly turned around, his face a mask of blankness; no emotions could be seen in his eyes.
"To fulfil your goals, you were doing all this, then leaving me, killing me, my family all this doesn’t seem impossible so you can reach your ultimate goal of demon-free world, right?"
He asked; the air around Vritra itself seemed to turn cold, his anger was suppressed but the pain was evident.
Each of his word felt like knives slashing at her heart.

With the precautions taken already, the chances of others getting hurt in this event were low.
She was sure that it won’t be long before she could find them.

It was Yennefer’s silence that made him feel that stinging pain.
It seemed because of her obsession, she would even leave him; from her action, he could tell there was something else she was planning.

Won’t she actually betray him in the future?

It was so strange; previously, seeing her would make him happy, but now it felt so suffocating to just be around her.

"Woah woah, I never thought our emperor would be so romantic.
Everyone, if you have filled your bellies with the food, then we would like to invite a few people onto the stage who would like to congratulate our couple here."
Beady announced, jumping into the air.

If only he had enough strength to kill the emperor.

This man named Dago was none other than her uncle’s son.
He was certainly talented but never fit to be a good ruler.
He was just too violent and short-tempered.
Three of them stood up; the phoenix emperors glared at one another.
They hated each other to extremes despite being great friends before.
But both were so obsessed with the title of the emperor that they even changed their names to Emperor.
"First, sir Dago, please grace us with your presence on the stage." Beady spoke, bowing respectfully; the strength of the dragon emperor was quite similar to the human emperor.

Dago stood tall and climbed onto the stage; he was at least ten times as arrogant as Griffith.
Pushing back his long hair, he walked up to Darius and patted his shoulder.

Though he would have loved to call her wife, he knew not to push her too much.
Upon opening the gift, the emperor found a stone inside the box.
"Hmm?" Darius looked at Dago, wondering why he had brought here a random pebble.
"...This is my lucky stone." Dago said, turning around.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Broken
paragraphs: "N- No, I would never..." Yennefer felt each of his words, slashing at her heart like a knife.
She didn’t like the cold look in his eyes; the warmth and love seemed to have disappeared.
"I can’t be with a woman, so... so indecisive, crazy and uncaring." Vritra narrowed his gaze, facing Yennefer yet looking at nothing, as if making a hard decision.
"No, I tried searching for you, I wanted to explain it all to you first-"
Yennefer felt that the situation was just becoming worse the more she tried to handle it, like she was losing him; even speaking was becoming difficult.
"And had you told me about all this, do you think I would ever agree to you playing wife for someone else? It seems I was mistaken about you, we were never meant to be together."
Vritra said; despite his attempt to appear neutral, his emotions kept exploding out.
The empress felt frustrated and didn’t know what to say; every word only seemed to destroy their relation further, but none of this was real and just an act.
With a burst of frustration, she spoke without thinking:
"S- So what, don’t you have three women already in your life? Will you leave them for me? No, right, then how can I give up on my one goal."
But even as she spoke, she instantly regretted saying that.

"Yes, you are right, I would never leave them. Anyway, I hope you achieve your goal and kill every single demon in existence but when you reach the end, I would no longer be standing with you." Vritra spoke, his voice heavy.
The next time they would meet, everything would be completely different.
Turning around, he said a few last words: "Goodbye Yennefer, may you be happy with your choice."
"N- No wait, I didn’t mean to-"
Just then, two figures flashed above the palace, hundreds of men following behind.
"Yennefer, what are you doing there? Come, we can’t let this rat escape again." Darius was trying to catch Raelion; many strong warriors followed him.
For a moment, Yennefer glanced to that side but when she looked back, Vritra’s figure had disappeared and no matter how much she tried to sense his presence she couldn’t find him anywhere.
Yennefer’s heart felt as if being squeezed; her body shivered as the reality of what just happened began to sink.
She swallowed her saliva with difficulty, feeling as if a lump was stuck in her throat; her eyes suddenly burning up.
Warm streaks of tears rolled down her cheeks; in the hundreds of years of life, she hadn’t cried once after that one incident.
Yet now, her eyes seemed to pour out hundreds of years’ worth of tears at once.
She looked around frantically, but he wasn’t there, only his words lingered. It was already too late...
Yennefer ran around, screamed his name, looking almost like a mad woman but nothing worked.
Only as the pain of their separation seeped in did she finally start to understand how big of a mistake she had made.
The only person who was ready to sacrifice himself for her, loved her so much, had left her.
Her blank life had become so colourful after he became a part of her; the scenes from their first meeting to this moment kept flashing in front of her.
On the ground, near the place Vritra had disappeared, Yennefer saw a handkerchief.
The same one that she had thrown at Vritra’s face inside the Scarlet couple inheritance to keep him from looking at her; he had kept it for all this time.
But now this truly was the end.
Everything felt so meaningless; taking revenge for those she had lost was important but at what cost? She pushed the only person in her life away too.
Yennefer kept searching for him, crying and feeling the sinking pain.
On the other side, Vritra teleported in a random direction; he too was feeling very bad.
He loved Yennefer a lot, forgetting her was something that even the passage of time might not accomplish.
Vritra stood in the air, surrounded by nothing but forest; as if responding to his emotions, the night sky was filled with heavy black clouds.
Lightning thundered in the sky, and soon rain began to pour down, drenching Vritra completely.
Yasmine’s figure materialised in front of Vritra and without saying a word, she pulled him into a tight embrace.
His face buried deeply into the gentle curve of her chest, as she tenderly caressed his head, her fingers weaving softly through his hair.
There was just the sound of thunder and rain; Vritra wrapped his arms around Yasmine, her presence bringing him comfort.
After staying silent for a while, Vritra pulled back and with a faint smile that didn’t look like one, he muttered: "Thank you, wifey, please don’t ever leave me."
"Hubby, even in death, I will be with you forever." Yasmine said softly, wishing to cut off all memories of Yennefer.
They stayed in the open for a while longer, then Vritra took her hand and began to fly back towards the capital; the cool wind felt quite nice.
Yasmine remained in her human form until she had reached her limits, then she disappeared and returned to Vritra’s body.
’I need to finish my business with Maeve and then return to the city of charms.’ Vritra thought as he arrived back into Ghazi city.
In the distance, everything was in chaos. Not only did a big fight break out between the emperor and Raelion but a certain gift exploded inside the palace.
It was packed with an extreme amount of destructive demonic energy; the moment it exploded, the whole place turned into a mess.
Doing that didn’t make Vritra feel better but it wasn’t bad to destroy the entire palace and cause that much destruction.
The guards were busy protecting all the guests; it was a complete and utter mess, even the emperor was baffled by the sight.
After getting severely injured, Raelion once again managed to escape and the empress seemed to have disappeared somewhere.
Darius tried looking for her, but she was nowhere around.
Devoid of any thoughts yet full of emotions, Vritra arrived at the hotel. Thankfully Maeve hadn’t been discovered yet, but with her strength back to peak, it wouldn’t be easy to catch her.
As he appeared inside the room, he found the fox demon lying over the bed, looking as if she still couldn’t move her body.

"Ben! I was waiting for you- I mean, we had a deal, right, and I can’t leave without fulfilling it." Maeve said righteously but she knew after the pact is broken, they would be going their separate ways.
"Yeah, let’s just get it over with." Vritra said plainly, as he stopped in front of the bed.
"Uh... W- What’s the hurry? Wait until I am healed, what if you brought me the wrong poison? Yeah, you have to wait a little longer to get rid of me."
Maeve said, hurriedly making up excuses.
Vritra rolled his eyes but right now he was in no mood to argue; it was already getting late, and he just wanted to lie down.
With a thought, his clothes were shredded to dust while a new set of clothes appeared over his body.
Then he climbed onto the bed and lay beside Maeve; the demoness rolled around until she was close enough to feel his warmth, while acting casual.

chapters.title: Chapter 390: Lewd Fox
paragraphs: [D-Day 18]
The night passed rather quietly, although the city was anything but peaceful, yet not a single sound could be heard inside the room.
As the hours ticked by, neither could Vritra sleep nor did he want to get up; ending a relationship in that manner was really painful for him.
He let his senses drift to the outside, sensing the hundreds of guards roaming across the streets.
The royal family naturally threw the previous day’s incident under Vritra’s name; they couldn’t tell all the big shots that they had just become part of a scheme and might have lost their lives.
The already seeping sadness and hatred boiled over as he thought about all these major organizations who were using his life for their profits.
Putting his family in danger, whether it be the demons, Grieves, humans or anyone else, they only sought their benefits no matter the cost.
If the others weren’t going to play fair, then so would he do; even after becoming a demon he had always tried to stay human.
But the world was slowly killing him; it seemed there was no need or chance for just a human to remain alive.
Inside the test area, Vanessa wasn’t able to take any of the Soul Wraiths so right now most of the Grieves were just in the city of charms, protecting the other two ladies.
’Maybe it is a purge this world needs to acquire true peace, a brand new start...’ he thought, but then pushed all negative emotions away.
Letting out a long sigh, he finally opened his eyes.
"Hubby, maybe we should go and meet with Fiona and Diana." Yasmine said, thinking that spending time with them might heal him.
’...I will visit them later, but for now I have to increase my strength, as much as possible and as fast as possible.’
He replied, getting the sin points would be very difficult at a time like this, after all, the entire Quartz continent was in chaos right now.
Nor was he in the mood to do anything, so he decided to check out his newly owned skill.
The Charged Fist!
"Foxie," he called out, stirring Maeve out of her sleep; the fox demon would roll over the bed in her sleep.
After twisting her body, she finally woke up, again lying in a strange posture.
"Mmm, did you call me?" she asked, sleeping here for some reason was thousands of times more comfortable and safe.
"Have you recovered?" Vritra asked, pushing her off him and sitting up.
"Uh... N- Not yet, just a little bit." Maeve replied hurriedly, as sleep disappeared from her eyes. She felt Vritra wanted to make her leave.
After knowing that he is a demon too, Maeve at least felt relaxed that he wouldn’t hate her for being one herself.
"Good, then I need you to hit me or let me hit you." Vritra said, straightening his clothes.
"Oh okay—wait what? Is that some weird game?" Maeve asked in bafflement.
"No." Without further explanation, Vritra went to take a bath. As cold water poured over his head, he emptied his mind; if only he possessed a mind manipulation skill.
Maeve sat on the bed in deep thought, still pondering his words, wondering what sort of fetish this was. But as her savior, she would fulfill all his fetishes, even if it was to hit or get hit.
Her tail was swinging from left to right as she imagined some strange things; in one of her thoughts she was tied and Vritra hit her, while in the other...
Her face turned red, and she covered it with both her hands, smoke rising over her head.
"You can go bathe now." Vritra walked out of the bath with nothing but a towel wrapped around his lower body.
"Oh..." Her gaze scanned him from bottom to top, stopping over his perfect muscles, those abs—the demoness felt as if her breath had been stolen away.
She really wanted to sink her teeth into his skin; the sight was dazzling enough to make her drool.
Then her gaze locked onto his face, since Vritra was now in his true appearance, neither Ben nor anything else.
"Y- You...? Is that your true appearance?" Maeve was baffled for two reasons, first because he looked infinitely handsome compared to her imaginations.
Secondly, how could she not recognize that face when it was displayed all over the world not long ago—he had become an even bigger celebrity than her.
"Y- You are Vritra Arclis?" She felt that this was really his true appearance but also wondered if this was yet another disguise.
"Yeah, are you taking a bath?" he asked again, putting on his clothes.
"Ah wait, I hadn’t had enough of it..." As her shock subsided, Maeve felt intense regret when Vritra wore his clothes; she wanted to savor that sight a lot more.
"..." As Vritra’s eyes narrowed, the fox demon could only sigh and meekly walk into the bathroom.
She hadn’t taken a proper bath after the time when Vritra threw water at her.
After some time, the two were ready.
Vritra first thought about going into the dimensional book but that small realm might not be able to hold the full power attacks of the demoness, so he decided to travel away from there first.
With a thought, his appearance changed to a random middle-aged man, different from the previous day.
Maeve took a glyph from her storage and changed her appearance as well to a loli.
"Is that the only disguise you have?" Vritra asked, a frown appearing on his slightly aged face.
"What’s wrong with it? Doesn’t I look cute?" the little Maeve asked, then tilting her head she took on a cuter pose and asked: "Big bruther, you don’t wike me?"
Vritra rolled his eyes and flew away; a few of the guards on the ground saw them and called out, but just one glance from Maeve and their minds and bodies were completely frozen.
The two of them flew at high speed, moving out of Ghazi city and getting into the endless forest.
Only after traveling far enough and making sure no one was around did the two finally stop.
"Okay so uh... what are we going to do?" Maeve asked, a faint blush appearing over her face, her thoughts kept drifting in weird directions.
"Where is the rope, t- the whip and uhm... do we need a blindfold too?"
Maeve asked in embarrassment; despite the shame, job is job, and how can she not help her savior even if the returning favor is weird.

"What is your small brain cooking up? Stop putting so much pressure over that single brain cell, you just literally need to hit me. Hmm, use 5% of your total strength initially." Vritra said, his lips stretching into a thin line.
As embarrassed as she seemed, the fox demon was quite lewd inside.
"Ah, t- that? You like getting hit?" Maeve asked; she knew his defenses were super strong, but she still can’t bring herself to hit him.
"Yeah, stop with the nonsense and start, there is a skill I need to test." Vritra said; after his experience with Yennefer, he didn’t want to get close to any other woman.
Maeve nodded with determination and took the pose, before plunging forward.

sentences.text: [D-Day 18]
The night passed rather quietly, although the city was anything but peaceful, yet not a single sound could be heard inside the room.
As the hours ticked by, neither could Vritra sleep nor did he want to get up; ending a relationship in that manner was really painful for him.
He let his senses drift to the outside, sensing the hundreds of guards roaming across the streets.
The royal family naturally threw the previous day’s incident under Vritra’s name; they couldn’t tell all the big shots that they had just become part of a scheme and might have lost their lives.
The already seeping sadness and hatred boiled over as he thought about all these major organizations who were using his life for their profits.
Putting his family in danger, whether it be the demons, Grieves, humans or anyone else, they only sought their benefits no matter the cost.
If the others weren’t going to play fair, then so would he do; even after becoming a demon he had always tried to stay human.
But the world was slowly killing him; it seemed there was no need or chance for just a human to remain alive.
Inside the test area, Vanessa wasn’t able to take any of the Soul Wraiths so right now most of the Grieves were just in the city of charms, protecting the other two ladies.
’Maybe it is a purge this world needs to acquire true peace, a brand new start...’ he thought, but then pushed all negative emotions away.
Letting out a long sigh, he finally opened his eyes.
"Hubby, maybe we should go and meet with Fiona and Diana." Yasmine said, thinking that spending time with them might heal him.
’...I will visit them later, but for now I have to increase my strength, as much as possible and as fast as possible.’
He replied, getting the sin points would be very difficult at a time like this, after all, the entire Quartz continent was in chaos right now.
Nor was he in the mood to do anything, so he decided to check out his newly owned skill.
The Charged Fist!
"Foxie," he called out, stirring Maeve out of her sleep; the fox demon would roll over the bed in her sleep.
After twisting her body, she finally woke up, again lying in a strange posture.
"Mmm, did you call me?" she asked, sleeping here for some reason was thousands of times more comfortable and safe.
"Have you recovered?" Vritra asked, pushing her off him and sitting up.
N- Not yet, just a little bit." Maeve replied hurriedly, as sleep disappeared from her eyes.
She felt Vritra wanted to make her leave.
After knowing that he is a demon too, Maeve at least felt relaxed that he wouldn’t hate her for being one herself.
"Good, then I need you to hit me or let me hit you." Vritra said, straightening his clothes.
"Oh okay—wait what?
Is that some weird game?" Maeve asked in bafflement.
"No." Without further explanation, Vritra went to take a bath.
As cold water poured over his head, he emptied his mind; if only he possessed a mind manipulation skill.

But as her savior, she would fulfill all his fetishes, even if it was to hit or get hit.
Her tail was swinging from left to right as she imagined some strange things; in one of her thoughts she was tied and Vritra hit her, while in the other...
Her face turned red, and she covered it with both her hands, smoke rising over her head.
"You can go bathe now." Vritra walked out of the bath with nothing but a towel wrapped around his lower body.
"Oh..." Her gaze scanned him from bottom to top, stopping over his perfect muscles, those abs—the demoness felt as if her breath had been stolen away.
She really wanted to sink her teeth into his skin; the sight was dazzling enough to make her drool.
Then her gaze locked onto his face, since Vritra was now in his true appearance, neither Ben nor anything else.
"Y- You...?
Is that your true appearance?" Maeve was baffled for two reasons, first because he looked infinitely handsome compared to her imaginations.
Secondly, how could she not recognize that face when it was displayed all over the world not long ago—he had become an even bigger celebrity than her.
"Y- You are Vritra Arclis?" She felt that this was really his true appearance but also wondered if this was yet another disguise.
"Yeah, are you taking a bath?" he asked again, putting on his clothes.
"Ah wait, I hadn’t had enough of it..." As her shock subsided, Maeve felt intense regret when Vritra wore his clothes; she wanted to savor that sight a lot more.

She hadn’t taken a proper bath after the time when Vritra threw water at her.

chapters.title: Chapter 391: The trio
paragraphs: On top of a building, an old man with white hair and a slumped body was standing, gazing at the distant buildings.
Beside him stood several men of varied age.
The old man was none other than Pink, one of the Six Seats from the Golden Moon but a demon in hiding.
And right now, he was standing among the leaders of the Bone Blood Cult.
Since this was an organisation made of lunatics, it needed a strong suppressive leader to keep them controlled.
Kryn was the leader of the Grieves and everyone knew that just because of him, countless of their kind have survived and even made several big movements.
While the leader of the Bone Blood Cult, named Red, used his overwhelming strength to keep everyone on leash.
Red stood beside the old man; there was no skin on his body, and red flesh was visible directly.

It was said that he was a kid that the previous leader of the Bone Blood Cult had brought and tortured to an extreme level until he became twisted, and finally after a long time, Red killed the leader and devoured his flesh with delight.
He could have healed but Red still kept his body condition like that since it made him look more oppressive and dangerous.
"Old man, have you found out anything about Vritra?" Red asked.
’Even though the kid’s strength is low right now, he was the centre of all the chaos and might prove useful in the future.’
Red usually remained calm but once he got into a fight, he would turn into a mindless beast.
"Yes, you already know he was brought to this world by a ritual in the small kingdom called Dunshire in the Topaz universe.
I heard he came here with his mother, and the two are very close. Aside from that, the Goddess Diana might also be with him and a classmate of his called Fiona."
The old man replied; finding this much information about Vritra wasn’t difficult.
"Anything else?" Red asked. All other men from the Bone Blood Cult were kneeling behind the two, waiting for any orders.
The stench of blood in the air was high.
"Hmm, well I heard he is here in Ghazi city, that’s all I found." Pink added, pulling his white hair and ripping them away from his head.
"I can sense that the decisive battle is getting close. We just need a catalyst; if things go right then I will be able to tear apart Darius with my own hands."
Red muttered; he loved nothing more than bloodshed, casualties, and disasters.
"Is there a way to find his family?" Red asked, after calming himself.
"Well we can try to find the general location but actually finding them might be impossible."
The old man answered; if he had the ability to find Vritra’s family, then he would have done so already.
"Hmm, general location is good enough; this will work. We just need to lure Vritra out, and we will start sowing discord among all others.
Anyway, for now try to find anything related to his family, anything even a piece of nail or hair as soon as possible." Red ordered before turning around and breaking apart into a bloody mist.
’I wonder what this lunatic is planning now but it certainly aligns with us, demons’ plans. But finding that would be difficult.’
While deep in thoughts, he jumped off the building and disappeared as well.
While finding this info his next goal was the Nine Pacts. All over the continent, a deadly storm was slowly brewing.
Maeve flew towards Vritra, using less than 5% of her strength, she still believed that her idea was better.
Taking a long breath, Vritra stood without raising his guard, letting the demoness’s punch collide with his chest directly.
His body was instantly blasted back. The gap between a demon lord and even a general is enormous; just one attack could annihilate several generals.
"Oh, are you alright?" Maeve worriedly flew towards Vritra, who landed on the ground with a loud boom.
But instead of any painful expression, there was a frown on his face as he stared into the empty air. Despite that powerful punch, the meter of the Charged Fist was still at 0.
Though his clothes barely seemed to be holding up.
"Is that the best you can do? Give me 30% of your full strength and don’t pull your punch this time."
Vritra said in an emotionless tone; rather than getting hit he was in the mood to beat someone up badly and take all his anger out.
But where exactly were the targets?
"Heh, you asked for it, here I come." Maeve announced, feeling reassured.
A deadly pinkish energy began to gather near her fist; she was using pure physical strength without any special skills right now.
Kicking the air, a loud sonic boom resounded as the slender arm flew at lightning speed; another deadly blow landed straight at Vritra’s chest, instantly ripping his upper body clothes completely.
BOOOOM!
The surrounding trees swung and a few were pulled off the ground, dust and rubble flying all over as a big crater appeared at the place Vritra was standing.
While his body was thrown back, hitting and breaking apart one tree after another.
Despite his almost perfect defence, he can’t handle that level of power, at least not without using demonic form.
Only after travelling more than a kilometre was he finally able to take control of his body; Maeve was once again worried that she had used too much power.
But when she got closer, she found Vritra standing calmly, though his clothes were in tatters, there wasn’t so much as a scratch on his body.
’Hoo, look at those muscles, his skin looks softer than mine...’ the fox demon was once again lost in her imagination while Vritra stared at the panel.
[Charged Fist: 0.02%]
’That’s quite low, anyway let’s keep going and see how powerful it actually is.’ Vritra thought, but as he was about to speak Maeve landed in front of him.
{Sin Point Gained: Drooled over +1}
"You should wear this outfit; it won’t be easily torn no matter how many times you get hit, uh but don’t wear it right now." She spoke, after all she wanted to keep looking at the picturesque body.
"Okay, anyway, increase the strength to 100% this time." Vritra said. The outfit was a battle suit in black colour; it seemed to be made of quite precious treasures.
"Uhm... are you sure? Although it is just physical attack, but that would still be very dangerous." Maeve warned, pulling her gaze away with difficulty and looking at his face.
"Do it." He said.
Some distance away in the same forest, three people could be seen walking around cautiously as if they were hiding and running from someone.
It was none other than One-Eyed Demon Lord, Fratty, and Trall.
The demon general and his two underlings, the same ones who had been responsible to destroy the city outside the continent.
But had forgotten the button in the middle of the forest, which was later pressed by Shitless.
After their countless failures and getting beaten up by the human general, Sirius, they were thrown out by their lord.
And their lord even ordered their execution if they were seen in his territory, calling the three utter embarrassment; the lord was made fun of because of these three among the other lords.
"You damned bastards, it’s all because of you two that I am in this condition right now." The one-eyed demon general was floating mere inches from the ground, with his back hunched.
"S- Sorry general, please forgive us sob we just wanted to give you a s- surprise. I- If you want you can cut off our heads and then use our skulls to drink wine."
Fratty said, as he hurriedly followed behind the lord; the fat on his body kept jiggling.
"Yes general, we don’t even know which bastard secretly pressed that button and saved all those people.
If no one had done that then it would have even exploded automatically after a while and all the people would be dead already." Trall said, fearfully flapping his bat-like wings.
"Shut up! You useless bastards, because of you I have now turned into a homeless dog. I don’t know which cursed day it was when I decided to accept you two as my underlings."
The one-eyed demon cursed.
"B- But general, I thought w- we were brothers from different mothers... sob if you hate us so much then cut open our bellies and pull out our intestines, then use it as a straw."
Trall said, resigning himself to fate.
"Aghhh These idiots, just keep quiet!!" the demon general shouted, his face twisted and his single eye was filled with tears of frustration.
"..." the three continued to move for a while then Fratty couldn’t stop himself from speaking:
"G- General, can I speak? Can I ask something?"
"Now that the gutter is open, throw out whatever dirt is inside." The demon general growled.
"So where are we going now? Are we to join some other demon lord? Or maybe! So have you decided to retribute against our previous lord and throw him off the throne? That’s perfect- mmph"
Fratty was speaking when the general hurriedly closed his mouth.
"You fuckers!! Do you wish to get me skewered and burned alive by our ex lord?" then he took out a whip and began to hit the two underlings.
The fat one, Fratty’s body was torn while Trall’s bones cracked under the beating.
"Yessss! Oohhhhh~ M- My general ahhhh r- right there~ kiyaaaaah~"
"hnnggggg~ General, p- punish us harder Mmmm~ we deserve it anngggg~"

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Future Slave
paragraphs: After beating his two underlings, the one-eyed general finally stopped, then he put away the whip and began to walk forward.
Fratty and Trall followed behind the general, their wounds closing quickly.
"S- So General, what’s your plan for the future?" Trall asked carefully.
"Hoo, we are going to recruit a future demon lord." The general answered, before continuing: "Vritra, everyone knows he is definitely going to be a demon lord in the future.
But right now he is very weak, if we protect and recruit him now then imagine in the future, a demon lord would be my underling, kneeling in front of me kukuku."

"Ohhh! As expected of our great general, demon lord as our slave, but where are we going to find this Vritra guy? It’s not like he would pop up right in front of us when everyone else is busy finding him."
Fratty said, his wings on the verge of giving up.
"Let’s go to the Ghazi city, if we are lucky we might find him there." The general, this was the most difficult part, finding him.
Only if they could find him, then recruiting him would be easy with his strength, and then he would have a bright future.
"Hehe, let’s get the demon lord!" Trall shouted, only to turn silent and stare into the distance, as explosive sounds rang out.
"Shh... there are people ahead." The three hid and secretly began to watch.
Vritra had just been blasted back as Maeve used her full strength; as usual, he didn’t sustain any injuries.
After he stabilized his body, Vritra once again looked at the status panel.
[Charged Fist: 0.08%]
For some reason, even when she had used her full strength, the number didn’t go up too much.
If he didn’t possess Divine’s Physique, then this skill would have been pretty useless.
Just as he was about to ask for the next round, Vritra and Maeve both sensed three presences not too far away in the forest.
"Hmm, they are weak, should I go take care of them?"
"..." Vritra focused and found out that the three were demons, one of them was even a general, but with his strength he could easily handle them now.
"No, it’s fine, I will take care of them—"
But before he could make a move, another person flashed a few meters away from Maeve, a crazy look on his face.
"Hah, found you!"
The entire palace had been destroyed by the gift Vritra had left behind.
Since most of the strongest guards were busy with other tasks, they weren’t able to protect the building itself.
There were many important people in the party; thankfully no one got hurt nor did anyone suspect the emperor of anything.
They too believed it was done by demons and Vritra, just as the news said.
Although a vast amount of wealth had been wasted with the enormous castle being turned into rubble, for someone like Darius, it wouldn’t be hard to make another even grander palace.
Countless men and women had already started the work; with their efficiency and abilities, nearly half of the castle’s structure was already built.
Darius sat over his throne, watching the reports; on a seat not far away from him was his younger brother, Griffith.
After the wedding night, Darius tried to look for Yennefer but she was nowhere to be found.
Who knows what happened that she even gave up on such a golden opportunity to kill a demon lord.
’I wonder what could be more important for her than to kill the creatures she hates more than anything.’ Darius thought, while absentmindedly staring at the papers.
"Emperor." Green Claw knelt in front of Darius, greeting him respectfully.
"Have you found her?" he questioned; behind the emperor was Han, who was also quite worried about Yennefer.
"No, maybe she has gone somewhere as usual, hunting demons." Green Claw answered.
He wasn’t all that worried; what could even happen to someone like the empress?
Being from the same family, he had obtained countless benefits inside the palace; even the position he obtained there was all because of his family name.
"Hmm, keep searching." Darius said before busying himself with other work.
’Yennefer, are you okay?’ Han sighed; although this was her usual personality, he had a feeling that something was different this time.
Green Claw bowed again before standing up and walking out of there. Griffith excused himself and hurriedly followed behind Green Claw.
After walking enough distance away, the two stopped.
"Have you obtained what I asked you to?" Griffith asked in a whisper.
"Yes prince, it is ready. Sigh, I had to go through so much trouble just to finish this task, please take better care of me in the future."
Green Claw spoke, as he took out something from his storage.
"Keke, don’t you worry; irrespective of success or failure, I will remember this favour." Griffith said as he took the glass-like cubical glyph.
This glyph alone was quite valuable, as it could allow its user to teleport to a certain location once. But what made it so much more precious was its another ability.
Inside the glass glyph, a single drop of blood could be seen, hovering inside it.
This blood belonged to Maeve, and by using this glyph, Griffith would be able to teleport close to her.
"Hahaha, very good, excellent, this is great! Green Fang or whatever, I will definitely remember you." Griffith laughed maniacally.
He had a really bad reputation around the entire continent.
Everyone knew he was a eunuch before, but even after getting the tool, he could never get excited.
But only upon seeing that demonic being did he experience what excitement, love and lust is.
He wanted to get her, keep her hidden from the world.
Her otherworldly beauty, those graceful movements, everything about her was too tempting.
Griffith wanted her very badly but since Yennefer was going to kill him he could do nothing but give up on his first love.
But now he finally got a chance, all thanks to the strange green guy.
Not only did he arrange for the Blood Call glyph but even gave him a drop of Maeve’s blood.
"Uh, I am Green Claw, anyway, I will be waiting to hear good news.
And don’t worry, this secret will stay only between the two of us. Go and turn that demon into your slave." He encouraged, imagining an even brighter future ahead.
"Yeah yeah, I will find you after I am done with this." Griffith said casually. Of course after he had caught Maeve, how could he let this guy live?
After thinking for a while, and making sure that he was completely prepared, Griffith injected a little of his mana into the glyph and disappeared.
"Hah, found you!" Griffith shouted, his face breaking into a twisted grin, as he stared maniacally at the gorgeous and voluptuous Fox demon.
Maeve was surprised at first, but then frowned. She knew a little about this guy, and she definitely didn’t have a good impression of him.
"So you came alone?" the space around Maeve’s body was filled with a deadly pressure, as her eyes began to glow, letting out intense killing intent.
It seemed these pathetic humans were underestimating her too much, or maybe he thought she would still be injured.
But now, he had just walked up to his death.

sentences.text: After beating his two underlings, the one-eyed general finally stopped, then he put away the whip and began to walk forward.
Fratty and Trall followed behind the general, their wounds closing quickly.
"S- So General, what’s your plan for the future?" Trall asked carefully.
"Hoo, we are going to recruit a future demon lord." The general answered, before continuing: "Vritra, everyone knows he is definitely going to be a demon lord in the future.
But right now he is very weak, if we protect and recruit him now then imagine in the future, a demon lord would be my underling, kneeling in front of me kukuku."
"Ohhh!
As expected of our great general, demon lord as our slave, but where are we going to find this Vritra guy?
It’s not like he would pop up right in front of us when everyone else is busy finding him."
Fratty said, his wings on the verge of giving up.
"Let’s go to the Ghazi city, if we are lucky we might find him there." The general, this was the most difficult part, finding him.
Only if they could find him, then recruiting him would be easy with his strength, and then he would have a bright future.
"Hehe, let’s get the demon lord!" Trall shouted, only to turn silent and stare into the distance, as explosive sounds rang out.
"Shh... there are people ahead." The three hid and secretly began to watch.
Vritra had just been blasted back as Maeve used her full strength; as usual, he didn’t sustain any injuries.
After he stabilized his body, Vritra once again looked at the status panel.
[Charged Fist: 0.08%]
For some reason, even when she had used her full strength, the number didn’t go up too much.
If he didn’t possess Divine’s Physique, then this skill would have been pretty useless.
Just as he was about to ask for the next round, Vritra and Maeve both sensed three presences not too far away in the forest.
"Hmm, they are weak, should I go take care of them?"
"..." Vritra focused and found out that the three were demons, one of them was even a general, but with his strength he could easily handle them now.
"No, it’s fine, I will take care of them—"
But before he could make a move, another person flashed a few meters away from Maeve, a crazy look on his face.
"Hah, found you!"
The entire palace had been destroyed by the gift Vritra had left behind.
Since most of the strongest guards were busy with other tasks, they weren’t able to protect the building itself.
There were many important people in the party; thankfully no one got hurt nor did anyone suspect the emperor of anything.
They too believed it was done by demons and Vritra, just as the news said.
Although a vast amount of wealth had been wasted with the enormous castle being turned into rubble, for someone like Darius, it wouldn’t be hard to make another even grander palace.
Countless men and women had already started the work; with their efficiency and abilities, nearly half of the castle’s structure was already built.
Darius sat over his throne, watching the reports; on a seat not far away from him was his younger brother, Griffith.
After the wedding night, Darius tried to look for Yennefer but she was nowhere to be found.
Who knows what happened that she even gave up on such a golden opportunity to kill a demon lord.
’I wonder what could be more important for her than to kill the creatures she hates more than anything.’ Darius thought, while absentmindedly staring at the papers.
"Emperor." Green Claw knelt in front of Darius, greeting him respectfully.
"Have you found her?" he questioned; behind the emperor was Han, who was also quite worried about Yennefer.
"No, maybe she has gone somewhere as usual, hunting demons." Green Claw answered.
He wasn’t all that worried; what could even happen to someone like the empress?
Being from the same family, he had obtained countless benefits inside the palace; even the position he obtained there was all because of his family name.
"Hmm, keep searching." Darius said before busying himself with other work.
’Yennefer, are you okay?’ Han sighed; although this was her usual personality, he had a feeling that something was different this time.
Green Claw bowed again before standing up and walking out of there.
Griffith excused himself and hurriedly followed behind Green Claw.
After walking enough distance away, the two stopped.
"Have you obtained what I asked you to?" Griffith asked in a whisper.
"Yes prince, it is ready.
Sigh, I had to go through so much trouble just to finish this task, please take better care of me in the future."
Green Claw spoke, as he took out something from his storage.
"Keke, don’t you worry; irrespective of success or failure, I will remember this favour." Griffith said as he took the glass-like cubical glyph.
This glyph alone was quite valuable, as it could allow its user to teleport to a certain location once.
But what made it so much more precious was its another ability.
Inside the glass glyph, a single drop of blood could be seen, hovering inside it.
This blood belonged to Maeve, and by using this glyph, Griffith would be able to teleport close to her.
"Hahaha, very good, excellent, this is great!
Green Fang or whatever, I will definitely remember you." Griffith laughed maniacally.
He had a really bad reputation around the entire continent.
Everyone knew he was a eunuch before, but even after getting the tool, he could never get excited.
