chapters.title: Chapter 393: Monster!
paragraphs: Griffith was actually surprised that Maeve looked perfectly fine.
From the information he had received from the Green Claw, she should be barely alive right now.
Getting rid of that poison is near impossible, but despite his initial surprise, he wasn’t going to run.
Griffith had made the necessary preparations in advance and was 100% sure of his victory against the fox demon despite the difference in their strength.
Spending quite a lot of resources, he found out the exact weaknesses of Maeve and arranged everything in advance.
’She won’t even be able to escape anymore.’ Griffith thought as he watched Maeve’s expression change from surprise to rage.
Without wasting a moment, the first thing he did was inject some mana into a glyph he was hiding in his clothes, which exploded and created a sphere of energy that grew quickly.
Within moments, the white energy sphere had locked in the area of a few kilometres.
This was a great treasure from the emperor’s personal treasury; not even Maeve would be able to escape from it.
Then he moved back hurriedly and pulled two round green balls and held them tightly in his hands.
Despite his preparations, he couldn’t be careless against such a powerful demon queen.
But in his excitement, he wasn’t able to notice the third presence right behind him, as Griffith’s back bumped into someone.
"Huh? Who is it?" While keeping a close eye on Maeve he turned and glanced back, seeing Vritra hovering in the air.
"Hmm, I think I have seen you somewhere..."
Griffith mumbled as he moved some distance away from Vritra.
Judging from the sight alone, it was obvious that Vritra and Maeve were fighting, and despite the destruction around, none of them were injured.
So there certainly wasn’t a big difference between their strength.
"Whoever you are, help me subdue this demon. You will be greatly rewarded by the emperor himself. I might even make you my protector.
I am the prince of the Quartz continent, Griffith." He announced proudly, waiting for Vritra to deeply bow in front of him.
But such a thing didn’t happen; Vritra just looked back at him with a stoic face.
"Hahaha, you don’t know him?" Maeve couldn’t help but laugh out loud upon seeing the prince ask for Vritra’s help.
"Hmm?" Griffith again focussed on Vritra’s face; he did seem a bit familiar since he was in his true form right now, except the horns.
"Hello Griffith, I am Vritra. How unfortunate to have met you again." Vritra said.
With a snap of his finger, another layer of barrier appeared around the white barrier, formed from the evil veyll god essence.
Not even the combined attacks from Maeve, Griffith and the three demons in hiding would be able to break it in a short time.
"Vritra... Vritra... VRITRA!! You are him, the new Divine, the demon lord in making? B- But weren’t you supposed to be very weak?"
Griffith gazed at the barrier and felt that the information they had obtained was wrong.
There was no way he was as weak as everyone believed.
"I indeed am weak; barely at the 3rd Legion rank as you might have heard. Now why don’t you come forward and show me your true strength?" Vritra said, a look of madness in his eyes.

Griffith had delivered himself at the perfect time; Vritra really wanted to take all his rage and frustration out on someone, and who could be a better choice than this eunuch who is also the emperor’s brother?
’With the barrier I put earlier, there is no chance of Maeve escaping in a short time.
Catching Vritra first is important; if I can do it my status will definitely be elevated and I would be known as someone who killed the demon lord!’ Griffith was filled with even more excitement.
He only came here to catch Maeve but unexpectedly had gained something really, really valuable.
"T- That’s Vritra?! We found him so easily, General, let’s go and recruit him." Fratty shouted, and almost ran out in the open.
But the one-eyed general held him back, his body shivering in terror.
His single eye moved from Maeve to Griffith; there was no way he would be able to defeat either of them.
"Sigh, forget it, we were too late it seems, we can’t save him. Don’t make any noise or we might be the first ones to die." He warned.
"Haha, Maeve, why don’t you wait a little for me? Let me finish this up then we will deal with our... business." Griffith said, smiling.

Vritra placed both his palms over his face, closing his eyes and taking a deep breath. Then he pushed his hair back as two horns grew over his head, and his veins turned purplish, as a burst of demonic energy consumed his body.
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification(55%)]
He instantly underwent the demonic transformation. The demon lord core had been completely devoured by the Evil Veyll God Essence core by now.

A deadly aura rose around Vritra, twisting the air itself. Using the laws of space with his comprehension of the Space Field, Vritra locked everything up after transferring everyone into the dimensional book.
There was no way for Griffith to escape or use any tricks.
"Show me, how confident are you of victory." Vritra challenged, gesturing at him to attack.
’So he really is a demon, but what sort of energy is this? There is no way he is weak, let me try it first; if nothing works I will escape then.’
Griffith thought, not to mention Maeve was still a danger and his strength was nowhere close to an actual lord.
"Be prepared, I am attackin—" Just while speaking, Griffith tried a sneak attack, his body becoming a blur as he flashed behind Vritra and with all his might he punched at his back.
This wasn’t just a physical attack; his entire arm had transformed into a strange metallic arm as tiny pieces of unknown metal stuck to his hand, increasing its size and power by several times.
At some unknown point, Vritra had turned around, raising his right hand he pointed a finger towards the large fist.
BOOOOOOOM
His hand was stopped instantly, not even able to push him back even an inch, as a strong gust of wind exploded in all directions.
The skill Recoil was also responsible for it; Vritra wasn’t pushed back instead Griffith was the one whose hand was bounced back.
Griffith’s heart thumped violently, although this wasn’t his strongest attack but it was definitely almost his full strength.
It had become completely obvious that Vritra wasn’t as weak as the rumors said; his real strength was definitely at the lord rank.
"Y- You deceived me!" Griffith said, and he knew that his only chance at survival was to escape.
Outrunning Vritra was just impossible; calling for help might work but Vritra just might finish him before the help arrives.
He did possess many treasures though, a crazed look appeared in his eyes as he pulled a scroll from his storage and shouted at Vritra.
"It was your mistake to reveal yourself before me, today is going to be the last day for you and your family."
After speaking he opened the scroll and threw it into the air.
A pillar of white light appeared around him and in an instant it had swallowed Griffith, making him disappear.

chapters.title: Chapter 394: Caring Brother
paragraphs: A pillar of white light appeared around Griffith and in an instant it had swallowed him, making him disappear.
A man in disheveled appearance hastily ran towards the newly building palace.
After arriving there, he rushed in to meet the emperor.
"Griffith, what happened to you?" Darius shouted, standing up instantly with great concern in his eyes.
"Brother, I- I saw Vritra Arclis just now, h- he was outside the Ghazi city, in the forest.
He is actually a demon—" Griffith was panting heavily as he explained everything.
"But how did you escape from there?" Darius asked, giving him some water to drink.
GULP
"I- I used the scroll... I took from your inventory, it allowed me to teleport directly close to you."
Griffith said, he was happy just to be alive now; as for any punishment he would happily take it.
"What if you didn’t have that scroll? You shouldn’t have gone in such danger, you know how much I care for you, right? Did you have any other way to escape?"
Darius asked, hugging his brother tightly.
Griffith’s heart was filled with warmth; he never knew his elder brother actually cared so much for him.
He was really happy to have gotten such a brother and sister-in-law, even though he hated them a lot initially.
"Don’t worry brother, I had dozens of ways to escape even if he had locked the surrounding and the space." Griffith said with a big smile, holding his brother’s arm.
Remembering that demonic presence, the aura emanating around Vritra, still made him shiver.
He had stopped his attack with just a finger.
"Oh right, brother, he isn’t as weak as we all believe—" Griffith was explaining when he was interrupted.
"Before that, show it to me, what are your escaping options? I need to be sure that you are always protected; I will even give you more treasures after checking them." Darius said.
Griffith felt immense love for his brother; with a hurried nod, he began to pull one treasure after another.
Each of them was very precious and belonged to the emperor’s personal treasury; no matter what sort of danger he faced, it was near impossible for him to die with them all.
"Good job, little brother, but is that all? Don’t hide anything from me, I am asking for your own good." Darius said solemnly.
"Yes brother, that’s all." Griffith replied, wondering what sort of new treasures he was going to get now.
"Alright then, now it is time for you to die."
Just as Darius spoke these words, the illusion around them began to break apart and Griffith once again found himself standing in the same space.
The demonic figure gazing at him with those glowing red eyes, Maeve laughing at him as if he was some sort of fool while two strange voices seemed to be mocking him from the distance.
Trall and Fratty were both laughing at the prince who seemed even stupider than their general.
"W- What’s... going on? Didn’t I just escape? There is no way you c- could’ve stopped that scroll!" Griffith’s body suddenly turned cold and fear gripped him.
He had just opened and showed all his escape routes and treasures.
He gazed around and then his eyes focused on the scroll that had been frozen in the sky; it wasn’t only locked by the space but even time.
"H- How can you control two principles? It doesn’t seem to be a skill..." Griffith’s body was shivering, as Vritra seemed more monstrous by the second.
He had never heard of a person who possessed two Fields.
"Enough with that, let’s fight." Vritra said, taking a step forward; the demonic energy was distorting the air.

"N- No please spare me, I- I will be your slave. I am begging you, we don’t even have any sort of conflict b- between us, please I will do whatever you want. I will even be your agent, your slave, j- just let me live."
Without wasting a heartbeat, Griffith knelt in the air and began to beg.
{Sin Point Gained: Begged +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +4}
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +5}
Griffith continued to beg as he secretly pulled out a dagger from his storage and with a burst of energy he slashed it at the air.

This was also one of his greatest treasures; this knife doesn’t even need to make direct contact as long as the enemy was within range; even if you slash in the opposite direction you would be able to hurt him.
"Die you bastard!!" With all his might and expanding a vast amount of his energy he swung the knife, hoping to cut Vritra into pieces.
After the first slash he didn’t wait to see the effect and continued to swing his hand again and again.
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
The deadly attack continued for over a couple of minutes. In that time, Griffith had exerted more than eighty percent of his energy and was covered in sweat.
"Hahaha Did you think I huff huff am powerless? I am fucking Griffith, the prince of the Quartz continent. I am neither a eunuch nor a lapdog for my brother, I am going to slaughter you all!"
Only after his hand felt like breaking from the over exertion, did the prince finally stop; he was breathing very heavily.
Leaning forward, he placed his hands over his knees to take some rest and finally looked at Vritra.
The demon whose body was bursting out with purple energy stood perfectly fine; even the body suit he was wearing had tiny cuts on it but they disappeared within moments.
"Hmm is that all?" Vritra asked, tilting his head with a bored expression.
Since Griffith was going to die anyway, he thought to make the most of it and let him increase the charged fist’s percentage a little.
But his strength was too low. Even after all those attacks, it didn’t increase by much.
"H- How... how can you still be fine? This is just impossible. Sob Please spare me... I was a fool, I had gone mad, please just this once sob."
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
Vritra shook his head; this guy was too spineless.
He had wasted enough time, and the sight of this disgusting creature was only making his blood boil.
All the anger Vritra was feeling exploded at once; his veins bulged and several skills like Shift, Forbidden, Blood Lock were activated at once.
Vritra’s body disappeared, freezing Griffith with dread. His vision was instantly covered by darkness as a heart wrenching scream rang out.
After taking his own dagger, Vritra stabbed at the empty air twice, as the squishing sound of both his eyeballs bursting rang out.
Throwing the knife into the inventory, Vritra flashed behind Griffith, his nails grew slightly becoming pointy and very sharp.
Then he plunged all ten of his fingers into Griffith’s throat and with a loud roar, shaking the space, he ripped away at his flesh.
From his neck to his chest, Vritra tore him apart before punching Griffith’s back with all his strength, blasting a massive hole in his torso.
"AhhhhhhCOUGH COUGHKrrrkkhhh S- Sav... Helllpp- ughhhh cough" he kept choking on his own blood, his body hitting the ground and bouncing back.

Trall and Fratty were both laughing at the prince who seemed even stupider than their general.
"W- What’s... going on?
Didn’t I just escape?
There is no way you c- could’ve stopped that scroll!" Griffith’s body suddenly turned cold and fear gripped him.
He had just opened and showed all his escape routes and treasures.
He gazed around and then his eyes focused on the scroll that had been frozen in the sky; it wasn’t only locked by the space but even time.
"H- How can you control two principles?
It doesn’t seem to be a skill..." Griffith’s body was shivering, as Vritra seemed more monstrous by the second.
He had never heard of a person who possessed two Fields.
"Enough with that, let’s fight." Vritra said, taking a step forward; the demonic energy was distorting the air.
"N- No please spare me, I- I will be your slave.
I am begging you, we don’t even have any sort of conflict b- between us, please I will do whatever you want.
I will even be your agent, your slave, j- just let me live."
Without wasting a heartbeat, Griffith knelt in the air and began to beg.
{Sin Point Gained: Begged +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Feared +4}
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +5}
Griffith continued to beg as he secretly pulled out a dagger from his storage and with a burst of energy he slashed it at the air.

This was also one of his greatest treasures; this knife doesn’t even need to make direct contact as long as the enemy was within range; even if you slash in the opposite direction you would be able to hurt him.
"Die you bastard!!" With all his might and expanding a vast amount of his energy he swung the knife, hoping to cut Vritra into pieces.
After the first slash he didn’t wait to see the effect and continued to swing his hand again and again.
WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH WHOOSH
The deadly attack continued for over a couple of minutes.
In that time, Griffith had exerted more than eighty percent of his energy and was covered in sweat.
"Hahaha Did you think I huff huff am powerless?
I am fucking Griffith, the prince of the Quartz continent.
I am neither a eunuch nor a lapdog for my brother, I am going to slaughter you all!"
Only after his hand felt like breaking from the over exertion, did the prince finally stop; he was breathing very heavily.
Leaning forward, he placed his hands over his knees to take some rest and finally looked at Vritra.
The demon whose body was bursting out with purple energy stood perfectly fine; even the body suit he was wearing had tiny cuts on it but they disappeared within moments.
"Hmm is that all?" Vritra asked, tilting his head with a bored expression.
Since Griffith was going to die anyway, he thought to make the most of it and let him increase the charged fist’s percentage a little.
But his strength was too low.
Even after all those attacks, it didn’t increase by much.
"H- How... how can you still be fine?
This is just impossible.
Sob Please spare me...
I was a fool, I had gone mad, please just this once sob."
{Sin Point Gained: Pleaded +1}
Vritra shook his head; this guy was too spineless.
He had wasted enough time, and the sight of this disgusting creature was only making his blood boil.
All the anger Vritra was feeling exploded at once; his veins bulged and several skills like Shift, Forbidden, Blood Lock were activated at once.
Vritra’s body disappeared, freezing Griffith with dread.
His vision was instantly covered by darkness as a heart wrenching scream rang out.
After taking his own dagger, Vritra stabbed at the empty air twice, as the squishing sound of both his eyeballs bursting rang out.
Throwing the knife into the inventory, Vritra flashed behind Griffith, his nails grew slightly becoming pointy and very sharp.
Then he plunged all ten of his fingers into Griffith’s throat and with a loud roar, shaking the space, he ripped away at his flesh.
From his neck to his chest, Vritra tore him apart before punching Griffith’s back with all his strength, blasting a massive hole in his torso.
"AhhhhhhCOUGH COUGHKrrrkkhhh S- Sav...
Helllpp- ughhhh cough" he kept choking on his own blood, his body hitting the ground and bouncing back.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: Provocation
paragraphs: Vritra flashed beside Griffith, punching his body again and again.
All his protective treasures were broken by the devastating force, his body twisting and breaking apart.
The sound of explosions and screams flooded the area; the meatball was no match for him.
The crunching of all his bones turning into powder made the three demons hiding shiver.
Even Maeve was shocked by this sight; she had seen how brutal Vritra could be when he had killed those human dolls in Zihong’s inheritance.
But right now he didn’t seem to be himself, but a wild beast who only knew destruction.
He was thoroughly destroying Griffith, making it as painful for him as possible but not giving him death.
Vritra let out a destructive roar, making the prince’s ear burst and nearly half of his brain turned into minced meat.
But Griffith’s body was healing rather fast because of some treasure, but even after knowing this, Vritra did nothing to the treasure.
He let him heal a bit only to destroy him even more.
With an inhumane and merciless expression, Vritra twisted and pulled away Griffith’s jaw.
Then pulling that spatial knife, he slashed again and again, turning his lower body into a bloody mess as it fell to the ground in tiny pieces.
Griffith kept trying to run; the pain was to the point that he had become mad within a few minutes.
Vritra turned the dust into something extremely hot, something that could turn lava into vapour and let it flow into the broken man’s veins.
Even using the nether eye’s ability to slowly corrode his soul, mind, and body but not completely, just giving him all the pain he could.
Vritra could almost see Darius’s disgusting face in Griffith’s, though now his face was so broken that even his healing skill had slowed down and couldn’t heal him back.
This level of torture continued for several hours; by the time Vritra stopped, Griffith was completely broken and barely alive.
Vritra took a spear from Griffith’s storage and spoke:
"Say hello to your brother."
Then he pulled his right hand back and threw the spear towards Griffith, as it tore through the air.
CHHIIIIIIII
One of Griffith’s eyes had barely healed and his jaw was still hanging onto his head with a strand of flesh.
The spear plunged into his open mouth, ripping away his head and flying towards the scroll.
The frozen scroll in the air finally lost its restriction and it turned into a white pillar of light, swallowing up the spear and the head.
Inside the palace, Darius was still checking up the recent affairs and giving orders to his commanders about Vritra, Maeve, and Raelion’s search.
"Hoo, I didn’t expect such a perfect night to bring me so much trouble. Who do you think was responsible for that explosion?
It was done at such a perfect time that no one could have predicted it." Darius leaned back on his throne, massaging the bridge of his nose.
"It might very well be Raelion, we all know how cunning he is. B- But what if he had done something to the empress? None of us can still get a hold of her after she ran out."
Hans said in worry; he knew that in this life he would never be able to receive love from Yennefer but he at least wanted to protect her and make sure she is always happy.
"You worry too much, nothing could happen to her. Just focus on your work. If you were this diligent about your job as well, then I wouldn’t have to worry so much about this—"
Just as he was speaking, a pillar of white light descended a few meters away from him.
And then a spear flew out from it, heading straight for his head. Of course, Darius easily avoided the spear with a slight tilt of his head, as the spear pierced through the throne.
Hans got ready to defend against any other surprise attacks but then they froze upon noticing the head skewered by the spear; it looked way too broken.
Only because of the familiar mana was Darius able to recognise him.
"Griffith?! What happened to you? Didn’t you just go out?"
Darius couldn’t understand what could have happened in a span of a few hours and who would dare hurt his brother in his continent, not to mention that he wasn’t able to notice it.
"..." Gritting his teeth, he pulled several high-level potions and began to pour them over his head.
Although their relation wasn’t very good, they were still brothers and he had made a promise to his father to always protect him.
"Tell me who did it? And I am not going to let anything happen to you!" Darius shouted, not caring about the wealth he was pouring on his half-brother.
"B- Brothe... S- saveee..."
As Griffith healed a little bit, he called out in desperation, begging as bloody tears streaked across his cheeks.
The sight only made Darius angrier; someone actually dared to challenge him in such a manner.
How could the human emperor not be enraged?
His body was shaking and under the pressure of his aura, the whole walls and ground were trembling.
"Stay with me, you are going to be alright!"
Hans rushed forward too; while the emperor was treating Griffith he made sure there wasn’t anything dangerous in the surrounding.
"Emperor, should I find where the battle has taken place?" Hans asked.
"GO!" Now that Griffith had returned to him, he won’t let his brother die, even if he was on his last breath.
Not a single chance of anyone being able to hurt Griffith in his presence.

Hans bowed before rushing outside; there should still be fluctuations of the battle if it was between such strong beings, and unless he was fighting someone at the lord rank, no way Griffith would lose easily.
Pulling out ten more potions, Darius poured it all on Griffith’s head, as he rapidly began to heal.
"Griffith, stay awake, you will be fine very soo—" Darius had not finished speaking when Griffith’s shadow moved strangely.
Then it transformed into a strange sorcerer appearing right beside the head that had barely grown the neck.
The Hellmancer opened his mouth with a twisted gape, endless darkness pouring out as it bit at Griffith’s head, swallowing his soul instantly and finally putting an end to the prince.
The emperor was so shaken by this that he was still pouring the potion over Griffith’s head.
Believing that no one would dare to hurt the prince in his presence and right in front of him, Darius had put his guard down.
And that one instant was enough for this strange creature to devour his brother’s soul.
Hellmancer’s strength increased rapidly, the darkness becoming more profound and deadly.
Then raising its long bony finger towards the emperor, it muttered in its twisted and rough voice: "You are next."
Then Hellmancer’s body began to swell at an unbelievable speed. The emperor was still in shock at the sudden death of his brother when he sensed the deadly energy.
He couldn’t tell immediately what sort of being it was but he didn’t expect the sorcerer to commit suicide all of a sudden.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Lust- Check!
paragraphs: BOOOOOOOOOOM!!
Darius hurriedly grabbed Griffith’s head and covered himself in a barrier as the vast destructive energy swallowed the entire newly built palace, once again breaking it down until nothing was left.
All the people were blasted away but with the strong guards’ protection, at least no one had died.
"NOOOOOOOOOOOO!!" Darius held Griffith’s head as endless grief filled him.
This was the one promise he had made to his father when getting the throne, although there wasn’t any brotherly love between the two but he didn’t hate his brother either.
Despite Griffith doing all sorts of things, he was only alive because of Darius; he believed it to be a duty just as important as being an emperor.
But now he had failed, killing intent rose around him as he let out a blood-curdling scream.
He wanted to kill whoever was responsible for this; it was obvious the other person was trying to provoke him, otherwise they wouldn’t have killed Griffith in such a manner.
[You have killed Pseudo Lord ranked human.]
[You have levelled up.]
[You have levelled up.]
[You have levelled up.]
[+Exp]
[+Exp]
[+Exp]
[All Attributes have increased by 50.]
[All Attributes have increased by 50.]
[All Attributes have increased by 50.]
[You have gained 50 Allocation Points.]
[You have gained 50 Allocation Points.]
[You have gained 50 Allocation Points.]
Message after message poured in front of Vritra the moment Griffith died; he had instantly reached the peak of the 5th Legion rank and then needed the empty legion stones to break through.
Griffith’s strength was definitely higher than a general, but above that Vritra had no idea; he decided to learn about it all from Yasmine later.
Still floating in the air, the majestic aura swirling around his body and the two horns making him look like the ruler of all demonic beings.
His gaze locked onto the three beings who were still shivering; they couldn’t believe that it was the same person they wanted to turn into their slave.
"Come out!" Vritra called out, his voice sounding cold and emotionless.
"M- My lord, please spare us. We are innocent- I mean we are the bad guys, we are on the same team." The one-eyed demon hastily jumped forward and prostrated himself on the ground.
His two underlings followed behind, shivering in fear.
"..." Vritra stared at the three for a few seconds and couldn’t think of a reason to spare them; raising his right hand he shot three orbs of energies that swallowed the three.
Hellmancer took form once again and swallowed the three souls; unlike Vritra, it didn’t need any soul stones or anything.
The sorcerer’s strength was already nearly equivalent to Griffith’s.
Familiar messages popped in front of Vritra; he could feel his body strengthen at a rapid pace.
"..." On the other side, Maeve was staring at him with wide, intoxicated eyes, her tail swinging quickly from left to right.
’H- He protected me just now with his life! Oof He looks so dazzling...’ the fox demon just stared at him absent-mindedly, growing fonder of him by the second.
"Are you okay?" Vritra asked, seeing her make such a strange expression.
’Oh my, he is still worried about me. Hehe it seems my evil plan has almost succeeded.’ Maeve shook her head as a big beautiful smile formed on her face.
"Yes masterrr~ I am perfectly fine, do you want to continue with the training or should we go back so I can give you a nice and long bath?"
Maeve asked, flying closer. Her charms can definitely be compared to the most gorgeous succubus; with her body she could even charm gods.
But despite seeing the clear meaning, Vritra refused to develop any more relations; he just doesn’t want to go through all that all over again.
"Let’s keep fighting, attack me with full strength, don’t hold back at all." Vritra said, turning the Switch off as all the purple energy disappeared.
"Okay master~" Maeve was no longer worried over hurting him, and so in the next moment she began to attack him with her strongest attacks.
A few hours had passed when Vritra and Maeve finally stopped; the demoness was panting lightly after having exhausted quite a bit of energy.
[Charged Fist: 13.82%]
Despite getting hit by so many of her attacks, the charge has only risen so much; Vritra did want to test it but he decided to keep on accumulating it.
"Return to that hotel, I will come meet you later on." Vritra said; he planned to visit the city of charms, wishing to spend some time with Fiona and Diana.
"H- Huh? You are leaving already? Again? Let’s go to the hotel first, you shouldn’t return home looking like this." Maeve suggested, since Vritra was still covered in blood.
She had noticed it; he seemed completely different from before, almost as if he had built a wall around him to keep everyone away.
That playful, approachable nature was locked under his cold exterior.
Vritra looked down at himself and he indeed was covered in blood; while beating up the prince, his only focus was to vent all his anger.
But he could also tell that the demoness might have started to have feelings for him.
"Sigh It would be best for both of us if we don’t get close; we will be parting ways very soon anyways and might end up as enemies in the future." He spoke, his trust literally at level 0.
At least his best friend, Zengis’s girl, is loyal.
"Hmm Why do you say that?" Maeve asked, a pondering look on her face.
"... Do you like me or anything?" Vritra asked directly; it was better to deal with the problem initially than to let it grow.
"Like you?" the demoness wondered; she hadn’t really thought about it yet.
First she thought what liking and loving even is.
I lust after him- Check!
Enjoy my time with him- Check!
Eye Candy- Check!
I feel protected and safe, and feel attracted- Check!
He has a hot body- Check!
Lust- Check again!
After a thorough contemplation, she was perfectly sure that it was nothing less than true love.
"Yes master~ I love you, are you going to punish me for that?" Maeve asked, while imagining the sinful punishment.
"It’s not so simple, you know just how much danger is revolving around me, not to mention I have other women-" while he was speaking the foxie interrupted.
"There is a rule among us demons and that is, we don’t follow any rules. Especially me, if I like something I take it.
Whether it be the family heirloom of the empress’s family or a man, and I don’t mind you having multiple women since it isn’t a rarity among the demons, just don’t create an army of women."
Maeve added, as long as she could get some personal time, what else would matter.
Vritra shook his head; this foxie was so much different from all his women, no matter the question all her answers seemed to end at the same point.
"Anyway, do you have Empty Legion stones?" he asked.
"Yes, I have all up to the 10th Legion rank, you can take them." Maeve answered immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 397: Her Obsession
paragraphs: "Yes, I have all up to the 10th Legion rank, you can take them." Maeve got even closer to Vritra, leaning her head forward for a pat.
Since some time ago he had even stopped giving her pats, the demoness wondered what might have changed him so much all of a sudden.
After thinking for a few moments, Vritra decided to go along with her; from there he would return to the city of charms.
"Let’s go." He spoke and flew away, the barrier around the place finally broke.
"Masterrr~ wait for me." Maeve flew and slowed down upon arriving beside him, teasing him and tickling his cheek with her tail.
With the fox constantly trying to cheer him up, the two soon arrived inside the continent; they only stopped upon reaching the hotel.
Only after Vritra and Maeve had left did Hans finally arrive there; only now was he able to sense the fluctuations of energy.
"They have already left? I can feel the demonic presence, so it really was a demon who has done it? Could it be Raelion? But this feels different."
Hans pondered; after a while he decided to leave and report it all to the emperor.
Unaware of the fact that the prince had already been killed.
A large distance away from the Quartz continent, over a very, very tall mountain sat a woman in an expensive-looking dress.
She was holding onto a handkerchief, staring absentmindedly at the thin air.
Her blue hair looked dishevelled and eyes red. Yennefer had searched for Vritra yet he had completely disappeared, leaving only sorrow and regret.
She couldn’t believe that their relation had actually already ended.
From the time in that inheritance ground, the white kingdom, the abandoned town, all the time they had spent together only brought them closer.
Yennefer was sure that the two of them would be life partners and be together forever; her losses and victories she wanted him to be with her along her journey and at the end.
"..." But now, there seemed to be no path of reconciliation.
’Is it worth it to destroy my future with him for the sake of the past?’ The same question kept ringing in her mind.
’Mother, father, in my obsession because of that incident, I forgot the most important thing. You only ever wanted me to be happy; how can my life be driven just by revenge?’
The words Vritra had said to her after their first meeting in the continent once again entered her mind.
At that time she hadn’t thought much about it, but now she understood why Vritra was so against her obsession.
It wasn’t like he wanted her to give up on her goal; he even promised to help her achieve that same goal but in the end she had failed him.
"I- I am sorry sob," her voice was cracked, feeling extreme sorrow.
Tears kept flowing out of her eyes until her eyes felt dry; she never could have imagined this feeling of separation to be so painful.
She just wanted him to give her one more chance; she had understood having a goal and working to achieve it is fine.
But destroying her present, hurting the only person who loved her so much, pushing him away all for the sake of what?
Killing all demons—then what? Hadn’t she already gotten so much happiness?
Yennefer just sat there, as all sorts of thoughts passed through her mind, in the silence.
After several hours had passed, Yennefer finally stood up and her blue eyes were filled with determination.
Now she knew exactly what she needed to do, what she wanted, and what needed to be thrown.
To hell with the obsession!
Damn the Emperor!
And especially, fuck the family!
She would no longer be bound by any rule, family, obsession or anything.
She didn’t need to and she wanted Vritra back in her life at any cost.
Even if she had to butcher the entire royal family just to appease him, her eyes were filled with a dangerous but different obsession, and so she flew away from the mountain.
"Vritra—no husband, you have to forgive me, e- even if I have to give up on my goal for that."
Yennefer thought; she just wanted to once again be in his embrace, hear his loving voice and feel his tender gaze.
Only after losing it all did she come to understand how precious it all was.
Maeve quickly took out the empty stones, from 6th Legion rank to the 10th Legion rank.
Originally Vritra planned to get them from Yennefer, but with the wedding and all, their relation ended up in shambles.
"Thank you, you can count these as five of the treasures you have promised." Vritra said, as he sat down on the bed.
Although their surroundings looked the same, the two were already inside the dimensional book.
"Uh huh, what are you saying master, with our relation, what’s mine is yours and what’s yours is mine. Don’t mind it and start absorbing them."
Maeve spoke, cupping her cheeks shyly, her tail the perfect display of her emotions.
Vritra didn’t know what to do with this cheeky fox, but despite the building bond between the two, he still felt it would be better to go their separate ways.
Maeve lay beside him, with her back facing the ceiling and her chin resting over her hands, she just stared at his face with a drunken fervour.
Because of all those shitty people, he has to hide such a stunning face; Maeve just wanted to keep looking at it.
Vritra held the empty 6th Legion rank stone first and began to absorb it.
A huge storm of dust instantly began to swirl around him; the bottleneck was slowly broken and enormous waves of energy and strength filled his body.
Griffith’s strength was higher than a general’s so Vritra had gained a vast amount of levels, but with the Evil Veyll God Essence Core in his body, it would be of little benefit for now.
’Haa, he looks so delicious, I wish I could just take a bite off him.’ Since Maeve didn’t want to disturb Vritra now, she stayed still, holding back her urges.
Otherwise she might already have bitten him.
One after another, Vritra began to absorb the empty legion rank stones, his levels rising rapidly.
Even as he absorbed the empty stones, Vritra wondered about the levels ahead of the General rank but his mind was still occupied with the concern of his mother’s safety and with... Yennefer.
While the two were sitting here peacefully, there was a vast storm going on outside.
The news about the prince’s death spread rather quickly despite the emperor trying to suppress it, and it was said that he was killed by the demons in very gruesome ways.
This led people to question whether they were actually as safe inside the continent as they believed, if even the emperor’s younger brother was murdered so openly during the day.
The fear and respect for Darius obviously came down several levels, and the people who never supported the emperor were definitely quite joyous.
On the other hand, the emperor put all his force into searching for the murderer of his brother, even temporarily stopping the search for Vritra.

chapters.title: Chapter 398: World Information Centre
paragraphs: Right after returning to the continent, the first thing that Yennefer did was to make several public announcements.
First, about the fake marriage, she spread the truth: that in reality it was just the emperor’s plan to capture a demon lord named Raelion.

Of course, this news was going to bring quite a lot of trouble for the emperor, and might even break his relation with several power figures, since he literally used them all as nothing more than baits, putting the lives of all guests in danger.
After the revelation of the fake marriage, she announced that she was going to break her engagement with the emperor, and that it never actually meant anything.
Thirdly, she had severed ties with her family, which was the sole reason why she was tied with so many boundaries, and even had to get engaged to the emperor.
Anyone she ever cared for had already died quite a long time ago, so it no longer mattered; she was just connected to them through the memory of her family.

Yet her family was leeching off Yennefer because of her strength and her status as the empress. This announcement would definitely pull the status of the entire family down and would decrease their strength greatly.
Lastly, Yennefer spread a few of the emperor’s secrets that would keep him busy for a while and in trouble, which might give Vritra some relaxing time.
Each and every word she said spread throughout the continent like wildfire. The emperor, who was already dealing with his brother’s death, was shocked by the storm of news.
Not only did Yennefer leave him completely, she even threw him into so much trouble.
Darius was surrounded with problems from all sides; many of the guests with high authority and statuses kept asking him for explanations.
The storm of the world was slowly brewing.
[D-Day 17]
While staring at Vritra, at some point, Maeve fell asleep as his leveling up continued for hours, and just like that, the dawn of the next day had appeared.
Away from all the trouble of the continent, the two stayed in the peace of the dimensional book.
As Vritra’s level rose rapidly, various sorts of changes were occurring around him, whether it be dust, space, or time—all of them were influenced.
Finally, Vritra opened his eyes as he finished absorbing the empty 10th legion rank stone; his strength was incomparably high.
"Congrats, hubby, well that was fast." Yasmine’s voice was the first thing that he heard, sounding relaxing and soothing.

’Hmm. Still it is far from enough. Until I am confident enough to scare all the dragons and can go to the dragon kingdom, I won’t be satisfied,’ Vritra said, as his strength grew, even his abilities getting stronger.
First, he decided to have a look at his status panel.
『Name: Vritra Arclis
Level:10,000 [100%] (General rank)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank: S) [SSS+(?)]
Title: The Cursed Hunter [Level 10]
Vitality: 100%
Stats:
Strength:655,000
Agility:705,543
Endurance: 654,364 (LOCKED)
Intelligence: 721,283
Luck: 512
[Allocation points: 334,700]
"Oh!" Vritra looked at the large jump in his stats; they had increased by more than three times.
Those large numbers looked quite nice.
Then he decided to distribute the allocation points in his usual manner.
Stats:
Strength:655,000
Agility: 785,953
Endurance: 654,364 (LOCKED)
Intelligence: 935,573
Luck: 512
[Allocation points: 0]
"Hmm. That’s perfect now. I would love to go to the dragon kingdom, but so many people are already searching for me," Vritra pondered.
"But since the emperor is currently here, then wouldn’t sneaking in be easier? What do you think, wifey?" he questioned.

"Even so, it won’t be safe. Who knows how much that place has changed after I left? The defenses and whatnot might be even stronger now," Yasmine replied, even though she wanted to be with Vritra as soon as possible.
But for that, she didn’t want him to be in danger.
After a moment, she added:
"Let’s deal with the trouble here first. Nine Pacts, Bone Blood Cult, Golden Moon, Grieves, the emperor himself, and many more are after you. I think we already have enough on our plate."
While the two were having a chat, the demoness finally stirred awake from her sleep.
"Mmm. Are you finally done?" she rubbed her eyes and yawned, sitting up and stretching.
"Yeah, so it is time to part ways. Can you remove that pact now?" Vritra asked, hoping not to get too attached to her.
"Oof, Master, I think something is wrong with my heart. Ugh, I think I need a few more days of healing still," Maeve pretended while clutching her chest and lying back on the bed, rolling around.
"Sigh. I know you are already fine, so you can stop pretending. Fine, you can stay a bit longer with me," Vritra decided to compromise before asking.
"Do you know of any place in the continent which can sell us any sort of news?"
"Of course. If you want, I can bring you to the personal information sources of various races—even demons—or—" Maeve replied happily.
"Just bring me somewhere I can get whatever info I desire and... it is cheaper," Vritra said.
Although he had gathered quite a lot of wealth, info could be really expensive and might just cost all his money.
"Don’t worry, the place we will be going to will be completely free for you. Let’s go," Maeve said as she changed her appearance back to a little girl and flew out of the window.
Even she didn’t notice that they were inside the dimensional book.
Vritra stood up as he too disguised himself as a middle-aged man.
Then the two landed over the road. The place looked rather lively, but more than ordinary folks, the guards flooded the streets.
"ALL OF YOU, GET BACK IN YOUR HOUSES AND CLOSE YOUR SHOPS! THE WHOLE CONTINENT WILL BE SHUT FOR 2 DAYS!"
"ANYONE SEEN OUTSIDE DURING THIS TIME WILL BE ARRESTED AND, IN THE WORST CASE, WILL BE EXECUTED.
I REPEAT, WE ARE SEARCHING FOR A DEMON, SO ALL OF YOU NEED TO GET BACK IN YOUR HOUSES!"
Vritra and Maeve stopped together. They wondered if it was because of the murder of the prince or if something else had happened while they were away.
"Let’s hurry; that place isn’t too far," Maeve spoke as she grabbed Vritra’s hand and pulled him along.
All the people were closing their shops and rushing back into their houses. The guards already seemed ready to start attacking them.
’Is Darius doing this to stop the flow of information, or is there some other reason behind it?’ Vritra wondered while walking hurriedly alongside the demoness.
While avoiding the guards, the two quickly walked into one of the alleys, though a few guards noticed them and followed behind.
"Tch. These bugs, with that puny strength, they dare to be so arrogant," Maeve seemed quite angry as she sensed the group of guards chasing after them into the empty alley.
"Give me a moment, Master. I will get rid of them," Maeve said as she let go of his hand and turned around. Her eyes glowed with a pinkish light as flower petals began to float in the air.
"Who is there? Stop!" one man among the group of six shouted, getting ready to attack.
"Huh? There is a little girl and a man. Where are you going? Haven’t you heard of the announcement?" another of the two asked.
But they were surprised upon seeing the flower petals. Then they became dazed; without Maeve saying a word, they turned around and began walking back.
Maeve smiled and hurried back to Vritra’s side. Then she leaned towards him and spoke: "Master, did I do good?"
Vritra’s lips stretched into a thin line, seeing her act like this, especially in this disguise.
After a few seconds, he rolled his eyes and patted her head, saying: "Yeah, you did great. Let’s leave now."
Then she grabbed his hand and started pulling him along. After taking several turns, she entered a rundown house only to arrive in another dark alley.
After running around for nearly twenty more minutes, they finally stopped in front of a building that looked like a big igloo.
"And we are here, Master," Maeve said, pointing at the igloo.
Vritra looked at the building; at the top of it were three words:
WORLD INFORMATION CENTRE
"And which race does this place belong to?" Vritra questioned. There was nothing special in its surroundings.

"This place isn’t limited by races or languages. Anyone with enough connection and authority can get the information here for a certain price," Maeve said, then she added proudly: "But I just happen to be a high-ranked member of this organisation, so you don’t need to spend even a bronze coin here."
Maeve began walking towards the entrance, and Vritra followed.
Even the door seemed to be made of snow.
KNOCK KNOCK
After knocking, Maeve waited. After a moment, a high-pitched voice sounded from inside.
"KNOCK KNOCK, who is there?"
Maeve frowned, showing an embarrassed expression: "Open the door before I break it."
"Ding, wrong answer, two attempts left."
"You pigs, open it before I cut you to pieces."
"Ding, wrong answer, one attempt left," the same voice said from inside.
Vritra wondered what the password was that she was so against speaking.
"Open it now!"
Her aura burst out, shaking the entire igloo. The panicked voice of the person inside came in haste as the door opened.
"F-Forgive us, m-madam, please go inside." The two looked like dwarves but more childish, bowing deeply.
"Let’s go, Master~" Maeve finally smiled, taking his hand and strolling inside.

"Ding, wrong answer, one attempt left," the same voice said from inside.
Vritra wondered what the password was that she was so against speaking.
"Open it now!"
Her aura burst out, shaking the entire igloo.
The panicked voice of the person inside came in haste as the door opened.
"F-Forgive us, m-madam, please go inside." The two looked like dwarves but more childish, bowing deeply.
"Let’s go, Master~" Maeve finally smiled, taking his hand and strolling inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: Crow
paragraphs: As Vritra and Maeve entered the igloo, they walked into a corridor. Even from inside, it seemed to be made of ice and the temperature of the air was quite low.
There were several rooms on both sides but they all seemed to be empty, though Vritra could clearly sense that there were people hidden in all those rooms.
"Don’t worry master, those people are weak as hell; they won’t be a threat to us even if they want to. They just like to remain hidden." Maeve explained, sensing Vritra’s probing.
"What exactly is this place?" he asked. There were at least a few thousand people in this igloo so it can’t be some small organization.
"Like the name written outside, this place is called the World Information Centre and it literally does that.
It is one of the biggest organizations in the continent though its combat power couldn’t compare to the ones like Bone Blood Cult, the big families, Nine Pacts, Golden Moon, or many others.
But if you could find any information in the world then it will definitely be here." Maeve praised.
"Yeah hubby, we can get most of the information here. This place is also famous for their costly charges; they sell even the smallest news like the rarest diamond." Yasmine added.
After walking for a while, they arrived in front of a special looking room, as it alone was painted black in the whole igloo.
"This is the place our informer is. He is quite eccentric so don’t get too angry; I will handle it." Maeve said; she had already returned to her true form.
’There are humans, demons, and many other races here; how do they not have any conflict?’ Vritra wondered; maybe it was run by someone super powerful.
Maeve directly kicked the door open and walked inside, speaking: "How are you, Crow? Can I enter?"
"Ughh my doors, damnit, why are you here again? Didn’t I tell you to just get any information through the communication glyph?"
From inside, a man’s crow-like voice sounded. Vritra entered and was surprised to see the man with a crow’s head and body of a human.
"We have a vee~ry special guest here, and the information we need is very important so I came." Maeve answered before turning towards Vritra and explaining:
"This is Crow, one of the managers of this place."
Crow held an important position in the W.I.C; his strength was also at the general rank, there were very few managers in this place.
"Oh, you brought a customer?!" Crow’s eyes shone; he straightened up and tightened his tie, dusting off his expensive suit.
"Tell me what sort of news it is you want, but beware, you will have to pay first. I don’t like beggars stepping in my room." Crow said.
A news item had no fixed price; he could sell any news at any price.
"Crow, mind your language and he won’t be paying anything for your news." Maeve said, her eyes glowing dangerously.

"What? You know it is the policy of our organization; we only tell news for free to our members and outsiders have to pay. I can’t break the rules." Crow said righteously, putting a cigarette in his beak.
"Is that so? Fine, then you will be answering me." Maeve nodded, then turned to Vritra and asked: "Master, ask me whatever you want."
’Damnit this crazy demon, she found a loophole in the rule. Anyway who is this guy, why is she calling him her master, hmm interesting.’ Crow thought.
Vritra was in no mood for their drama. He pulled a chair and asked: "What has happened in the continent in the past few days? Tell us just a little about all the special events."
After he finished, Maeve turned to Crow and spoke:
"What has happened in the continent in the past fe-"
"Stop you don’t need to repeat, I understand I will answer your questions sigh." Taking a puff of the cigarette, he leaned onto the table and spoke in a whisper:
"Give me a millio- cough Give me a gold coin and I will let you in on a secret."
"..." Vritra frowned but Maeve added: "Haa It is fine, this is just his style."
She pulled a gold coin and tossed it at him; Crow caught the coin, he bit it and then put it away.
"The prince had turned into a man from a eunuch at his 19th birthday, he was so happy to finally have some balls."
Hearing this Vritra rolled his eyes, wondering if it really was as good of a place as Maeve and Yasmine said it to be.
"Stop your nonsense and answer, why is there suddenly a curfew all over the continent?" Maeve spoke, almost smashing his head into the wall.

"Anyway, the mess in the continent started ever since that announcement. At first things were still silent but recently there have been many changes and many big movements." Crow spoke in a serious tone; after a dramatic pause, he continued.
"First the city outside the continent getting destroyed, even the general named Sirius was so badly injured that he seemed to be searching for the people who healed the prince for some reason.
Anyway, after the recent marriage event, the whole palace was destroyed. But that was just the start, things only got more interesting."
Crow now got lost in the storytelling, leaning forward as he spoke: "Griffith was killed by some demon, for whom the search is still going on.
Oh right, Raelion and Maeve, the demon siblings they were also being chased haha I so wish I could rat you out."
"Try it." Maeve had a small smile on her face that made the birdman shiver; he averted his gaze from the sexy fox and looked at Vritra.
"You won’t believe, the prince was killed right in front of the emperor. And finally, the last bomb was dropped by the empress- oh sorry, she is no longer the empress." Crow continued to speak.
Vritra was quite surprised upon hearing about Yenni. His expression remained unchanged acting like he didn’t care about her at all but he was somewhat eager to hear her news.
It wasn’t easy to just kill the love and forget her all of a sudden; there are a few things that even time might not erase.
"Yennifer Gratt, not only she broke off that fake engagement but even exposed several of the King’s dirty secrets that put him in deep trouble.
Cough Give me a gold coin and I will let you in on a secret." Crow spoke.
Maeve sighed and threw yet another gold coin; after checking which he spoke:
"Darius’s relation with the other three emperors had turned ugly, this whole curfew isn’t just to silence all the news but also to stop the upcoming trouble."
"..." Vritra listened to it all; he didn’t know what to feel about Yennifer’s actions anymore, not sure if he could trust her again and afraid of going through the same pain.
"What about the Golden Moon, Nine Pacts, Bone Blood Cult or any other big organization or family, have they made any big movements?"
Vritra questioned, while a part of his mind was still busy with thoughts of Yenni.
"What about the Golden-" Maeve was about to repeat but was stopped by Crow.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: The Queen’s Deadly Challenge
paragraphs: Vritra had already gotten some information about the big organizations and families from Yasmine, so he knew of those six seats, even the twin duo he met while cutting off Green Claw’s finger.
"Yeah yeah, don’t repeat, I heard clearly enough." Crow said in annoyance; he would have made a fortune selling so much information.
"The big families are rather quiet, but maybe they might be taking some measures in secret.
But the Golden Moon’s six seats have started to move; they had already held a meeting after so many years." Crow said in astonishment.
"The demons, the Nine Pacts, and Bone Blood Cult seem to be just as active. All I can say is they are brewing a really big trouble.
Oh right, a member from the Golden Moon called Pink seems to be searching for someone." Crow added.
"Who is it?" Vritra asked.
"Give me a gold coin and I will let you in on a secret." Crow said with a nod.
Maeve threw a coin that smashed against his forehead and left a red mark over it.
"Oww How ungentle, womanly. Anyway, the person he is searching for isn’t Vritra." Crow spoke, putting away the gold.
"Really?" Vritra’s meter of patience was breaking with each word in that annoying voice. He grabbed Crow’s tie and spoke:
"Speak nonsense one more time, and I will put your beak up your ass, then keep asking yourself for that gold coin."
GULP
Crow shivered visibly, glancing at Maeve in fear.
While the demoness looked at Vritra with an adoring gaze, even his annoyed side looked so cute to her, though it wasn’t so cute for Crow.
"Uh... I don’t know the specifics but I heard Pink has been moving around Ghazi city to look for someone." Crow spoke hastily while pressing a button under the table rapidly.
"Ah don’t try it, I cut off the wires upon our arrival." Maeve spoke; she had predicted this with Vritra’s current mood.
"Oh right, give me a goooo- cough cough I mean, I just remembered one piece of very, very, very expensive news."
Crow barely stopped himself, remembering the threat.
"Sigh What is it now?" Vritra really wanted to get out of there; this place was giving him so much headache, especially the kaw kaw-like voice.

"The Pink who likes to touch men inappropriately seems to be part of some shady organizations like Bone Blood Cult and Nine Pacts; recently he has been seen colluding with them though he did change his appearance." Crow spoke carefully.
"Alright, thank you for answering all my questions." Vritra spoke before standing up and turning to leave.
"How unexpected, you actually survived and here I was thinking who would be replacing you soon." Maeve chuckled as she hurriedly followed along Vritra.
"Tsk These damned demons, they never follow any rules." Crow cursed before shouting: "Ah right, recently there has been a lot of enquiry for the city of charms."
Vritra paused for a moment then continued moving; he knew that the city of charms’ existence wasn’t really a secret but no one could find it nor could they break the defenses.

’At least I could be sure of mom’s and others’ safety, but it seems everyone is making big moves now; the fight might be happening faster than I expected but my strength is nowhere near enough to face them all.’
For some reason, he was reminded of those messages from the Divine; they were vague but mentioned death.
’Yennifer... I wonder if she is fine-’ Vritra’s thought drifted towards a certain beautiful lady before he shook his head and emptied his mind.
Having gathered all this information, he could at least be prepared for whatever might come.
They quickly walked out of the igloo and then made their way out of there, once again appearing in the empty alley.
"Looks like the curfew has already started, sigh looks like we will be stuck together for a while master." Maeve said, turning back into the little girl.
"What are you doing there? Arrest them!!" just then several guards rushed into the alley.
Vritra didn’t want to waste any more time and just wanted to return to the city of charms.
Taking Maeve’s hand, he teleported them both directly inside the hotel room.
"Whoa master, you can even teleport! Your field is space? It is incredibly rare; I have only heard about one or two also having similar field." She spoke in surprise.
"Wait here for me; I will be back soon." Vritra said, and without giving the cunning fox time to present any arguments, he disappeared.
"Wait maste- Humph and he is gone." Then she sat down on the bed and pulled out a book from her storage that she had recently gotten her hands on.
The title being: Master, not so hard!
She needed to widen her knowledge and get a better understanding of the world; of course, she was still working on her evil plan of seducing Vritra.
[Book of Dimensions Activated.]
Vritra’s speed was incredibly fast now; even at his 1% speed he was at least thousands of times faster than before, it was just incomparable.
In just a few seconds, Vritra arrived close to the city of charms while avoiding getting seen by others.
In a vast area, covered completely by lava. Hundreds of thousands of explosive lava monsters rose and flew towards a single entity.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
Sounds of explosions kept ringing as one creature after another was slaughtered by the sharp spear.
Vanessa stood half submerged in the lava, constantly suffering the burning sensation while fighting against those creatures.
It was one of the tests to become the next succubus Queen, though it would change her physique greatly.
The lava wasn’t normal, it kept seeping into her skin, pouring directly into her body and destroying her while also healing her at the same time.
Thankfully the passage of time inside was faster otherwise she might have needed to spend years inside this place, which was nothing short of a prison.
Each test was extremely gruesome; although the gains were huge, she had to put all her mind and strength to get over each one.
A cut appeared over her shoulder, as blood began to leak only to burn a moment later, even the color of her blood was changing.
’Honey, I am sorry that I have left you alone now but I will be with you very soon.’ Vanessa thought, missing Vritra so much. She had already been inside this place for so many days.
With a burst of rage, she swung the spear and blasted hundreds of those creatures before going deeper into the lava; the more she suffered, the higher her strength would be.
So enduring all the pain, she held her breath and stayed inside the lava, still cutting the blasting creatures though her body was riddled with countless injuries.
Those blasts were strong enough to even destroy the body of a person at 3rd Legion rank; each of these creatures was really deadly.
And just like while battling them, Vanessa had spent several weeks inside the lava and only came out when the lava no longer could hurt her; even those creatures couldn’t hurt her anymore.
But the tests were far from over; her strength grew rapidly but so did her fear of something bad happening to her son.
Vanessa’s performance far surpassed even the previous Succubus Queen.
